<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 935;
  const refillAmt = 343;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return;
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){

    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();

function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-28";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>
<script>
// Guild announcement dismiss logic
(function(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('guildAnnouncementBar');
  const btn = document.getElementById('dismissGuildAnnouncementBtn');
  if (!bar || !btn) return;

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    const annId = bar.getAttribute('data-ann-id') || '0';
    bar.style.display = 'none';

    const fd = new URLSearchParams();
    fd.set('ann_id', annId);

    fetch('announcement_guild_seen.php', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
      body: fd.toString(),
      cache: 'no-store'
    }).catch(()=>{});
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const PAYPAL_BONUS = 0.10; // 10%
  const CRYPTO_BONUS = 0.15; // 15%
  const userId       = 159129;
  const serverTime = 1793207665000;
  const clockStart = performance.now();
  const nowMs = () => serverTime + performance.now() - clockStart;
  const promoEndsAt = 1793989708000;



  // ---- Fill bonus texts (base + extra) + guild envelopes ----
function initBonusDisplay() {
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ny-pack-card');
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const baseGems = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-gems') || '0', 10) || 0;
    if (!baseGems) return;

    const paypalSpan = card.querySelector('.ny-bonus-value[data-bonus-type="paypal"]');
    const cryptoSpan = card.querySelector('.ny-bonus-value[data-bonus-type="crypto"]');

    const paypalExtra = Math.round(baseGems * PAYPAL_BONUS);
    const cryptoExtra = Math.round(baseGems * CRYPTO_BONUS);

    const paypalTotal = baseGems + paypalExtra;
    const cryptoTotal = baseGems + cryptoExtra;

    const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString();

    if (paypalSpan) paypalSpan.textContent = `${fmt(paypalTotal)} (${fmt(baseGems)} + ${fmt(paypalExtra)})`;
    if (cryptoSpan) cryptoSpan.textContent = `${fmt(cryptoTotal)} (${fmt(baseGems)} + ${fmt(cryptoExtra)})`;
  });
}

  // ---- Crypto modal ----
  const modal       = document.getElementById('nyCryptoModal');
  const packTitleEl = document.getElementById('nyCryptoPackTitle');
  const totalGemsEl = document.getElementById('nyCryptoTotalGems');
  const amountEl    = document.getElementById('nyCryptoAmount');
  const priceEl     = document.getElementById('nyCryptoPrice');
  const exampleEl   = document.getElementById('nyCryptoExample');

  function openCryptoModal(card) {
    if (!modal || !card || nowMs() >= promoEndsAt) return;

    const price    = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-price') || '0', 10) || 0;
    const baseGems = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-gems')  || '0', 10) || 0;
    const packName = card.getAttribute('data-pack-name') || 'Gems Pack';

    const bonus     = Math.round(baseGems * CRYPTO_BONUS);
    const total     = baseGems + bonus;
    const amountStr = price + '.00' + String(userId); // e.g. 50.001234

    const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString();

    if (packTitleEl) packTitleEl.textContent = `Pack: ${packName}`;
    if (totalGemsEl) totalGemsEl.textContent = `${fmt(total)} Gems (${fmt(baseGems)} + ${fmt(bonus)})`;
    if (priceEl)     priceEl.textContent = `$${price}`;
    if (amountEl)    amountEl.textContent = amountStr;
    if (exampleEl)   exampleEl.textContent = amountStr;


    modal.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  function closeCryptoModal() {
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (e.target.closest('.ny-pack-cta-paypal') && nowMs() >= promoEndsAt) {
      e.preventDefault();
      updateCountdown();
      return;
    }
    const btn = e.target.closest('.ny-pack-cta-crypto');
    if (btn) {
      const card = btn.closest('.ny-pack-card');
      openCryptoModal(card);
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (!modal || modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;
    if (e.target === modal || e.target.hasAttribute('data-ny-close')) {
      closeCryptoModal();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal && modal.style.display === 'flex') {
      closeCryptoModal();
    }
  });

  // Fixed database deadlines, using a server-anchored clock.
  const countdownEl = document.getElementById('nyCountdown');

  function updateCountdown() {
    if (!countdownEl) return;
    const diff = promoEndsAt - nowMs();

    if (diff <= 0) {
      countdownEl.textContent = "Ended";
      const promo = document.getElementById('eventGemPromo');
      if (promo) promo.hidden = true;
      closeCryptoModal();
      return;
    }

    const sec  = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
    const days = Math.floor(sec / 86400);
    const hrs  = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600);
    const mins = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
    const s    = sec % 60;

    countdownEl.textContent =
      `${days}d ${String(hrs).padStart(2,'0')}h ` +
      `${String(mins).padStart(2,'0')}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
  }

  let eventLaunchRefreshPending = false;
  function updateEventStartCountdowns() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.event-start-countdown[data-target]').forEach((el) => {
      const raw = el.getAttribute('data-target') || '';
      const target = new Date(raw).getTime();
      if (!target || Number.isNaN(target)) {
        el.textContent = 'Start time unavailable';
        return;
      }
      const now = nowMs();
      let diff = target - now;
      if (diff <= 0) {
        const launch = el.classList.contains('event-launch-countdown');
        el.textContent = launch ? 'The gate is opening...' : 'Live now';
        if (launch && !eventLaunchRefreshPending) {
          eventLaunchRefreshPending = true;
          // Reload once so PHP rebuilds the sealed tile as the real event link.
          // The countdown element is absent from the server's post-start response.
          window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1000);
        }
        return;
      }
      const sec  = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
      const days = Math.floor(sec / 86400);
      const hrs  = Math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600);
      const mins = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
      const s    = sec % 60;
      el.textContent =
        `${days}d ${String(hrs).padStart(2,'0')}h ` +
        `${String(mins).padStart(2,'0')}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
    });
  }

  function boot(){
    initBonusDisplay();
    updateCountdown();
    updateEventStartCountdowns();
    setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
    setInterval(updateEventStartCountdowns, 1000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>

          <li><strong>Daily Refills:</strong> Stamina is auto refilled twice by 50% of max stamina, once at midnight and another at midday. (Server Time)</li>
          <li><strong>Hourly Refill:</strong> Every player gets [40 + (level / 50) + ((ATTACK + DEFENSE) / 100)] stamina every hour. (Server Time)</li>
          <li><strong>Hourly Rewards:</strong> Every player receives <em>1 gem</em> and <em>3 PvP tokens</em> every hour. (Server Time)</li>
          <li>You can farm <strong>+2 stamina</strong> once per chapter by leaving your first reaction. capped at 1000 stamina / day</li>
          <li>Stamina potions can be purchased from the <em>Merchant</em>.</li>
        </ul>
        <p>Monsters drop <strong>items, crafting materials, and equipment</strong> that will prove very useful in your journey.</p>
        <p>Visit the <strong>Blacksmith</strong> to craft extremely powerful equipment.</p>
        <p>Do not forget to <strong>equip your pets and equipment</strong>; they will greatly increase your damage output.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
(function () {
  const COOKIE_NAME = 'veyraHowtoCollapsed';

  function getCookie(name) {
    const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
    const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
    if (parts.length === 2) {
      return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
    }
    return null;
  }

  function setCookie(name, val, days) {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setTime(d.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    const expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
    document.cookie = `${name}=${val};${expires};path=/`;
  }

  function initHowtoToggle() {
    const container = document.querySelector('.howto-info');
    const scroll    = container ? container.querySelector('.howto-info-scroll') : null;
    const btn       = document.getElementById('howtoToggle');
    if (!container || !scroll || !btn) return;

    let isCollapsed = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME) === '1';

    function applyState() {
      if (isCollapsed) {
        container.classList.add('collapsed');
        btn.textContent = 'Show';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      } else {
        container.classList.remove('collapsed');
        btn.textContent = 'Hide';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    }

    applyState();

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      isCollapsed = !isCollapsed;
      setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, isCollapsed ? '1' : '0', 365);
      applyState();
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initHowtoToggle);
  } else {
    initHowtoToggle();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 885;
  const refillAmt = 343;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return;
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>

<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){
  const drawer   = document.getElementById('sideDrawer');
  const fabOpen  = document.getElementById('nav_fab');       // 👈 bottom-left button
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('sideCloseBtn');  // ✕ inside drawer header
  const overlay  = document.getElementById('sideOverlay');   // dark backdrop on mobile

  if (!drawer) return;

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','true');
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','false');
  }

  if (fabOpen){
    fabOpen.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  }
  if (closeBtn){
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }
  if (overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }

  // ESC closes only on mobile view (doesn't really matter to check width though)
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();

function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-28";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>
<script>
// Guild announcement dismiss logic
(function(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('guildAnnouncementBar');
  const btn = document.getElementById('dismissGuildAnnouncementBtn');
  if (!bar || !btn) return;

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    const annId = bar.getAttribute('data-ann-id') || '0';
    bar.style.display = 'none';

    const fd = new URLSearchParams();
    fd.set('ann_id', annId);

    fetch('announcement_guild_seen.php', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
      body: fd.toString(),
      cache: 'no-store'
    }).catch(()=>{});
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
function pvpEscapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

const pvpClockStart = performance.now();
const pvpServerTime = 1793207715735;
let pvpSeasonLaunchPending = false;
function bindCountdown(id, endedLabel) {
  const node = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!node) return;
  const end = Number(node.dataset.end || 0) * 1000;
  if (!end) {
    node.textContent = endedLabel;
    return;
  }
  function tick() {
    const diff = end - (pvpServerTime + performance.now() - pvpClockStart);
    if (diff <= 0) {
      node.textContent = endedLabel;
      if ((id === 'seasonStartCountdown' || id === 'seasonStartCountdownInline') && !pvpSeasonLaunchPending) {
        pvpSeasonLaunchPending = true;
        window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1200);
      }
      return;
    }
    const total = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
    const days = Math.floor(total / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
    const seconds = total % 60;
    node.textContent = (days > 0 ? days + 'd ' : '') + String(hours).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(minutes).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
  }
  tick();
  window.setInterval(tick, 1000);
}

async function pvpPost(url, body) {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
      'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
    },
    body: new URLSearchParams(body)
  });
  return res.json();
}

function openAchievementModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('achievementModal');
  if (!modal) return;
  modal.classList.add('show');
}

function closeAchievementModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('achievementModal');
  if (!modal) return;
  modal.classList.remove('show');
}

function switchAchievementCategory(targetId) {
  if (!targetId) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.achievementTab').forEach((tab) => {
    tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.achTarget === targetId);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.achievementGroup').forEach((group) => {
    group.classList.toggle('active', group.id === targetId);
  });
}

let refillConfirmState = null;
let shopBuyConfirmForm = null;

function openRefillConfirm(ladder, cost) {
  const normalizedLadder = String(ladder || 'solo').toLowerCase() === 'party' ? 'party' : 'solo';
  const numericCost = Number(cost || 0);
  refillConfirmState = { ladder: normalizedLadder, cost: numericCost };

  const title = normalizedLadder === 'party' ? 'Confirm Party Token Refill' : 'Confirm Solo Token Refill';
  const text = normalizedLadder === 'party'
    ? 'Spend ' + numericCost.toLocaleString() + ' Gems to refill your party PvP tokens to the daily cap?'
    : 'Spend ' + numericCost.toLocaleString() + ' Gems to refill your solo PvP tokens?';
  const note = normalizedLadder === 'party'
    ? 'Only members who have been in this party for at least 3 days can refill the whole party token supply for the team.'
    : 'This uses Gems immediately and refreshes your solo PvP token supply through the normal refill endpoint.';

  document.getElementById('refillConfirmTitle').textContent = title;
  document.getElementById('refillConfirmText').textContent = text;
  document.getElementById('refillConfirmNote').textContent = note;
  document.getElementById('refillConfirmModal').classList.add('show');
}

function closeRefillConfirm() {
  refillConfirmState = null;
  document.getElementById('refillConfirmModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openShopBuyConfirm(form) {
  if (!form) return;
  const quantityInput = form.querySelector('input[name="quantity"]');
  const quantity = Math.max(1, Number(quantityInput ? quantityInput.value : 1) || 1);
  const itemName = form.dataset.itemName || 'this item';
  const pricePerItem = Math.max(0, Number(form.dataset.priceSouls || 0) || 0);
  const totalPrice = quantity * pricePerItem;
  shopBuyConfirmForm = form;

  document.getElementById('shopBuyConfirmTitle').textContent = 'Confirm Purchase';
  document.getElementById('shopBuyConfirmText').textContent = 'Buy ' + quantity.toLocaleString() + ' x ' + itemName + '?';
  document.getElementById('shopBuyConfirmNote').textContent = 'This will cost ' + totalPrice.toLocaleString() + ' Player Souls' + (quantity > 1 ? ' (' + pricePerItem.toLocaleString() + ' each).' : '.');
  document.getElementById('shopBuyConfirmModal').classList.add('show');
}

function closeShopBuyConfirm() {
  shopBuyConfirmForm = null;
  document.getElementById('shopBuyConfirmModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function confirmShopBuy() {
  if (!shopBuyConfirmForm) return;
  const form = shopBuyConfirmForm;
  closeShopBuyConfirm();
  form.submit();
}

    form.submit();
  }
}

function renderRankingRewards(rows) {
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) {
    return '<div class="empty">No reward rows are configured yet.</div>';
  }
  return rows.map((row) => {
    const from = Number(row.RANK_FROM || 0);
    const to = Number(row.RANK_TO || 0);
    const label = from === to ? ('Rank #' + from) : ('Ranks #' + from + ' - #' + to);
    const items = Array.isArray(row.ITEMS) ? row.ITEMS : [];
    const rewardsHtml = items.length
      ? '<div class="rewardGrid">' + items.map((item) => {
          const image = item.IMAGE_URL || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
          return '<div class="rewardCard">' +
            '<img src="' + pvpEscapeHtml(image) + '" alt="">' +
            '<div>' +
              '<div><strong>' + pvpEscapeHtml(item.NAME || ('Item #' + item.ID)) + '</strong></div>' +
              '<div class="muted">x' + Number(item.QUANTITY || 0).toLocaleString() + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>';
        }).join('') + '</div>'
      : '<div class="empty">No items configured for this bracket.</div>';
    return '<div class="rewardLine"><div style="font-weight:900;margin-bottom:10px">' + pvpEscapeHtml(label) + '</div>' + rewardsHtml + '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderTierRewards(rows) {
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) {
    return '<div class="empty">No tier rewards are configured yet.</div>';
  }
  return '<div class="rewardList">' + rows.map((line) => '<div class="rewardLine">' + pvpEscapeHtml(line) + '</div>').join('') + '</div>';
}

async function loadRewards(type) {
  let url = '';
  let title = '';
  if (type === 'solo') {
    url = 'pvp_rewards_ranking.php?ladder=solo';
    title = 'Solo Ranking Rewards';
  } else if (type === 'party') {
    url = 'pvp_rewards_ranking.php?ladder=party';
    title = 'Party Ranking Rewards';
  } else {
    url = 'pvp_rewards_tiers.php';
    title = 'Tier Rewards';
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } });
    const data = await res.json();
    openRewardModal(title, type === 'tiers' ? renderTierRewards(data) : renderRankingRewards(data));
  } catch (err) {
    window.alert('Could not load rewards right now.');
  }
}

const matchmakeBusy = { solo: false, party: false };

function setMatchmakeButtonsBusy(ladder, busy) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.js-matchmake').forEach((btn) => {
    if ((btn.dataset.ladder || 'solo') !== ladder) return;
    if (busy) {
      if (!btn.dataset.originalLabel) {
        btn.dataset.originalLabel = btn.textContent || '';
      }
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Finding Match...';
    } else {
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (btn.dataset.originalLabel) {
        btn.textContent = btn.dataset.originalLabel;
      }
    }
  });
}

async function runMatchmake(ladder) {
  ladder = (ladder || 'solo').toLowerCase();
  if (matchmakeBusy[ladder]) {
    return;
  }
  matchmakeBusy[ladder] = true;
  setMatchmakeButtonsBusy(ladder, true);
  try {
    const data = await pvpPost('pvp_matchmake.php', { ladder: ladder });
    if (!data || data.status !== 'success') {
      window.alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not start matchmaking.');
      return;
    }
    if (data.redirect) {
      window.location.href = data.redirect;
      return;
    }
    window.location.reload();
  } catch (err) {
    window.alert('Could not contact matchmaking.');
  } finally {
    matchmakeBusy[ladder] = false;
    setMatchmakeButtonsBusy(ladder, false);
  }
}

async function refillTokens(ladder) {
  try {
    const data = await pvpPost('pvp_refill.php', { refill: 1, ladder: ladder });
    if (!data || data.status !== 'success') {
      window.alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Refill failed.');
      return;
    }
    window.alert(data.message || 'Tokens refilled.');
    window.location.reload();
  } catch (err) {
    window.alert('Could not refill tokens right now.');
  }
}

async function confirmRefillTokens() {
  if (!refillConfirmState) return;
  const ladder = refillConfirmState.ladder;
  closeRefillConfirm();
  await refillTokens(ladder);
}

document.querySelectorAll('.js-matchmake').forEach((btn) => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => runMatchmake(btn.dataset.ladder || 'solo'));
});

document.querySelectorAll('.js-refill').forEach((btn) => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => openRefillConfirm(btn.dataset.ladder || 'solo', btn.dataset.cost || '0'));
});

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 865;
  const refillAmt = 343;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
