async function finishIntroSequence(){
  try {
    const data = await postAction("dismiss_intro", {node_id: selectedNodeId});
    closeBriefOverlay();
    if (data.state) applyState(data.state);
    showToast("The Crucible syncs your route.");
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(err.message || "Could not continue.");
  }
}

function renderIntroLine(){
  if (!Array.isArray(introQueue) || !introQueue.length) return;
  const line = introQueue[Math.max(0, Math.min(introIndex, introQueue.length - 1))] || {};
  if (introSpeaker) introSpeaker.textContent = String(line.speaker || "Dungeon Creator");
  if (introPortrait) {
    const url = String(line.portrait || "").trim();
    introPortrait.innerHTML = url ? `<img src="${url.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" alt="">` : "";
  }
  if (introText) introText.textContent = String(line.dialogue || "");
  if (introMeta) introMeta.textContent = `${introIndex + 1} / ${introQueue.length}`;
  if (introContinue) introContinue.textContent = introIndex >= introQueue.length - 1 ? "Enter Dungeon" : "Continue";
}

function curve(a,b){
  const mx=((a.x+b.x)/2)+((b.y-a.y)*.08);
  const my=((a.y+b.y)/2)-((b.x-a.x)*.08);
  return `M ${a.x} ${a.y} Q ${mx} ${my} ${b.x} ${b.y}`;
}

function buildFaceHtml(faceKey){
  const faceMeta = FACE_DATA[faceKey] || {title:faceKey,sub:"",badge:faceKey,desc:"",nodes:[],paths:[]};
  const faceNodes = (Array.isArray(state?.nodes) ? state.nodes : [])
    .filter(node => String(node.face_key || "") === String(faceKey))
    .map(node => ({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.name,
      type: node.type,
      x: node.x,
      y: node.y,
      status: node.status,
      enter_label: node.enter_label,
      hint: node.hint,
      description: node.description,
      monsters_left: node.monsters_left,
      monsters_total: node.monsters_total
    }));
  const face = {...faceMeta, nodes: faceNodes};
  const nodeMap = {};
  face.nodes.forEach(node => nodeMap[String(node.id)] = node);
  const paths = (face.paths || []).map(([a,b]) => {
    const start = nodeMap[String(a)];
    const end = nodeMap[String(b)];
    return start && end ? `<path d="${curve(start,end)}"></path>` : "";
  }).join("");
  const nodes = face.nodes.map(node => {
    const statusClass = `s-${(node.status || "available").replace(/[^a-z_]/gi, "_")}`;
    return `<button class="node t-${node.type} ${statusClass}" style="left:${node.x}%;top:${node.y}%;" data-face="${faceKey}" data-node="${node.id}" aria-label="${node.label}"><span class="label">${node.label}</span></button>`;
  }).join("");
  return `<div class="grid"></div><div class="fh"><div><h2>${face.title}</h2><div class="fs">${face.sub || ""}</div></div><div class="badge">${face.badge}</div></div><svg class="paths" viewBox="0 0 100 100">${paths}</svg><div class="nodes">${nodes}</div>`;
}

document.querySelectorAll(".face").forEach(faceEl => {
  faceEl.innerHTML = buildFaceHtml(faceEl.dataset.face);
});

if (tabs) {
  ["front","right","back","left","top","bottom"].forEach(faceKey => {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.className = "tab";
    button.dataset.face = faceKey;
    button.textContent = faceKey;
    button.onclick = () => setFace(faceKey);
    tabs.appendChild(button);
  });
}

function getAllNodes(){
  return (state.nodes || []).reduce((acc, node) => {
    acc[String(node.id)] = node;
    return acc;
  }, {});
}

function getNode(nodeId){
  return getAllNodes()[String(nodeId)] || null;
}

function syncFront(){
  document.querySelectorAll(".face").forEach(face => face.classList.toggle("fronting", face.dataset.face === frontFace));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(tab => tab.classList.toggle("on", tab.dataset.face === frontFace));
}

function updateRunLeaders(){
  const leaders = state.run_leaders || [];
  if (!leaders.length) {
    els.runLeadersBox.innerHTML = "<p>No run stats yet. The Crucible is still waiting.</p>";
    return;
  }
  els.runLeadersBox.innerHTML = leaders.slice(0, 5).map(row => {
    const picture = row.PICTURE && row.PICTURE !== "" ? row.PICTURE : "/images/monsters/not_set.webp";
    return `<div class="hero"><img src="${picture}" alt=""><div><strong>${row.USERNAME}</strong><small>${Number(row.TOTAL_PVE_DAMAGE || 0).toLocaleString()} damage / ${Number(row.ARMY_UNITS_KILLED || 0)} army kills / ${Number(row.PVP_STYLE_WINS || 0)} PvP wins</small></div></div>`;
  }).join("");
}

function getNodeExtraText(node){
  if (!node) return "";
  if ((node.type === "pve" || node.type === "boss") && Number(node.monsters_total || 0) > 0) {
    return `Enemies: ${Number(node.monsters_left || 0)} / ${Number(node.monsters_total || 0)} left`;
  }
  if (node.type === "forge") return "Craft the Crucible's legendary poison set here";
  if (node.type === "shop") return "Exchange sigils for dungeon materials and supplies";
  if (node.type === "army") {
    if (node.unlock_rule === "all_army_other") {
      return "Army boss trial. Unlocks after every other army node is cleared";
    }
    const cleared = Number(node.army_matches_cleared || 0);
    const total = Number(node.army_matches_total || 0);
    if (total > 0) return `Army Fights: ${cleared} / ${total} cleared`;
    return node.status === "in_progress" ? "A live shared army battle is already open" : "Shared captain battle for your guild";
  }
  if (node.type === "pvp") {
    if (node.unlock_rule === "all_pvp_other") {
      return "PvP boss trial. Unlocks after every other PvP-style node is cleared";
    }
    const cleared = Number(node.pvp_matches_cleared || 0);
    const total = Number(node.pvp_matches_total || 0);
    if (total > 0) return `PvP Matches: ${cleared} / ${total} cleared`;
    return "PvP-style chamber for up to 5 guild members";
  }
  if (node.type === "boss") {
    return node.unlock_rule === "crucible_apex"
      ? "Apex seal. Unlocks only after every other active node, including the specialist boss trials, is cleared"
      : "The final chamber of the Crucible";
  }
  return String(node.hint || "");
}

function formatFaceLabel(faceKey){
  return FACE_DATA[String(faceKey || "")]?.title || String(faceKey || "Unknown");
}

function formatStatusLabel(status){
  const raw = String(status || "available").replace(/_/g, " ");
  return raw.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + raw.slice(1);
}

function renderNodeTable(){
  if (!nodeTableView) return;
  const faceOrder = ["front","right","back","left","top","bottom"];
  const rows = (Array.isArray(state?.nodes) ? state.nodes : [])
    .filter(node => String(node.type || "") !== "arrival")
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const faceA = faceOrder.indexOf(String(a.face_key || ""));
      const faceB = faceOrder.indexOf(String(b.face_key || ""));
      if (faceA !== faceB) return faceA - faceB;
      const aLocked = String(a.status || "") === "locked" ? 1 : 0;
      const bLocked = String(b.status || "") === "locked" ? 1 : 0;
      if (aLocked !== bLocked) return aLocked - bLocked;
      return String(a.name || "").localeCompare(String(b.name || ""));
    });

  if (!rows.length) {
    nodeTableView.innerHTML = `<div class="tableIntro"><div><h3>Node Table</h3><p>The Crucible has not revealed any nodes yet.</p></div></div>`;
    return;
  }

  nodeTableView.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tableIntro">
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow">Lightweight View</div>
        <h3>Crucible Node Table</h3>
        <p>Use this low-lag list to review every revealed, locked, and cleared node without rendering the 3D cube.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pill"><strong>${rows.length}</strong> nodes tracked</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tableWrap">
      <table class="nodeTable">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Face</th>
            <th>Node</th>
            <th>Type</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Progress</th>
            <th>Hint</th>
            <th>Action</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${rows.map(node => {
            const nodeId = String(node.id);
            const selectedClass = selectedNodeId === nodeId ? " sel" : "";
            const progress = escHtml(getNodeExtraText(node) || "No live progress to show.");
            const hint = escHtml(node.description || node.hint || "Awaiting interaction.");
            const actionHtml = canEnterNode(node)
              ? `<button class="btn tableActionBtn" type="button" data-enter-node="${nodeId}">${escHtml(node.enter_label || "Enter")}</button>`
              : `<span class="tableLocked">Locked</span>`;
            return `
              <tr class="${selectedClass.trim()}" data-select-node="${nodeId}">
                <td><div class="tableFace">${escHtml(formatFaceLabel(node.face_key))}</div></td>
                <td>
                  <div class="tableNodeName">${escHtml(node.name || "Unknown Node")}</div>
                  <div class="tableNodeSub">${escHtml(node.unlock_rule || "")}</div>
                </td>
                <td><span class="statusPill">${escHtml(TYPE_LABELS[node.type] || node.type || "Node")}</span></td>
                <td><span class="statusPill status-${escHtml(String(node.status || "available").replace(/[^a-z_]/gi, "_"))}">${escHtml(formatStatusLabel(node.status))}</span></td>
                <td><div class="tableProgress">${progress}</div></td>
                <td><div class="tableHint">${hint}</div></td>
                <td>${actionHtml}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  `;
}

function applyViewMode(mode){
  viewMode = mode === "table" ? "table" : "cube";
  if (stage) {
    stage.classList.toggle("table-mode", viewMode === "table");
  }
  updateViewModeButton(viewMode);
  renderNodeTable();
  if (viewMode === "table") {
    stopCubeSpin();
  } else {
    startCubeSpin();
  }
}

function selectNode(nodeId){
  const node = getNode(nodeId);
  if (!node) return;
  selectedNodeId = String(node.id);
  frontFace = node.face_key || frontFace;
  if (RING.includes(frontFace)) lastRing = frontFace;
  target = {...(ROT[frontFace] || ROT.front)};
  lastTouch = performance.now();
  document.querySelectorAll(".node").forEach(el => el.classList.toggle("sel", el.dataset.node === String(node.id)));
  nodeTableView?.querySelectorAll("[data-select-node]").forEach(row => row.classList.toggle("sel", row.dataset.selectNode === String(node.id)));
  els.nodeTitle.textContent = node.name || "Unknown Node";
  els.nodeDesc.textContent = node.description || "";
  els.nodeStatus.textContent = `Status: ${node.status || "available"}`;
  els.nodeHint.textContent = node.hint ? node.hint : " ";
  els.nodeExtra.textContent = getNodeExtraText(node);
  els.nodeType.innerHTML = `<i></i><span>${TYPE_LABELS[node.type] || node.type}</span>`;
  els.nodeType.style.color = TYPE_COLOR[node.type] || "var(--cyan)";
  els.footer.textContent = `Current node: ${node.name}`;
  els.focusBtn.textContent = `${frontFace.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${frontFace.slice(1)} Face`;
  const disabled = ["hidden","locked"].includes(node.status || "");
  els.enterBtn.disabled = disabled;
  els.enterBtn.textContent = node.enter_label || "Enter";
  syncFront();
}

function setFace(faceKey){
  frontFace = faceKey;
  if (RING.includes(faceKey)) lastRing = faceKey;
  target = {...(ROT[faceKey] || ROT.front)};
  lastTouch = performance.now();
  const firstNode = (state.nodes || []).find(node => node.face_key === faceKey && node.is_revealed);
  if (firstNode) selectNode(firstNode.id);
  syncFront();
}

function left(){ if (!RING.includes(frontFace)) return setFace("left"); const index = RING.indexOf(frontFace); setFace(RING[(index + RING.length - 1) % RING.length]); }
function right(){ if (!RING.includes(frontFace)) return setFace("right"); const index = RING.indexOf(frontFace); setFace(RING[(index + 1) % RING.length]); }
function rotateTopFace(){ setFace(frontFace === "top" ? (lastRing || "front") : "top"); }
document.getElementById("leftBtn")?.addEventListener("click", left);
document.getElementById("rightBtn")?.addEventListener("click", right);
document.getElementById("topBtn")?.addEventListener("click", rotateTopFace);
window.addEventListener("keydown", event => { if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") left(); if (event.key === "ArrowRight") right(); if (event.key === "ArrowUp") rotateTopFace(); });

function canEnterNode(node){
  if (!node || ["hidden","locked"].includes(node.status || "")) return false;
  return true;
}

async function runNodeAction(nodeOverride){
  const node = nodeOverride || getNode(selectedNodeId);
  if (!canEnterNode(node)) return;
  try {
    const data = await postAction("enter_node", {node_id: node.id, face_key: node.face_key});
    if (data.state) applyState(data.state);
    if (data.redirect) { window.location.href = data.redirect; return; }
    if (data.message) showToast(data.message);
  } catch (err) { showToast(err.message || "Action failed."); }
}

document.addEventListener("click", event => {
  const nodeButton = event.target.closest(".node");
  if (!nodeButton) return;
  const node = getNode(nodeButton.dataset.node);
  if (!node) return;
  selectNode(node.id);
  if (canEnterNode(node)) {
    runNodeAction(node);
  }
});

nodeTableView?.addEventListener("click", async event => {
  const enterButton = event.target.closest("[data-enter-node]");
  if (enterButton) {
    const node = getNode(enterButton.dataset.enterNode);
    if (!node) return;
    selectNode(node.id);
    await runNodeAction(node);
    return;
  }
  const row = event.target.closest("[data-select-node]");
  if (!row) return;
  const node = getNode(row.dataset.selectNode);
  if (!node) return;
  selectNode(node.id);
});

const dragState = {active:false,startX:0,startY:0,baseX:0,baseY:0,moved:false,pointerId:null};
function clamp(value, min, max){ return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value)); }
function nearestFaceForRotation(x, y){
  let bestFace = frontFace;
  let bestDist = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  Object.entries(ROT).forEach(([faceKey, rot]) => {
    const dx = x - rot.x;
    const dy = y - rot.y;
    const dist = (dx * dx) + (dy * dy);
    if (dist < bestDist) {
      bestDist = dist;
      bestFace = faceKey;
    }
  });
  return bestFace;
}
function stopDrag(pointerId){
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  dragState.active = false;
  if (pointerId !== null && scene.releasePointerCapture) {
    try { scene.releasePointerCapture(pointerId); } catch (err) {}
  }
  const snappedFace = nearestFaceForRotation(target.x, target.y);
  frontFace = snappedFace;
  if (RING.includes(frontFace)) lastRing = frontFace;
  target = {...(ROT[frontFace] || ROT.front)};
  lastTouch = performance.now();
  const firstNode = (state.nodes || []).find(node => node.face_key === frontFace && node.is_revealed);
  if (firstNode) selectNode(firstNode.id);
  else syncFront();
}
scene?.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
  if (event.target.closest(".node, .ctrl, .tab, .btn, a, button")) return;
  dragState.active = true;
  dragState.startX = event.clientX;
  dragState.startY = event.clientY;
  dragState.baseX = target.x;
  dragState.baseY = target.y;
  dragState.moved = false;
  dragState.pointerId = event.pointerId;
  lastTouch = performance.now();
  if (scene.setPointerCapture) {
    try { scene.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
  }
});
scene?.addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  const dx = event.clientX - dragState.startX;
  const dy = event.clientY - dragState.startY;
  if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 6) dragState.moved = true;
  target.x = clamp(dragState.baseX - (dy * 0.36), -130, 92);
  target.y = clamp(dragState.baseY + (dx * 0.42), -240, 110);
  lastTouch = performance.now();
});
scene?.addEventListener("pointerup", event => stopDrag(event.pointerId));
scene?.addEventListener("pointercancel", event => stopDrag(event.pointerId));

let cubeSpinHandle = 0;
function spin(now){
  if (viewMode === "table" || !cube) {
    cubeSpinHandle = 0;
    return;
  }
  const dt = now - lastTouch, idle = dt > 700 ? Math.min(1, (dt - 700) / 1400) : 0;
  const wx = idle * (Math.sin(now * .00062) * 4.4 + Math.cos(now * .00027) * 1.6);
  const wy = idle * (Math.cos(now * .00041) * 8.5);
  const wz = idle * (Math.sin(now * .00053) * 2.8);
  live.x += ((target.x + wx) - live.x) * .085;
  live.y += ((target.y + wy) - live.y) * .085;
  cube.style.transform = `rotateX(${live.x}deg) rotateY(${live.y}deg) rotateZ(${wz}deg)`;
  cubeSpinHandle = requestAnimationFrame(spin);
}
function startCubeSpin(){
  if (viewMode === "table" || cubeSpinHandle || !cube) return;
  cubeSpinHandle = requestAnimationFrame(spin);
}
function stopCubeSpin(){
  if (!cubeSpinHandle) return;
  cancelAnimationFrame(cubeSpinHandle);
  cubeSpinHandle = 0;
}

async function postAction(action, payload){
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("action", action);
  fd.append("instance_id", String(INSTANCE_ID));
  Object.entries(payload || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => fd.append(key, String(value)));
  const res = await fetch("guild_dungeon_cube_action.php", {method: "POST", body: fd, credentials: "same-origin"});
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !data || !data.ok) throw new Error((data && data.message) ? data.message : "The Crucible did not respond.");
  return data;
}

function redrawCube(){
  document.querySelectorAll(".face").forEach(faceEl => faceEl.innerHTML = buildFaceHtml(faceEl.dataset.face));
}
function applyState(nextState){ state = nextState; redrawCube(); renderNodeTable(); els.clearCount.textContent = String(state.total_clears || 0); updateRunLeaders(); selectNode(state.selected_node_id || selectedNodeId); }

els.enterBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  await runNodeAction();
});

els.focusBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try { await postAction("set_face", {face_key: frontFace, node_id: selectedNodeId}); showToast("Face focus updated."); }
  catch (err) { showToast(err.message || "Could not save your view."); }
});

completeNodeBtn?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const node = getNode(selectedNodeId);
  if (!node) return;
  try {
    const data = await postAction("admin_complete_node", {node_id: node.id, face_key: node.face_key});
    if (data.state) applyState(data.state);
    showToast(data.message || "Node auto-completed.");
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(err.message || "Could not auto-complete that node.");
  }
});

    closeIntroOverlay();
    openBriefOverlay();
  });

  if (!confirm("Restart this entire dungeon run?")) return;

    const data = await postAction("admin_restart_dungeon", {});
    showToast(data.message || "Dungeon restarted.");
    if (data.redirect) {
      window.location.href = data.redirect;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(err.message || "Could not restart the dungeon.");
  }
});

giveUpBtn?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to GIVE UP?\nThis will immediately end the current dungeon run for your guild.")) return;
  const oldLabel = giveUpBtn.textContent;
  giveUpBtn.disabled = true;
  giveUpBtn.textContent = "Ending...";
  try {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("instance_id", String(INSTANCE_ID));
    const res = await fetch("guild_dungeon_surrender.php", {
      method: "POST",
      body: fd,
      headers: {"X-Requested-With": "fetch"},
      credentials: "same-origin"
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!res.ok || !data || !data.ok) {
      throw new Error((data && data.error) ? data.error : "Could not end the run.");
    }
    window.location.href = "guild_dungeon.php";
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(err.message || "Could not end the run.");
    giveUpBtn.disabled = false;
    giveUpBtn.textContent = oldLabel;
  }
});

<script>
const cv = document.getElementById("fx");
const ctx = cv ? cv.getContext("2d", {alpha:true}) : null;
const FX_PRESETS = {
  high: {dprCap: 1.6, particles: 110, sigils: 16, fog: true, frameMs: 0, opacity: 1},
  low: {dprCap: 1, particles: 32, sigils: 6, fog: false, frameMs: 48, opacity: 0.85},
  off: {dprCap: 1, particles: 0, sigils: 0, fog: false, frameMs: 0, opacity: 0}
};
let fxMode = getStoredFxMode();
let fxPreset = FX_PRESETS[fxMode] || FX_PRESETS.high;
let fxParticles = [];
let fxSigils = [];
let fxHandle = 0;
let fxLastDraw = 0;

function makeParticles(count){
  return Array.from({length: count}, () => ({
    x: Math.random(),
    y: Math.random(),
    r: .6 + Math.random() * 2.8,
    s: .12 + Math.random() * .45,
    d: (Math.random() - .5) * .18,
    a: .18 + Math.random() * .42
  }));
}

function makeSigils(count){
  return Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) => ({
    angle: (Math.PI * 2 * i) / Math.max(1, count),
    r: .32 + Math.random() * .18,
    size: 10 + Math.random() * 14,
    s: .12 + Math.random() * .18,
    color: i % 3 === 0 ? "112,214,255" : (i % 3 === 1 ? "170,145,255" : "255,215,122")
  }));
}

function reseedFx(){
  fxParticles = makeParticles(fxPreset.particles);
  fxSigils = makeSigils(fxPreset.sigils);
}

function resizeFx(){
  if (!cv || !ctx) return;
  const width = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 1);
  const height = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 1);
  const dpr = Math.min(fxPreset.dprCap, Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
  cv.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
  cv.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
  cv.style.width = width + "px";
  cv.style.height = height + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}

window.addEventListener("resize", resizeFx);

function rune(x,y,size,rot,color,a){
  if (!ctx) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},${a})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.15;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0,0,size*.72,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-size*.56,0);
  ctx.lineTo(size*.56,0);
  ctx.moveTo(0,-size*.56);
  ctx.lineTo(0,size*.56);
  ctx.moveTo(-size*.42,-size*.42);
  ctx.lineTo(size*.42,size*.42);
  ctx.moveTo(size*.42,-size*.42);
  ctx.lineTo(-size*.42,size*.42);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function fog(cx,cy,t){
  if (!ctx || !fxPreset.fog) return;
  [
    {ox:Math.sin(t*.00028)*180,oy:Math.cos(t*.00023)*70,r:180,c:"112,214,255",a:.09},
    {ox:Math.cos(t*.00022+1.3)*220,oy:Math.sin(t*.00017+.6)*90,r:210,c:"170,145,255",a:.07},
    {ox:Math.sin(t*.00019+2.2)*140,oy:Math.cos(t*.00021+1.1)*110,r:160,c:"255,159,131",a:.06}
  ].forEach(w => {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx+w.ox,cy+w.oy,0,cx+w.ox,cy+w.oy,w.r);
    g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${w.c},${w.a})`);
    g.addColorStop(.55,`rgba(${w.c},${w.a*.32})`);
    g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx+w.ox,cy+w.oy,w.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawFxFrame(t){
  if (!ctx || !cv) return;
  const width = parseFloat(cv.style.width || "0") || window.innerWidth || 1;
  const height = parseFloat(cv.style.height || "0") || window.innerHeight || 1;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
  const r = scene.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
  const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
  fog(cx,cy,t);
  const pulse = (Math.sin(t*.0018)+1)*.5;
  const rad = 130 + pulse*40;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,rad*.14,cx,cy,rad);
  g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,.03)");
  g.addColorStop(.3,"rgba(112,214,255,.10)");
  g.addColorStop(.65,"rgba(170,145,255,.04)");
  g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx,cy,rad,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  fxSigils.forEach((s,i) => {
    const angle = s.angle + (t*.00022*s.s) * (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1);
    const orb = Math.min(width,height) * s.r;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * orb;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * (orb*.46);
    const alpha = .07 + ((Math.sin(t*.0014+i)+1)*.5)*.16;
    rune(x,y,s.size,angle+t*.0003,s.color,alpha);
  });

  fxParticles.forEach((p,i) => {
    const x = (p.x*width+((t*.018*p.s)%(width+60))-30)%(width+60)-30;
    const y = (p.y*height+Math.sin(t*.00035+i)*26+((t*p.d)*.02))%(height+50);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,232,255,${p.a})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function stopFxLoop(){
  if (fxHandle) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(fxHandle);
    fxHandle = 0;
  }
  if (ctx && cv) {
    const width = parseFloat(cv.style.width || "0") || window.innerWidth || 1;
    const height = parseFloat(cv.style.height || "0") || window.innerHeight || 1;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
  }
}

function runFxLoop(t){
  if (fxMode === "off" || !ctx || !cv) {
    fxHandle = 0;
    return;
  }
  fxHandle = requestAnimationFrame(runFxLoop);
  if (fxPreset.frameMs > 0 && (t - fxLastDraw) < fxPreset.frameMs) return;
  fxLastDraw = t;
  drawFxFrame(t);
}

function startFxLoop(){
  if (fxMode === "off" || !ctx || !cv) {
    stopFxLoop();
    return;
  }
  if (!fxHandle) {
    fxLastDraw = 0;
    fxHandle = requestAnimationFrame(runFxLoop);
  }
}

window.getCubeFxMode = function(){
  return fxMode;
};

window.applyCubeFxMode = function(mode){
  const nextMode = (mode === "off" || mode === "low") ? mode : "high";
  fxMode = nextMode;
  fxPreset = FX_PRESETS[fxMode] || FX_PRESETS.high;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(FX_MODE_KEY, fxMode);
  } catch (err) {}
  reseedFx();
  resizeFx();
  updateFxConfigButton(fxMode);
  if (fxCurrentMode) fxCurrentMode.textContent = `Current Mode: ${labelForFxMode(fxMode)}`;
  document.body.classList.toggle("fx-off", fxMode === "off");
  if (cv) cv.style.opacity = String(fxPreset.opacity);
  if (fxMode === "off") {
    stopFxLoop();
  } else {
    startFxLoop();
  }
};

reseedFx();
resizeFx();
window.applyCubeFxMode(fxMode);

let hasStoredFxMode = false;
try {
  hasStoredFxMode = !!localStorage.getItem(FX_MODE_KEY);
} catch (err) {}

const fxDetection = detectLowPerformance();
if (!hasStoredFxMode && !hasSeenFxPrompt() && fxDetection.weak) {
  pendingFxSuggestion = fxDetection.suggested;
  pendingFxReasons = fxDetection.reasons;
  markFxPromptSeen();
  openFxOverlay({
    auto: true,
    suggested: fxDetection.suggested,
    reasons: fxDetection.reasons
  });
}

syncFront();
applyViewMode(viewMode);
updateRunLeaders();
selectNode(selectedNodeId || state.entry_node_id || 0);
renderIntroLine();
syncModalLock();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 760;
  const refillAmt = 343;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return;
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {

(function(){

function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-28";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>

<script>
function startReviveCountdown(spanId, btnId, reviveAtMs, nowMs){
  const span = document.getElementById(spanId);
  const btn  = document.getElementById(btnId);
  if (!span || !btn) return;

  let serverNow = nowMs;

  function fmt(s){
    const h = Math.floor(s/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((s%3600)/60);
    const sec = s%60;
    const tw = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
    return `${tw(h)}:${tw(m)}:${tw(sec)}`;
  }

  function tick(){
    const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((reviveAtMs - serverNow)/1000));
    if (remaining <= 0){
      span.textContent = '00:00:00';
      btn.disabled = false;           // ← enables exactly when time is up
      btn.title = 'You can heal now';
      return;
    }
    span.textContent = fmt(remaining);
    serverNow += 1000;
    setTimeout(tick, 1000);
  }
  tick();
}

function healDungeonPlayer(instanceId, userId, btn){
  try { btn && (btn.disabled = true); } catch(e){}
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append('instance_id', instanceId);
  fd.append('user_id', userId);

  fetch('user_heal.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: fd,
    headers: {'X-Requested-With': 'fetch'}
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(j => {
    if (j && j.ok) location.reload();
    else {
      alert(j && j.error ? j.error : 'Heal failed.');
      if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
  })
  .catch(() => {
    alert('Network error.');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
  });
}
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  const BTN_ID   = 'btn_recalc_hp';
  const ENDPOINT = 'guild_dungeon_recalc_hp.php';
  const COST     = 500000; // 500k guild gold
  const btn = document.getElementById(BTN_ID);
  if (!btn) return;

  function fmt(n){ try{ return Number(n).toLocaleString(); } catch { return String(n); } }

  btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const ok = confirm(`Spend ${fmt(COST)} guild gold to recalculate all players’ MAX HP?\nThis action cannot be undone.`);
    if (!ok) return;

    // lock UI
    const oldLabel = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = 'Working…';
    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('instance_id', '16113');

      const r = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: fd,
        headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'fetch' }
      });

      // tolerate non-JSON (but your endpoint returns JSON)
      const ct = r.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      const data = ct.includes('application/json') ? await r.json() : null;

      if (!r.ok || !data) {
        alert(data?.error || `Server error (HTTP ${r.status})`);
        return;
      }

      if (data.ok) {
        const spent = fmt(data.spent ?? COST);
        const rec   = fmt(data.recalculated ?? 0);
        const rem   = (data.remaining_gold != null) ? `\nRemaining gold: ${fmt(data.remaining_gold)}.` : '';
        alert(`Recalculated ${rec} players.\nSpent ${spent} gold.${rem}`);
        location.reload();
      } else {
        alert(data.error || 'Failed.');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Network error.');
    } finally {
      // unlock (in case we didn’t reload)
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = oldLabel;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn_surrender');
  if (!btn) return;

  btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const ok = confirm('Are you sure you want to SURRENDER?\nThis will immediately end the current dungeon run for your guild.');
    if (!ok) return;

    const old = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'Ending…';

    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('instance_id', '16113');

      const r = await fetch('guild_dungeon_surrender.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: fd,
        headers: {'X-Requested-With': 'fetch'}
      });

      const ct = r.headers.get('content-type')||'';
      const data = ct.includes('application/json') ? await r.json() : null;

      if (!r.ok || !data || !data.ok) {
        alert((data && data.error) || `Server error (HTTP ${r.status})`);
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = old;
        return;
      }
      // success
      location.reload();
    } catch(e){
      alert('Network error.');
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = old;
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 740;
  const refillAmt = 343;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return;
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>

<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){
  const drawer   = document.getElementById('sideDrawer');
  const fabOpen  = document.getElementById('nav_fab');       // 👈 bottom-left button
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('sideCloseBtn');  // ✕ inside drawer header
  const overlay  = document.getElementById('sideOverlay');   // dark backdrop on mobile

  if (!drawer) return;

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','true');
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','false');
  }

  if (fabOpen){
    fabOpen.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  }
  if (closeBtn){
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }
  if (overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }

  // ESC closes only on mobile view (doesn't really matter to check width though)
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();
