function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-28";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>

// Guild announcement dismiss logic
(function(){

  const btn = document.getElementById('dismissGuildAnnouncementBtn');

    fetch('announcement_guild_seen.php', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
      body: fd.toString(),
      cache: 'no-store'
    }).catch(()=>{});
  });
})();

<script>
let questCooldownReloadQueued = false;

function formatQuestCooldown(totalSeconds) {
    totalSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
    const days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
    const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

    if (days > 0) {
        return `${days}d ${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds)}`;
    }
    return `${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds)}`;
}

function startQuestCooldowns() {
    const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-cooldown-ts]'));
    if (!nodes.length) return;
    let timer = null;

    function tick() {
        const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        let hasFutureCooldown = false;

        nodes.forEach(node => {
            const unlockTs = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-cooldown-ts') || '0', 10);
            if (!unlockTs) return;

            const remaining = unlockTs - now;
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                node.textContent = 'Ready now';
                if (!questCooldownReloadQueued) {
                    questCooldownReloadQueued = true;
                    setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1200);
                }
                return;
            }

            hasFutureCooldown = true;
            node.textContent = formatQuestCooldown(remaining);
        });

        if (!hasFutureCooldown) {
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }

    tick();
    timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startQuestCooldowns);

function acceptQuest(qid, btn) {
    if (!confirm("Accept this quest from the Adventurer's Guild?")) return;
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/adventurers_accept_quest.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({ quest_id: qid })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data && data.status === 'ok') {
            alert(data.message || 'Quest accepted!');
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not accept quest.');
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        alert('Server error while accepting quest.');
        btn.disabled = false;
    });
}
function buyShopItem(shopId, btn) {
    if (!confirm("Purchase this item from the Adventurer's Shop?")) return;
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/adventurers_shop_buy.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({ shop_item_id: shopId })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data && data.status === 'ok') {
            alert(data.message || 'Purchase successful!');
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not complete purchase.');
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        alert('Server error while buying item.');
        btn.disabled = false;
    });
}
function finishQuest(qid, btn) {
    if (!confirm("Turn in this quest at the Adventurer's Guild?")) return;
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/adventurers_finish_quest.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({ quest_id: qid })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data && data.status === 'ok') {
            alert(data.message || 'Quest finished!');
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not finish quest.');
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        alert('Server error while finishing quest.');
        btn.disabled = false;
    });
}

function giveUpQuest(qid, btn) {
    if (!confirm("Abandon this quest? Progress will be lost.")) return;
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/adventurers_giveup_quest.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({ quest_id: qid })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data && data.status === 'ok') {
            alert(data.message || 'Quest abandoned.');
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not abandon quest.');
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        alert('Server error while abandoning quest.');
        btn.disabled = false;
    });
}
function donateGatherItem(qid, itemId, btn) {
    if (!confirm("Donate one of this item towards your quest? You must own more than one.")) return;
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/adventurers_donate_gather.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({
            quest_id: qid,
            item_id: itemId
        })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data && data.status === 'ok') {
            alert(data.message || 'Item donated successfully.');
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Could not donate item.');
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        alert('Server error while donating item.');
        btn.disabled = false;
    });
}

</script>

  const shouldShowOlympusIntro = false;
  const shouldShowMelanippeStableIntro = false;
  const melanippeStableIntroLines = ["My stable is open now. Come check the items I have for sale; your pets will need more than courage on these roads."];
  const serverNowTs = 1793207924;
  const clientLoadedAtTs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const byKey = new Map(domains.map((domain) => [String(domain.key), domain]));
  const npcByKey = new Map(olympusNpcs.map((npc) => [String(npc.key), npc]));
  const modal = document.getElementById('domainModal');
  const modalTitle = document.getElementById('domainModalTitle');
  const modalText = document.getElementById('domainModalText');
  const modalStatus = document.getElementById('domainModalStatus');
  const modalCountdown = document.getElementById('domainModalCountdown');
  const closeModal = () => {
    if (modalCountdown) {
      modalCountdown.hidden = true;
      modalCountdown.dataset.unlockTs = '';
    }
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  };
  function currentServerTs(){
    return serverNowTs + (Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - clientLoadedAtTs);
  }
  function secondsUntilUnlock(unlockTs){
    return Math.max(0, Number(unlockTs || 0) - currentServerTs());
  }
  function formatUnlockCountdown(seconds){
    if (seconds <= 0) return 'Ready to unlock';
    const days = Math.floor(seconds / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    const hh = String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0');
    const ss = String(secs).padStart(2, '0');
    return days > 0 ? `${days}d ${hh}h ${mm}m ${ss}s` : `${hh}h ${mm}m ${ss}s`;
  }
  function refreshDomainCountdowns(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-unlock-ts]').forEach((el) => {
      const unlockTs = Number(el.dataset.unlockTs || 0);
      if (unlockTs <= 0) return;
      const text = formatUnlockCountdown(secondsUntilUnlock(unlockTs));
      el.textContent = el.id === 'domainModalCountdown' ? `Unlocks in ${text}` : text;
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.domain-marker.locked').forEach((marker) => {
    marker.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const domain = byKey.get(String(marker.dataset.domain || ''));
      if (!domain) return;
      modalTitle.textContent = `${domain.name}: ${domain.domain}`;
      const unlockTs = Number(domain.unlock_at_ts || 0);
      modalText.textContent = domain.maintenance
        ? `This wave is being updated. It will reopen when the countdown ends.`
        : (unlockTs > 0
        ? `${domain.summary} This domain is visible on the map, but its seal has not opened yet.`
        : `${domain.summary} This domain is visible on the map, but it is not unlocked yet.`);
      modalStatus.textContent = domain.status || 'Sealed';
      if (modalCountdown && unlockTs > 0) {
        modalCountdown.dataset.unlockTs = String(unlockTs);
        modalCountdown.hidden = false;
        refreshDomainCountdowns();
      }
      modal.classList.add('open');
      modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    });
  });
  refreshDomainCountdowns();
  setInterval(refreshDomainCountdowns, 1000);
  document.getElementById('domainModalClose')?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  modal?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === modal) closeModal();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') closeModal();

  const npcDialogue = document.getElementById('npcDialogue');
  const npcDialoguePortrait = document.getElementById('npcDialoguePortrait');
  const npcDialogueTitle = document.getElementById('npcDialogueTitle');
  const npcDialogueName = document.getElementById('npcDialogueName');
  const npcDialogueText = document.getElementById('npcDialogueText');
  const npcDialogueNext = document.getElementById('npcDialogueNext');
  const npcDialogueSkip = document.getElementById('npcDialogueSkip');
  let npcDialogueQueue = [];
  let npcDialogueIndex = 0;
  let npcDialogueOpen = false;
  let npcDialogueActiveNpc = null;

  function escapeHtml(value){
    return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (ch) => ({
      '&':'&amp;',
      '<':'&lt;',
      '>':'&gt;',
      '"':'&quot;',
      "'":'&#039;'
    }[ch]));
  }

  function npcInitials(npc){
    const name = String(npc?.name || 'O').trim();
    return (name.slice(0, 1) || 'O').toUpperCase();
  }

  function renderNpcDialogueLine(){
    const line = npcDialogueQueue[npcDialogueIndex];
    if (!line) {
      closeNpcDialogue();
      return;
    }
    const npc = line.npc || {};
    if (npcDialogueName) npcDialogueName.textContent = String(npc.name || 'Olympus');
    if (npcDialogueTitle) npcDialogueTitle.textContent = String(npc.title || npc.role || '');
    if (npcDialogueText) npcDialogueText.textContent = String(line.text || '');
    if (npcDialoguePortrait) {
      const portrait = String(npc.portrait || '').trim();
      if (portrait) {
        npcDialoguePortrait.innerHTML = `<img src="${escapeHtml(portrait)}" alt="">`;
      } else {
        npcDialoguePortrait.textContent = npcInitials(npc);
      }
    }
    if (npcDialogueNext) {
      npcDialogueNext.textContent = npcDialogueIndex >= npcDialogueQueue.length - 1 ? 'Close' : 'Next';
    }
  }

  function openNpcDialogue(npc, forceIntro = false, customLines = null){
    if (!npcDialogue || !npc) return;
    let lines = [];
    if (Array.isArray(customLines) && customLines.length) {
      lines = customLines.slice();
    } else if (forceIntro && Array.isArray(npc.intro_dialogue) && npc.intro_dialogue.length) {
      lines = npc.intro_dialogue.slice();
    } else if (npc.random_dialogue && Array.isArray(npc.dialogue) && npc.dialogue.length) {
      lines = [npc.dialogue[Math.floor(Math.random() * npc.dialogue.length)]];
    } else {
      lines = Array.isArray(npc.dialogue) ? npc.dialogue : [];
    }
    if (!lines.length) return;
    npcDialogueQueue = lines.map((text) => ({ npc, text }));
    npcDialogueIndex = 0;
    npcDialogueOpen = true;
    npcDialogueActiveNpc = npc;
    npcDialogue.classList.add('isOpen');
    npcDialogue.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.body.classList.add('dlgLock');
    renderNpcDialogueLine();
  }

  function closeNpcDialogue(options = {}){
    const completedNpc = options.completed ? npcDialogueActiveNpc : null;
    npcDialogueQueue = [];
    npcDialogueIndex = 0;
    npcDialogueOpen = false;
    npcDialogueActiveNpc = null;
    npcDialogue?.classList.remove('isOpen');
    npcDialogue?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.classList.remove('dlgLock');
    if (completedNpc && String(completedNpc.shop || '') === 'damon_potions') {
      setTimeout(openDamonShop, 120);
    }
    if (completedNpc && String(completedNpc.shop || '') === 'melanippe_stable') {
      setTimeout(openMelanippeStable, 120);
    }
    if (completedNpc && String(completedNpc.shop || '') === 'brontes_mythic_forge') {
      setTimeout(openBrontesForge, 120);
    }
    if (options.completed) {
      setTimeout(runNextOlympusAutoDialogue, 160);
    }
  }

  function nextNpcDialogueLine(){
    if (!npcDialogueOpen) return;
    npcDialogueIndex += 1;
    if (npcDialogueIndex >= npcDialogueQueue.length) {
      closeNpcDialogue({ completed: true });
      return;
    }
    renderNpcDialogueLine();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.npc-marker').forEach((marker) => {
    marker.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const npc = npcByKey.get(String(marker.dataset.npc || ''));
      openNpcDialogue(npc);
    });
  });
  npcDialogueNext?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    nextNpcDialogueLine();
  });
  npcDialogueSkip?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    closeNpcDialogue({ completed: true });
  });
  npcDialogue?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === npcDialogue) nextNpcDialogueLine();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape' && npcDialogueOpen) closeNpcDialogue();
  });

  const olympusAutoDialogueQueue = [];
  if (shouldShowOlympusIntro) {
    olympusAutoDialogueQueue.push({ npc: npcByKey.get('calliope'), forceIntro: true, lines: null });
  }
  if (shouldShowMelanippeStableIntro) {
    olympusAutoDialogueQueue.push({ npc: npcByKey.get('melanippe'), forceIntro: false, lines: melanippeStableIntroLines });
  }
  function runNextOlympusAutoDialogue(){
    if (npcDialogueOpen || olympusAutoDialogueQueue.length <= 0) return;
    const next = olympusAutoDialogueQueue.shift();
    if (!next?.npc) return runNextOlympusAutoDialogue();
    openNpcDialogue(next.npc, !!next.forceIntro, next.lines || null);
  }
  if (olympusAutoDialogueQueue.length) {
    setTimeout(runNextOlympusAutoDialogue, 450);
  }

  const damonShopModal = document.getElementById('damonShopModal');
  const damonShopGrid = document.getElementById('damonShopGrid');
  const damonShopGold = document.getElementById('damonShopGold');
  const damonShopStatus = document.getElementById('damonShopStatus');
  const damonShopClose = document.getElementById('damonShopClose');

  function normalizeAssetUrl(url){
    const value = String(url || '').trim();
    if (!value) return '';
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(value) || value.startsWith('/')) return value;
    return `/${value}`;
  }

  function setDamonShopStatus(message, type = ''){
    if (!damonShopStatus) return;
    damonShopStatus.classList.remove('ok', 'err');
    if (type) damonShopStatus.classList.add(type);
    damonShopStatus.textContent = message || '';
  }

  function closeDamonShop(){
    damonShopModal?.classList.remove('open');
    damonShopModal?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  function renderDamonShop(data){
    if (!damonShopGrid) return;
    if (damonShopGold) damonShopGold.textContent = Number(data.gold || 0).toLocaleString();
    const offers = Array.isArray(data.offers) ? data.offers : [];
    damonShopGrid.innerHTML = offers.map((offer) => {
      const remaining = offer.weekly_limit > 0 ? Number(offer.remaining || 0) : null;
      const maxQty = remaining === null ? 99 : Math.max(0, remaining);
      const disabled = maxQty <= 0 ? 'disabled' : '';
      const image = normalizeAssetUrl(offer.image_url);
      const weeklyText = offer.weekly_limit > 0
        ? `Weekly limit: ${Number(offer.bought || 0).toLocaleString()} / ${Number(offer.weekly_limit || 0).toLocaleString()}`
        : 'No weekly limit';
      return `
        <article class="damon-item-card" data-offer="${escapeHtml(offer.key)}">
          <img class="damon-item-img" src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="">
          <div>
            <div class="damon-item-name">${escapeHtml(offer.name)}</div>
            <div class="damon-item-meta">
              Price: ${Number(offer.price || 0).toLocaleString()} Gold<br>
              ${escapeHtml(weeklyText)}
            </div>
            <div class="damon-buy-row">
              <input class="damon-qty" type="number" min="1" max="${maxQty}" value="${maxQty > 0 ? 1 : 0}" ${disabled}>
              <button type="button" class="btn primary damon-buy-btn" ${disabled}>Buy</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </article>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  async function loadDamonShop(){
    setDamonShopStatus('Loading shop...');
    const res = await fetch('olympus_damon_buy.php?action=state', {
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      credentials: 'same-origin'
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.status !== 'success') {
      throw new Error(data.message || 'Could not load shop.');
    }
    renderDamonShop(data);
    setDamonShopStatus('');
  }

  async function openDamonShop(){
    if (!damonShopModal) return;
    damonShopModal.classList.add('open');
    damonShopModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    try {
      await loadDamonShop();
    } catch (error) {
      setDamonShopStatus(error.message || 'Could not load shop.', 'err');
    }
  }

  async function buyDamonOffer(card){
    const key = String(card?.dataset?.offer || '');
    const qtyInput = card?.querySelector('.damon-qty');
    const buyBtn = card?.querySelector('.damon-buy-btn');
    const qty = Math.max(1, parseInt(qtyInput?.value || '1', 10) || 1);
    if (!key || !buyBtn) return;
    buyBtn.disabled = true;
    setDamonShopStatus('Processing purchase...');
    try {
      const body = new URLSearchParams({ offer: key, qty: String(qty) });
      const res = await fetch('olympus_damon_buy.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body,
        credentials: 'same-origin'
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status !== 'success') {
        throw new Error(data.message || 'Purchase failed.');
      }
      renderDamonShop(data);
      setDamonShopStatus(data.message || 'Purchase completed.', 'ok');
    } catch (error) {
      setDamonShopStatus(error.message || 'Purchase failed.', 'err');
      buyBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

    if (buyBtn) {
      event.preventDefault();
      buyDamonOffer(buyBtn.closest('.damon-item-card'));
    }
  });

  const brontesForgeLocked = true;
  const brontesForgeModal = document.getElementById('brontesForgeModal');
  const brontesForgeGold = document.getElementById('brontesForgeGold');
  const brontesForgeStatus = document.getElementById('brontesForgeStatus');
  const brontesPrimarySlot = document.getElementById('brontesPrimarySlot');
  const brontesSacrificeSlot = document.getElementById('brontesSacrificeSlot');
  const brontesForgeConfirm = document.getElementById('brontesForgeConfirm');
  const brontesForgeClose = document.getElementById('brontesForgeClose');
  const brontesPickerModal = document.getElementById('brontesPickerModal');
  const brontesPickerTitle = document.getElementById('brontesPickerTitle');
  const brontesPickerEyebrow = document.getElementById('brontesPickerEyebrow');
  const brontesPickerList = document.getElementById('brontesPickerList');
  const brontesPickerClose = document.getElementById('brontesPickerClose');
  let brontesState = { gold: 0, primary: [], sacrifices: [], forge_cost: 500000000 };
  let brontesPrimary = null;
  let brontesSacrifice = null;
  let brontesPickerKind = 'primary';

  function setBrontesStatus(message, type = ''){
    if (!brontesForgeStatus) return;
    brontesForgeStatus.classList.remove('ok', 'err');
    if (type) brontesForgeStatus.classList.add(type);
    brontesForgeStatus.textContent = message || '';
  }

  function normalizeForgeType(type){
    return String(type || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }

  function brontesItemMeta(item){
    if (!item) return '';
    const bits = [
      `${escapeHtml(item.type || 'Equipment')} · Level ${Number(item.level || 0)}`,
      `ATK ${Number(item.attack || 0).toLocaleString()} · DEF ${Number(item.defense || 0).toLocaleString()}`
    ];
    if (item.power_text) bits.push(escapeHtml(item.power_text));
    if (Number(item.quantity || 1) > 1) bits.push(`Stacked x${Number(item.quantity || 1).toLocaleString()} - cannot forge while stacked`);
    return bits.join('<br>');
  }

  function brontesPickedHtml(item, emptyText){
    if (!item) return `<div class="brontes-empty">${escapeHtml(emptyText)}</div>`;
    const image = normalizeAssetUrl(item.image_url);
    const rarity = item.rarity_override || item.rarity || 'Legendary';
    return `
      <div class="brontes-picked">
        <img src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="">
        <div>
          <div class="brontes-picked-name">${escapeHtml(item.name || 'Legendary Item')}</div>
          <div class="brontes-picked-meta">
            ${escapeHtml(rarity)}<br>
            ${brontesItemMeta(item)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderBrontesForge(){
    if (brontesForgeLocked) {
      brontesPrimarySlot.disabled = true;
      brontesSacrificeSlot.disabled = true;
      brontesForgeConfirm.disabled = true;
      setBrontesStatus('Forge Beyond Legendary is currently locked.');
      return;
    }
    if (brontesForgeGold) brontesForgeGold.textContent = Number(brontesState.gold || 0).toLocaleString();
    if (brontesPrimarySlot) {
      brontesPrimarySlot.innerHTML = `
        <div class="brontes-slot-title">Olympian Legendary</div>
        ${brontesPickedHtml(brontesPrimary, 'Click to pick a legendary level 5 Olympian equipment or weapon.')}
      `;
    }
    if (brontesSacrificeSlot) {
      brontesSacrificeSlot.disabled = !brontesPrimary;
      brontesSacrificeSlot.innerHTML = `
        <div class="brontes-slot-title">Devoured Legendary</div>
        ${brontesPickedHtml(
          brontesSacrifice,
          brontesPrimary
            ? 'Click to pick a same-type level 5 non-Olympian legendary sacrifice.'
            : 'Pick the Olympian item first. Then choose a same-type level 5 legendary sacrifice.'
        )}
      `;
    }
    if (brontesForgeConfirm) {
      brontesForgeConfirm.disabled = !(brontesPrimary && brontesSacrifice && Number(brontesState.gold || 0) >= Number(brontesState.forge_cost || 500000000));
    }
  }

  async function loadBrontesForge(){
    if (brontesForgeLocked) { renderBrontesForge(); return; }
    setBrontesStatus('Loading forge...');
    const res = await fetch('olympus_brontes_forge.php?action=state', {
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      credentials: 'same-origin'
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.status !== 'success') {
      throw new Error(data.message || 'Could not load forge.');
    }
    brontesState = data;
    if (brontesPrimary) {
      brontesPrimary = (data.primary || []).find((item) => Number(item.inv_id) === Number(brontesPrimary.inv_id)) || null;
    }
    if (brontesSacrifice) {
      brontesSacrifice = (data.sacrifices || []).find((item) => Number(item.inv_id) === Number(brontesSacrifice.inv_id)) || null;
    }
    renderBrontesForge();
    setBrontesStatus('');
  }

  async function openBrontesForge(){
    if (!brontesForgeModal) return;
    brontesForgeModal.classList.add('open');
    brontesForgeModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    try {
      await loadBrontesForge();
    } catch (error) {
      setBrontesStatus(error.message || 'Could not load forge.', 'err');
    }
  }

  function closeBrontesForge(){
    brontesForgeModal?.classList.remove('open');
    brontesForgeModal?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    brontesPickerModal?.classList.remove('open');
    brontesPickerModal?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  function closeBrontesPicker(){
    brontesPickerModal?.classList.remove('open');
    brontesPickerModal?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  function brontesPickerItems(kind){
    if (kind === 'primary') return Array.isArray(brontesState.primary) ? brontesState.primary : [];
    const wantedType = normalizeForgeType(brontesPrimary?.type || '');
    return (Array.isArray(brontesState.sacrifices) ? brontesState.sacrifices : [])
      .filter((item) => normalizeForgeType(item.type) === wantedType);
  }

  function openBrontesPicker(kind){
    if (brontesForgeLocked) { renderBrontesForge(); return; }
    brontesPickerKind = kind;
    const items = brontesPickerItems(kind);
    if (brontesPickerEyebrow) brontesPickerEyebrow.textContent = kind === 'primary' ? 'Olympian Legendary' : 'Devoured Legendary';
    if (brontesPickerTitle) brontesPickerTitle.textContent = kind === 'primary' ? 'Pick Olympian Level 5 Legendary' : `Pick ${brontesPrimary?.type || 'Same-Type'} Sacrifice`;
    if (brontesPickerList) {
      brontesPickerList.innerHTML = items.length ? items.map((item) => {
        const image = normalizeAssetUrl(item.image_url);
        const disabled = Number(item.quantity || 1) > 1 || Number(item.is_mythic || 0) === 1;
        return `
          <button type="button" class="brontes-pick-card" data-inv-id="${Number(item.inv_id || 0)}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>
            <img src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="">
            <div>
              <div class="brontes-pick-name">${escapeHtml(item.name || 'Legendary Item')}</div>
              <div class="brontes-pick-meta">${brontesItemMeta(item)}</div>
            </div>
          </button>
        `;
      }).join('') : '<div class="brontes-empty">No eligible legendary level 5 item found.</div>';
    }
    brontesPickerModal?.classList.add('open');
    brontesPickerModal?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  }

  async function forgeBrontesMythic(){
    if (brontesForgeLocked) { renderBrontesForge(); return; }
    if (!brontesPrimary || !brontesSacrifice || !brontesForgeConfirm) return;
    brontesForgeConfirm.disabled = true;
    setBrontesStatus('Heating the Third Anvil...');
    try {
      const body = new URLSearchParams({
        primary_inv_id: String(brontesPrimary.inv_id),
        sacrifice_inv_id: String(brontesSacrifice.inv_id)
      });
      const res = await fetch('olympus_brontes_forge.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body,
        credentials: 'same-origin'
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status !== 'success') {
        throw new Error(data.message || 'Forge failed.');
      }
      brontesState = data;
      brontesPrimary = null;
      brontesSacrifice = null;
      renderBrontesForge();
      setBrontesStatus(data.message || 'Mythic forge complete.', 'ok');
    } catch (error) {
      setBrontesStatus(error.message || 'Forge failed.', 'err');
      renderBrontesForge();
    }
  }

  brontesPrimarySlot?.addEventListener('click', () => openBrontesPicker('primary'));
  brontesSacrificeSlot?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (brontesPrimary) openBrontesPicker('sacrifice');
  });
  brontesForgeClose?.addEventListener('click', closeBrontesForge);
  brontesForgeConfirm?.addEventListener('click', forgeBrontesMythic);
  brontesPickerClose?.addEventListener('click', closeBrontesPicker);
  brontesForgeModal?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === brontesForgeModal) closeBrontesForge();
  });
  brontesPickerModal?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === brontesPickerModal) closeBrontesPicker();
    const card = event.target.closest?.('.brontes-pick-card');
    if (!card || card.disabled) return;
    const invId = Number(card.dataset.invId || 0);
    const source = brontesPickerKind === 'primary' ? brontesState.primary : brontesPickerItems('sacrifice');
    const picked = source.find((item) => Number(item.inv_id) === invId);
    if (!picked) return;
    if (brontesPickerKind === 'primary') {
      brontesPrimary = picked;
      brontesSacrifice = null;
    } else {
      brontesSacrifice = picked;
    }
    closeBrontesPicker();
    renderBrontesForge();
  });

  const mapWrap = document.querySelector('.map-frame');
  const mapEl = document.getElementById('olympusMap');
  let mapScale = 1;
  let mapMinScale = 1;
  let mapTx = 0;
  let mapTy = 0;
  let dragStart = null;
  let pinchStart = null;
  const activePointers = new Map();
  let touchGesture = null;
  let framePending = false;
  let wrapRect = null;
  let wrapW = 0;
  let wrapH = 0;
  let mapW = 3840;
  let mapH = 2901;

  function updateMapMetrics(){
    if (!mapWrap || !mapEl) return;
    wrapRect = mapWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    wrapW = mapWrap.clientWidth;
    wrapH = mapWrap.clientHeight;
    mapW = mapEl.offsetWidth || 3840;
    mapH = mapEl.offsetHeight || 2901;
  }

  function applyMapTransformNow(){
    mapEl.style.transform = `translate(${mapTx}px, ${mapTy}px) scale(${mapScale})`;
  }

  function scheduleMapTransform(){
    if (framePending) return;
    framePending = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      framePending = false;
      applyMapTransformNow();
    });
  }

  function clampMap(){
    if (!mapWrap || !mapEl) return;
    const ww = wrapW || mapWrap.clientWidth;
    const wh = wrapH || mapWrap.clientHeight;
    const mw = mapW * mapScale;
    const mh = mapH * mapScale;

    if (mw <= ww) {
      mapTx = (ww - mw) / 2;
    } else {
      mapTx = Math.min(0, Math.max(ww - mw, mapTx));
    }

    if (mh <= wh) {
      mapTy = (wh - mh) / 2;
    } else {
      mapTy = Math.min(0, Math.max(wh - mh, mapTy));
    }
  }

  function fitMapToScreen(){
    if (!mapWrap || !mapEl) return;
    updateMapMetrics();
    mapMinScale = Math.max(wrapW / mapW, wrapH / mapH);
    mapScale = mapMinScale;
    mapTx = (wrapW - mapW * mapScale) / 2;
    mapTy = (wrapH - mapH * mapScale) / 2;
    applyMapTransformNow();
  }

  function zoomMap(delta, clientX, clientY){
    if (!mapWrap || !mapEl) return;
    const rect = wrapRect || mapWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = clientX - rect.left;
    const py = clientY - rect.top;
    const oldScale = mapScale;
    const nextScale = Math.max(mapMinScale, Math.min(mapMinScale * 4.5, mapScale * delta));
    if (Math.abs(nextScale - oldScale) < 0.0001) return;

    const mapX = (px - mapTx) / oldScale;
    const mapY = (py - mapTy) / oldScale;
    mapScale = nextScale;
    mapTx = px - mapX * mapScale;
    mapTy = py - mapY * mapScale;
    clampMap();
    scheduleMapTransform();
  }

  mapWrap?.addEventListener('wheel', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!wrapRect) updateMapMetrics();
    const delta = Math.exp(-event.deltaY * 0.0018);
    zoomMap(delta, event.clientX, event.clientY);
  }, { passive:false });

  function pointerPair(){
    return Array.from(activePointers.values()).slice(0, 2);
  }

  function pointerDistance(a, b){
    return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
  }

  function pointerCenter(a, b){
    return { x:(a.x + b.x) / 2, y:(a.y + b.y) / 2 };
  }

  mapWrap?.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    if (event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
    if (event.target.closest('.domain-marker, .npc-marker, .npc-dialogue')) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, { x:event.clientX, y:event.clientY });
    mapWrap.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);

    if (activePointers.size === 1) {
      dragStart = { x:event.clientX, y:event.clientY, tx:mapTx, ty:mapTy };
      pinchStart = null;
      return;
    }

    if (activePointers.size === 2) {
      const [a, b] = pointerPair();
      const center = pointerCenter(a, b);
      pinchStart = {
        distance: Math.max(1, pointerDistance(a, b)),
        center,
        scale: mapScale,
        tx: mapTx,
        ty: mapTy,
      };
      dragStart = null;
    }
  });

  mapWrap?.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    if (event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
    if (!activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, { x:event.clientX, y:event.clientY });

    if (activePointers.size >= 2 && pinchStart) {
      const [a, b] = pointerPair();
      const distance = Math.max(1, pointerDistance(a, b));
      const center = pointerCenter(a, b);
      const rect = wrapRect || mapWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      const oldScale = pinchStart.scale;
      const nextScale = Math.max(mapMinScale, Math.min(mapMinScale * 4.5, oldScale * (distance / pinchStart.distance)));
      const anchorX = pinchStart.center.x - rect.left;
      const anchorY = pinchStart.center.y - rect.top;
      const mapX = (anchorX - pinchStart.tx) / oldScale;
      const mapY = (anchorY - pinchStart.ty) / oldScale;

      mapScale = nextScale;
      mapTx = (center.x - rect.left) - mapX * mapScale;
      mapTy = (center.y - rect.top) - mapY * mapScale;
      clampMap();
      scheduleMapTransform();
      return;
    }

    if (!dragStart || activePointers.size !== 1) return;
    mapTx = dragStart.tx + (event.clientX - dragStart.x);
    mapTy = dragStart.ty + (event.clientY - dragStart.y);
    clampMap();
    scheduleMapTransform();
  });

  function endPointer(event){
    if (event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
    pinchStart = null;

    if (activePointers.size === 1) {
      const remaining = Array.from(activePointers.values())[0];
      dragStart = { x:remaining.x, y:remaining.y, tx:mapTx, ty:mapTy };
    } else {
      dragStart = null;
    }
  }

  mapWrap?.addEventListener('pointerup', endPointer);
  mapWrap?.addEventListener('pointercancel', endPointer);

  function touchPoint(touch){
    return { x:touch.clientX, y:touch.clientY };
  }

  function touchDistance(touches){
    const a = touches[0];
    const b = touches[1];
    return Math.hypot(a.clientX - b.clientX, a.clientY - b.clientY);
  }

  function touchCenter(touches){
    const a = touches[0];
    const b = touches[1];
    return {
      x:(a.clientX + b.clientX) / 2,
      y:(a.clientY + b.clientY) / 2,
    };
  }

  function beginTouchGesture(event){
    if (event.target.closest('.domain-marker, .npc-marker, .map-back-btn, .npc-dialogue')) return;

    if (event.touches.length === 1) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const p = touchPoint(event.touches[0]);
      touchGesture = { mode:'pan', x:p.x, y:p.y, tx:mapTx, ty:mapTy };
      return;
    }

    if (event.touches.length >= 2) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const center = touchCenter(event.touches);
      touchGesture = {
        mode:'pinch',
        distance:Math.max(1, touchDistance(event.touches)),
        center,
        scale:mapScale,
        tx:mapTx,
        ty:mapTy,
      };
    }
  }

  function moveTouchGesture(event){
    if (!touchGesture) return;

    if (event.touches.length >= 2) {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (touchGesture.mode !== 'pinch') {
        const center = touchCenter(event.touches);
        touchGesture = {
          mode:'pinch',
          distance:Math.max(1, touchDistance(event.touches)),
          center,
          scale:mapScale,
          tx:mapTx,
          ty:mapTy,
        };
      }

      const rect = wrapRect || mapWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = touchCenter(event.touches);
      const oldScale = touchGesture.scale;
      const nextScale = Math.max(
        mapMinScale,
        Math.min(mapMinScale * 4.5, oldScale * (Math.max(1, touchDistance(event.touches)) / touchGesture.distance))
      );
      const anchorX = touchGesture.center.x - rect.left;
      const anchorY = touchGesture.center.y - rect.top;
      const mapX = (anchorX - touchGesture.tx) / oldScale;
      const mapY = (anchorY - touchGesture.ty) / oldScale;

      mapScale = nextScale;
      mapTx = (center.x - rect.left) - mapX * mapScale;
      mapTy = (center.y - rect.top) - mapY * mapScale;
      clampMap();
      scheduleMapTransform();
      return;
    }

    if (event.touches.length === 1 && touchGesture.mode === 'pan') {
      event.preventDefault();
      const p = touchPoint(event.touches[0]);
      mapTx = touchGesture.tx + (p.x - touchGesture.x);
      mapTy = touchGesture.ty + (p.y - touchGesture.y);
      clampMap();
      scheduleMapTransform();
    }
  }

  function endTouchGesture(event){
    if (event.touches.length === 1) {
      const p = touchPoint(event.touches[0]);
      touchGesture = { mode:'pan', x:p.x, y:p.y, tx:mapTx, ty:mapTy };
      return;
    }
    if (event.touches.length === 0) {
      touchGesture = null;
    }
  }

  mapWrap?.addEventListener('touchstart', beginTouchGesture, { passive:false });
  mapWrap?.addEventListener('touchmove', moveTouchGesture, { passive:false });
  mapWrap?.addEventListener('touchend', endTouchGesture, { passive:false });
  mapWrap?.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => { touchGesture = null; }, { passive:false });

  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    setTopbarHeight();
    fitMapToScreen();
  });

  fitMapToScreen();
</script>


</body></html>

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 628;
  const refillAmt = 343;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return;
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>

        body: fd.toString()
    })

  });

<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){
  const drawer   = document.getElementById('sideDrawer');
  const fabOpen  = document.getElementById('nav_fab');       // 👈 bottom-left button
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('sideCloseBtn');  // ✕ inside drawer header
  const overlay  = document.getElementById('sideOverlay');   // dark backdrop on mobile

  if (!drawer) return;

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','true');
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','false');
  }

  if (fabOpen){
    fabOpen.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  }
  if (closeBtn){
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }
  if (overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }

  // ESC closes only on mobile view (doesn't really matter to check width though)
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();

function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-28";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>

// Guild announcement dismiss logic
(function(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('guildAnnouncementBar');
  const btn = document.getElementById('dismissGuildAnnouncementBtn');
  if (!bar || !btn) return;

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    const annId = bar.getAttribute('data-ann-id') || '0';

      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
      body: fd.toString(),
      cache: 'no-store'
    }).catch(()=>{});
  });
})();
