<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; 
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>

(function(){
  const bar   = document.getElementById('globalAnnouncementBar');
  const btn   = document.getElementById('dismissAnnouncementBtn');

        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body: fd.toString()
    })
    .then(r => r.json())

    })
    .catch(()=>{  });
  });
})();

<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){
  const drawer   = document.getElementById('sideDrawer');
  const fabOpen  = document.getElementById('nav_fab');       // 👈 bottom-left button
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('sideCloseBtn');  // ✕ inside drawer header
  const overlay  = document.getElementById('sideOverlay');   // dark backdrop on mobile

  if (!drawer) return;

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','true');
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','false');
  }

  if (fabOpen){
    fabOpen.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  }
  if (closeBtn){
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }
  if (overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }

  // ESC closes only on mobile view (doesn't really matter to check width though)
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();

function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-29";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>

// Guild announcement dismiss logic

  const btn = document.getElementById('dismissGuildAnnouncementBtn');

      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
      body: fd.toString(),
      cache: 'no-store'
    }).catch(()=>{});
  });
})();

function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str ?? '')
        .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
        .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
        .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
        .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
        .replaceAll("'", '&#039;');
}

function fmtNum(n) {
    if (n === null || n === undefined || n === '') return '0';
    const num = Number(n);
    if (Number.isNaN(num)) return String(n);
    return num.toLocaleString();
}

function formatCountdown(seconds) {
    seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
    const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = seconds % 60;
    return String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
}

function updateCountdowns() {
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    document.querySelectorAll('.countdown').forEach(el => {
        const readyTs = Number(el.getAttribute('data-ready-ts') || 0);
        if (!readyTs) {
            el.textContent = 'Recovering…';
            return;
        }
        const left = readyTs - now;
        if (left <= 0) {
            el.textContent = 'Heal Ready';
            el.classList.add('ready');
        } else {
            el.textContent = formatCountdown(left);
        }
    });
}
setInterval(updateCountdowns, 1000);
updateCountdowns();

function submitUnitAction(action, unitType, unitId, confirmText, extra = {}) {
    if (confirmText && !confirm(confirmText)) {
        return;
    }

    document.getElementById('formAction').value = action;
    document.getElementById('formUnitType').value = unitType;
    document.getElementById('formUnitId').value = unitId;
    document.getElementById('formItemInvId').value = '';
    document.getElementById('formScrollQty').value = extra.scrollQty ? String(extra.scrollQty) : '';
    document.getElementById('formSelectedSacrificeIds').value = Array.isArray(extra.selectedSacrificeIds)
        ? extra.selectedSacrificeIds.join(',')
        : '';

    document.getElementById('unitActionForm').submit();
}

function submitMonsterSoulUse(itemInvId, itemName, shadowName) {
    const targetName = shadowName || 'this special shadow';
    const labelName = itemName || 'this monster soul';

    if (!confirm(`Use ${labelName} to rise ${targetName}? This item will be consumed.`)) {
        return;
    }

    document.getElementById('formAction').value = 'use_monster_soul';
    document.getElementById('formUnitType').value = '';
    document.getElementById('formUnitId').value = '';
    document.getElementById('formSelectedSacrificeIds').value = '';
    document.getElementById('formItemInvId').value = String(itemInvId || 0);
    document.getElementById('formScrollQty').value = '';
    document.getElementById('unitActionForm').submit();
}
function confirmReleaseNormalShadow(unitId) {
    const unit = normalUnits[unitId];
    if (!unit) return;

    const label = unit.title || 'this normal shadow';

    if (!confirm(`Release ${label}? This will permanently delete this normal shadow and remove it from formation if it is currently assigned.`)) {
        return;
    }

    closeModal('unitModal');
    submitUnitAction('release_unit', 'normal', unitId, '');
}

function openScrollModal(type, unitId) {
    const unit = type === 'special' ? specialUnits[unitId] : normalUnits[unitId];
    if (!unit) return;
    if (Number(unit.level) >= Number(unit.max_level)) {
        alert(`${unit.title} is already at max level.`);
        return;
    }
    const scroll = type === 'special' ? captainShadowScroll : normalShadowScroll;
    if (scroll.count <= 0) {
        alert(`You do not have any ${scroll.name}.`);
        return;
    }

    const maxByScrolls = scroll.count;
    const bodyHtml = `
        <div class="info-stack">
            <div class="info-box">
                <h4>Train Target</h4>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Target</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.title)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Current Level</span><strong>Lv. ${fmtNum(unit.level)} / ${fmtNum(unit.max_level)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Scroll Type</span><strong>${escapeHtml(scroll.name)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Scrolls Owned</span><strong>${fmtNum(scroll.count)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>EXP Per Scroll</span><strong>${fmtNum(scroll.exp)}</strong></div>
            </div>
            <div class="info-box">
                <h4>Spend Scrolls</h4>
                <div class="modal-desc">Choose how many ${escapeHtml(scroll.name)}s to spend on this shadow. The EXP is applied instantly on this page.</div>
                <div class="field-stack">
                    <label for="scrollQtyInput">Scroll Quantity</label>
                    <input
                        id="scrollQtyInput"
                        class="qty-input"
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        max="${maxByScrolls}"
                        step="1"
                        value="1"
                    >
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="confirm-actions">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" onclick="closeModal('scrollModal')">Cancel</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-violet" onclick="confirmUseScrolls('${type}', ${unit.inv_id})">Use Scrolls</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('scrollModalTitle').textContent = `Train — ${unit.title}`;
    document.getElementById('scrollModalBody').innerHTML = bodyHtml;
    document.getElementById('scrollModal').classList.add('show');

    const input = document.getElementById('scrollQtyInput');
    if (input) {
        input.focus();
        input.select();
    }
}

function confirmUseScrolls(type, unitId) {
    const input = document.getElementById('scrollQtyInput');
    const qty = Math.max(1, Number(input ? input.value : 1) || 1);
    const scroll = type === 'special' ? captainShadowScroll : normalShadowScroll;
    if (qty > scroll.count) {
        alert(`You only have ${fmtNum(scroll.count)} ${scroll.name}(s).`);
        return;
    }

    const unit = type === 'special' ? specialUnits[unitId] : normalUnits[unitId];
    if (!unit) return;

    closeModal('scrollModal');
    closeModal('unitModal');
    submitUnitAction(
        'use_shadow_exp_scroll',
        type,
        unitId,
        `Use ${fmtNum(qty)} ${scroll.name}${qty === 1 ? '' : 's'} on ${unit.title} for ${fmtNum(qty * scroll.exp)} EXP?`,
        { scrollQty: qty }
    );
}

function refreshSacrificeSelectionState(requiredCount) {
    const checks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#sacrificeModal .sacrifice-check'));
    const selected = checks.filter(ch => ch.checked);

    if (selected.length >= requiredCount) {
        checks.forEach(ch => {
            if (!ch.checked) ch.disabled = true;
        });
    } else {
        checks.forEach(ch => {
            ch.disabled = false;
        });
    }

    const pickedText = document.getElementById('sacrificePickedText');
    if (pickedText) {
        pickedText.textContent = `${selected.length} / ${requiredCount} selected`;
    }

    const btn = document.getElementById('confirmSacrificeBtn');
    if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = (selected.length !== requiredCount);
    }
}

function confirmNormalSacrificeStarUp(unitId) {
    const unit = normalUnits[unitId];
    if (!unit) return;

    const selectedIds = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll('#sacrificeModal .sacrifice-check:checked')
    ).map(el => Number(el.value)).filter(Boolean);

    if (selectedIds.length !== Number(unit.copies_needed || 0)) {
        alert(`Select exactly ${unit.copies_needed} shadows.`);
        return;
    }

    closeModal('sacrificeModal');
    closeModal('unitModal');

    submitUnitAction(
        'star_up_unit',
        'normal',
        unitId,
        'Star up this normal shadow with the selected sacrifices?',
        { selectedSacrificeIds: selectedIds }
    );
}

function openNormalSacrificeModal(unitId) {
    const unit = normalUnits[unitId];
    if (!unit) return;

    if (!unit.can_star_up) {
        alert(`Not enough duplicates. Needed: ${unit.copies_needed}.`);
        return;
    }

    const needed = Number(unit.copies_needed || 0);
    const candidates = Array.isArray(unit.sacrifice_candidates)
        ? unit.sacrifice_candidates.slice()
        : [];

    candidates.sort((a, b) =>
        (Number(a.stars || 0) - Number(b.stars || 0)) ||
        (Number(a.level || 0) - Number(b.level || 0)) ||
        (Number(a.exp || 0) - Number(b.exp || 0)) ||
        (Number(a.inv_id || 0) - Number(b.inv_id || 0))
    );

    const cardsHtml = candidates.map(c => `
        <label class="sacrifice-option">
            <input
                type="checkbox"
                class="sacrifice-check"
                value="${Number(c.inv_id)}"
                onchange="refreshSacrificeSelectionState(${needed})"
            >
            <div class="sacrifice-option-card">
                <div class="sacrifice-mini">
                    <img src="${escapeHtml(c.image)}" alt="">
                    <div class="sacrifice-lines">
                        <strong>${escapeHtml(c.title)}</strong>
                        <span>Lv. ${fmtNum(c.level)} • ${escapeHtml(c.stars_text || '')}</span>
                        <span>EXP ${fmtNum(c.exp)} • HP ${fmtNum(c.current_health)}/${fmtNum(c.max_health)}</span>
                        <span>ATK ${fmtNum(c.attack)} • DEF ${fmtNum(c.defense)}${c.dead ? ' • Dead' : ''}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </label>
    `).join('');

    document.getElementById('sacrificeModalTitle').textContent = `Star Up — ${unit.title}`;
    document.getElementById('sacrificeModalBody').innerHTML = `
        <div class="sacrifice-help">
            Select exactly <strong>${needed}</strong> normal shadows to sacrifice.
            Nothing will be auto-selected, so high-level shadows will stay safe unless the player picks them.
        </div>

        <div class="sacrifice-picked" id="sacrificePickedText">0 / ${needed} selected</div>

        <div class="sacrifice-grid">
            ${cardsHtml}
        </div>

        <div class="confirm-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" onclick="closeModal('sacrificeModal')">Cancel</button>
            <button
                type="button"
                class="btn btn-gold"
                id="confirmSacrificeBtn"
                disabled
                onclick="confirmNormalSacrificeStarUp(${unit.inv_id})"
            >
                Confirm Star Up
            </button>
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('sacrificeModal').classList.add('show');
    refreshSacrificeSelectionState(needed);
}
function openUnitModal(type, id) {
    const unit = type === 'special' ? specialUnits[id] : normalUnits[id];
    if (!unit) return;

    let actionHtml = '';
    const healBlock = unit.heal_ready
        ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-success" onclick="submitUnitAction('heal_unit','${type}',${unit.inv_id},'Heal this unit now?')">Heal Unit</button>`
        : (unit.injured
            ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" disabled>${unit.dead ? 'Recovering' : 'On Cooldown'}</button>`
            : `<button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" disabled>Full Health</button>`);

    if (type === 'special') {
        actionHtml = `
            <div class="confirm-actions">
                <a href="shadow_army_formation.php" class="btn btn-violet">Go to Formation</a>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="btn btn-violet"
                    ${((captainShadowScroll.count > 0) && Number(unit.level) < Number(unit.max_level)) ? '' : 'disabled'}
                    onclick="openScrollModal('special',${unit.inv_id})"
                >
                    Use Scrolls
                </button>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="btn btn-gold"
                    ${unit.can_star_up ? '' : 'disabled'}
                    onclick="submitUnitAction('star_up_unit','special',${unit.inv_id},'Star up this special shadow?')"
                >
                    Star Up
                </button>
                ${healBlock}
            </div>
        `;
    } else {
       actionHtml = `
    <div class="confirm-actions">
        <button
            type="button"
            class="btn btn-violet"
            ${((normalShadowScroll.count > 0) && Number(unit.level) < Number(unit.max_level)) ? '' : 'disabled'}
            onclick="openScrollModal('normal',${unit.inv_id})"
        >
            Use Scrolls
        </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            class="btn btn-gold"
            ${unit.can_star_up ? '' : 'disabled'}
            onclick="openNormalSacrificeModal(${unit.inv_id})"
        >
            Star Up
        </button>
        ${healBlock}
        <button
            type="button"
            class="btn btn-danger"
            onclick="confirmReleaseNormalShadow(${unit.inv_id})"
        >
            Release
        </button>
    </div>
`;
    }

    let powerBox = '';
    if (type === 'special') {
        powerBox = `
            <div class="info-box">
                <h4>Shadow Power</h4>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Power</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.power_name || 'None')}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Rate</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.power_rate_display || '0')}</strong></div>
                <div class="modal-desc" style="margin-top:10px;">${escapeHtml(unit.power_desc || 'No power description.')}</div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    let starBox = '';
    if (type === 'special') {
        starBox = `
            <div class="info-box">
                <h4>Star Up</h4>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Current Stars</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.stars_text)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Extra Copies</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.extra_copies)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Needed for Next Star</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.copies_needed)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Attack</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_attack)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Defense</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_defense)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Max HP</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_max_hp)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Power Rate</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.preview_power_display)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Lead Capacity</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_lead_capacity)}</strong></div>
            </div>
        `;
    } else {
        starBox = `
            <div class="info-box">
                <h4>Star Up</h4>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Current Stars</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.stars_text)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Duplicate Units Available</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.copies_available)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Needed for Next Star</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.copies_needed)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Sacrifice Mode</span><strong>Manual Selection</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Attack</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_attack)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Defense</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_defense)}</strong></div>
                <div class="info-line"><span>Next Max HP</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.preview_max_hp)}</strong></div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    let statusText = unit.dead
        ? (unit.heal_ready ? 'Dead — ready to heal' : 'Dead — recovering')
        : (unit.injured
            ? (unit.heal_ready ? 'Injured — ready to heal' : 'Injured — on cooldown')
            : 'Healthy');

    let healInfo = '';
    if (unit.injured) {
        healInfo = `
            <div class="info-line">
                <span>Heal State</span>
                <strong>${unit.heal_ready ? 'Ready' : (unit.dead
                    ? '<span class="countdown" data-ready-ts="' + Number(unit.heal_ready_ts || 0) + '">Recovering…</span>'
                    : 'On Cooldown')}</strong>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    const bodyHtml = `
        <div class="unit-modal-layout">
            <div class="unit-modal-art">
                <img src="${escapeHtml(unit.image)}" alt="">
            </div>

            <div class="info-stack">
                <div class="info-box">
                    <h4>${escapeHtml(type === 'special' ? 'Special Shadow' : 'Normal Shadow')}</h4>
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Title</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.title)}</strong></div>
                    ${type === 'special' ? `<div class="info-line"><span>Rank</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.rank)}</strong></div>` : ''}
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Status</span><strong>${statusText}</strong></div>
                    ${healInfo}
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Level</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.level)} / ${fmtNum(unit.max_level)}</strong></div>
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Stars</span><strong>${escapeHtml(unit.stars_text)}</strong></div>
                    <div class="info-line"><span>EXP</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.exp)} / ${unit.exp_needed > 0 ? fmtNum(unit.exp_needed) : 'MAX'}</strong></div>
                    <div class="info-line"><span>HP</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.current_health)} / ${fmtNum(unit.max_health)}</strong></div>
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Attack</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.attack)}</strong></div>
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Defense</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.defense)}</strong></div>
                    ${type === 'special'
                        ? `<div class="info-line"><span>Lead Capacity</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.lead_capacity)}</strong></div>`
                        : ''
                    }
                    <div class="info-line"><span>Required Skill Level</span><strong>${fmtNum(unit.required_skill)}</strong></div>
                </div>

                ${powerBox}
                ${starBox}
                ${actionHtml}
            </div>
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('unitModalTitle').textContent = unit.title || 'Unit';
    document.getElementById('unitModalBody').innerHTML = bodyHtml;
    document.getElementById('unitModal').classList.add('show');
    updateCountdowns();
}

function closeModal(id) {
    document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
}

document.querySelectorAll('.modal').forEach(modal => {
    modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === modal) modal.classList.remove('show');
    });
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('show'));
    }
});
