const battlefieldFx = {
    canvas: null,
    ctx: null,
    width: 0,
    height: 0,
    dpr: 1,
    stars: [],
    ready: false,
    resizeObserver: null,
    rafId: 0
};

function resizeBattlefieldFx(){
    if (!battlefieldFx.canvas) return;
    const rect = battlefieldFx.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width));
    const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height));
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    if (battlefieldFx.canvas.width !== Math.round(width * dpr) || battlefieldFx.canvas.height !== Math.round(height * dpr)) {
        battlefieldFx.canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
        battlefieldFx.canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
    }

    battlefieldFx.width = width;
    battlefieldFx.height = height;
    battlefieldFx.dpr = dpr;
}

function drawBattlefieldFx(timestamp){
    if (!battlefieldFx.ready || !battlefieldFx.ctx) return;

    const ctx = battlefieldFx.ctx;
    const width = battlefieldFx.width;
    const height = battlefieldFx.height;
    const dpr = battlefieldFx.dpr;

    if (!width || !height) {
        resizeBattlefieldFx();
        battlefieldFx.rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawBattlefieldFx);
        return;
    }

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#04050b';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const fog1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.74, height * 0.12, 0, width * 0.74, height * 0.12, width * 0.38);
    fog1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(124,58,237,0.11)');
    fog1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(124,58,237,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = fog1;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const fog2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.18, height * 0.24, 0, width * 0.18, height * 0.24, width * 0.28);
    fog2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(52,211,153,0.08)');
    fog2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(52,211,153,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = fog2;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const floorGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.5, height * 0.74, 0, width * 0.5, height * 0.74, width * 0.48);
    floorGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(150,188,255,0.12)');
    floorGlow.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(150,188,255,0.04)');
    floorGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150,188,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = floorGlow;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    battlefieldFx.stars.forEach((star, index) => {
        const twinkle = 0.18 + 0.22 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin((timestamp * 0.0012 * star.drift) + star.phase + index));
        ctx.globalAlpha = twinkle;
        ctx.fillStyle = star.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(star.x * width, star.y * height, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    const gridSize = 96;
    const gridOffsetX = (timestamp * 0.01) % gridSize;
    const gridOffsetY = (timestamp * 0.006) % gridSize;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.024)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = -gridSize; x < width + gridSize; x += gridSize) {
        ctx.moveTo(x + gridOffsetX, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(x + gridOffsetX, height);
    }
    for (let y = -gridSize; y < height + gridSize; y += gridSize) {
        ctx.moveTo(0, y + gridOffsetY);
        ctx.lineTo(width, y + gridOffsetY);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(width * 0.5, height * 0.60);
    ctx.rotate(-0.04);
    [1, 0.72, 0.46].forEach((scale, index) => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, width * 0.24 * scale, height * 0.10 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = index === 0 ? 'rgba(196,181,253,0.10)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
        ctx.lineWidth = index === 0 ? 1.4 : 1;
        ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.restore();

    const vignette = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.5, height * 0.48, Math.min(width, height) * 0.12, width * 0.5, height * 0.48, Math.max(width, height) * 0.82);
    vignette.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vignette.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vignette;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    battlefieldFx.rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawBattlefieldFx);
}

function initBattlefieldFx(){
    if (battlefieldFx.ready) return;
    const canvas = document.getElementById('battlefieldCanvas');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });
    if (!ctx) return;

    battlefieldFx.canvas = canvas;
    battlefieldFx.ctx = ctx;
    battlefieldFx.stars = Array.from({ length: 170 }, () => ({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random() * 0.78,
        size: Math.random() * 1.7 + 0.35,
        drift: Math.random() * 0.8 + 0.35,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        color: Math.random() > 0.58 ? 'rgba(167,139,250,0.82)' : 'rgba(134,239,172,0.82)'
    }));
    battlefieldFx.ready = true;
    resizeBattlefieldFx();

    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
        battlefieldFx.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => resizeBattlefieldFx());
        battlefieldFx.resizeObserver.observe(canvas);
    } else {
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeBattlefieldFx);
    }

    battlefieldFx.rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawBattlefieldFx);
}

function showToast(message){
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = message;
    toast.classList.add('show');
    window.clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2400);
}

async function postAction(action, extra = {}){
    const body = new URLSearchParams({ action, csrf: "", ...extra });
    const res = await fetch('shadow_army_live_battle.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
        body: body.toString()
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || 'Action failed.');
    }
    return data;
}

function sortCaptains(list){
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.side !== b.side) return a.side.localeCompare(b.side);
        if (a.owner_name !== b.owner_name) return a.owner_name.localeCompare(b.owner_name);
        if (a.slot_index !== b.slot_index) return a.slot_index - b.slot_index;
        return a.id - b.id;
    });
}

function getLivingEnemyCaptains(){
    if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.captains)) return [];
    return sortCaptains(state.captains.filter(captain => captain.side === 'ENEMY' && !captain.is_dead));
}

function getEnemyPageMeta(){
    const enemies = getLivingEnemyCaptains();
    const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(enemies.length / ENEMY_PAGE_SIZE));
    enemyPageIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(pageCount - 1, enemyPageIndex));
    const startIndex = enemyPageIndex * ENEMY_PAGE_SIZE;
    const pageEnemies = enemies.slice(startIndex, startIndex + ENEMY_PAGE_SIZE);

    return {
        enemies,
        pageEnemies,
        pageCount,
        pageIndex: enemyPageIndex,
        start: enemies.length > 0 ? startIndex + 1 : 0,
        end: startIndex + pageEnemies.length,
        total: enemies.length
    };
}

function setEnemyPage(nextPageIndex){
    const meta = getEnemyPageMeta();
    enemyPageIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(meta.pageCount - 1, Number(nextPageIndex) || 0));
    render();
}

function getVisibleArenaData(){
    if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.captains)) {
        return { captains: [], engagements: [] };
    }

    const allCaptains = state.captains;
    const allEngagements = Array.isArray(state.engagements) ? state.engagements : [];
    const captainMap = new Map(allCaptains.map(captain => [Number(captain.id), captain]));
    const pageMeta = getEnemyPageMeta();
    const visibleEnemyIds = new Set(pageMeta.pageEnemies.map(captain => Number(captain.id)));
    const ownedAllyIds = new Set(
        allCaptains
            .filter(captain => captain.side === 'ALLY' && captain.is_mine && !captain.is_dead)
            .map(captain => Number(captain.id))
    );

    allEngagements.forEach(engagement => {
        const attackerId = Number(engagement.attacker_captain_unit_id || 0);
        const defenderId = Number(engagement.defender_captain_unit_id || 0);
        const attacker = captainMap.get(attackerId);
        const defender = captainMap.get(defenderId);

        if (ownedAllyIds.has(attackerId) && defender && defender.side === 'ENEMY' && !defender.is_dead) {
            visibleEnemyIds.add(defenderId);
        }
        if (ownedAllyIds.has(defenderId) && attacker && attacker.side === 'ENEMY' && !attacker.is_dead) {
            visibleEnemyIds.add(attackerId);
        }
    });

    [selectedCaptainId, detailCaptainId].forEach(captainId => {
        const captain = captainMap.get(Number(captainId || 0));
        if (captain && captain.side === 'ENEMY' && !captain.is_dead) {
            visibleEnemyIds.add(Number(captain.id));
        }
    });

    const contextualAllyIds = new Set();
    allEngagements.forEach(engagement => {
        const attackerId = Number(engagement.attacker_captain_unit_id || 0);
        const defenderId = Number(engagement.defender_captain_unit_id || 0);
        const attacker = captainMap.get(attackerId);
        const defender = captainMap.get(defenderId);

        if (visibleEnemyIds.has(defenderId) && attacker && attacker.side === 'ALLY' && !attacker.is_dead) {
            contextualAllyIds.add(attackerId);
        }
        if (visibleEnemyIds.has(attackerId) && defender && defender.side === 'ALLY' && !defender.is_dead) {
            contextualAllyIds.add(defenderId);
        }
    });

    const additionalAllies = sortCaptains(
        allCaptains.filter(captain => (
            captain.side === 'ALLY'
            && !captain.is_dead
            && !ownedAllyIds.has(Number(captain.id))
            && contextualAllyIds.has(Number(captain.id))
        ))
    ).slice(0, MAX_CONTEXT_ALLIES);
    const visibleAllyIds = new Set([...ownedAllyIds, ...additionalAllies.map(captain => Number(captain.id))]);

    [selectedCaptainId, detailCaptainId].forEach(captainId => {
        const captain = captainMap.get(Number(captainId || 0));
        if (captain && captain.side === 'ALLY') {
            visibleAllyIds.add(Number(captain.id));
        }
    });

    const visibleIds = new Set([...visibleEnemyIds, ...visibleAllyIds]);
    const captains = allCaptains.filter(captain => visibleIds.has(Number(captain.id)));
    const engagements = allEngagements.filter(engagement => (
        visibleIds.has(Number(engagement.attacker_captain_unit_id || 0))
        && visibleIds.has(Number(engagement.defender_captain_unit_id || 0))
    ));

    return { captains, engagements };
}

function escapeHtml(value){
    return String(value ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

function getCaptainById(id){
    if (!state || !state.captains) return null;
    return state.captains.find(c => Number(c.id) === Number(id)) || null;
}

function getOwnedAttackableCaptains(){
    if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.captains)) return [];
    return state.captains.filter(captain => (
        captain.side === 'ALLY'
        && captain.is_mine
        && !captain.is_dead
        && !captain.retreat_requested
    ));
}

function getDefaultAttackCaptain(){
    const selected = getCaptainById(selectedCaptainId);
    if (
        selected
        && selected.side === 'ALLY'
        && selected.is_mine
        && !selected.is_dead
        && !selected.retreat_requested
    ) {
        return selected;
    }

    const owned = getOwnedAttackableCaptains();
    if (owned.length === 1) {
        return owned[0];
    }

    return null;
}

function getCaptainEngagement(captainId){
    if (!state || !state.engagements) return null;
    return state.engagements.find(eng => Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id) === Number(captainId)) || null;
}

function clearDetailState(){
    detailState = null;
    detailLoading = false;
    detailLoadedAt = 0;
}

function clearFeedState(){
    feedState = null;
    feedSummary = null;
    feedLoading = false;
    feedLoadedAt = 0;
}

function getCurrentDetailData(){
    if (!detailState || Number(detailState.captain_id) !== Number(detailCaptainId)) {
        return null;
    }
    return detailState;
}

function getCurrentFeedData(){
    return Array.isArray(feedState) ? feedState : null;
}

async function loadCaptainDetail(captainId, options = {}){
    if (!hasBattle || !captainId) return;
    const silent = !!options.silent;
    const preserveExisting = !!options.preserveExisting;
    const fetchNonce = ++detailFetchNonce;

    detailLoading = true;
    if (!preserveExisting) {
        detailState = null;
    }
    if (!silent) {
        renderDetailPanel();
    }

    try {
        const data = await postAction('get_captain_detail', {
            battle_id: String(battleId),
            captain_unit_id: String(captainId)
        });
        if (fetchNonce !== detailFetchNonce || Number(detailCaptainId) !== Number(captainId)) {
            return;
        }
        detailState = data.detail || null;
        detailLoadedAt = Date.now();
        renderDetailPanel();
    } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) {
            showToast(err.message || 'Could not load captain detail.');
            renderDetailPanel();
        }
    } finally {
        if (fetchNonce === detailFetchNonce) {
            detailLoading = false;
        }
    }
}

async function loadBattleFeed(options = {}){
    if (!hasBattle) return;
    const silent = !!options.silent;
    const preserveExisting = !!options.preserveExisting;
    const fetchNonce = ++feedFetchNonce;

    feedLoading = true;
    if (!preserveExisting) {
        feedState = null;
    }
    if (!silent) {
        renderDetailPanel();
    }

    try {
        const data = await postAction('get_attackers', {
            battle_id: String(battleId),
            limit: '120'
        });
        if (fetchNonce !== feedFetchNonce || panelMode !== 'feed') {
            return;
        }
        const board = data.board || {};
        feedState = Array.isArray(board.attackers) ? board.attackers : [];
        feedSummary = {
            participant_count: Number(board.participant_count || 0),
            total_damage: Number(board.total_damage || 0),
            total_kills: Number(board.total_kills || 0)
        };
        feedLoadedAt = Date.now();
        renderDetailPanel();
    } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) {
            showToast(err.message || 'Could not load attacker board.');
            renderDetailPanel();
        }
    } finally {
        if (fetchNonce === feedFetchNonce) {
            feedLoading = false;
        }
    }
}

function openBattleFeed(){
    panelMode = 'feed';
    detailCaptainId = null;
    renderDetailPanel();
    void loadBattleFeed({
        silent: !!getCurrentFeedData(),
        preserveExisting: !!getCurrentFeedData()
    });
}

function openEnemyForces(){
    panelMode = 'enemies';
    detailCaptainId = null;
    clearDetailState();
    renderDetailPanel();
}

function isCaptainEngaged(captainId){
    if (!state || !state.engagements) return false;
    return state.engagements.some(eng =>
        Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id) === Number(captainId)
        || Number(eng.defender_captain_unit_id) === Number(captainId)
    );
}

function buildBasePositions(captains){
    const positions = new Map();
    const maxPerRow = 4;
    const sidePaddingX = 12;

    function placeCaptainsInGrid(list, options){
        const {
            startY,
            rowStep,
            fromBottom = false,
        } = options;

        list.forEach((captain, index) => {
            const rowIndex = Math.floor(index / maxPerRow);
            const columnIndex = index % maxPerRow;
            const rowCaptains = list.slice(rowIndex * maxPerRow, (rowIndex * maxPerRow) + maxPerRow);
            const rowCount = rowCaptains.length;
            const usableWidth = 100 - (sidePaddingX * 2);
            const x = sidePaddingX + (((columnIndex + 0.5) / rowCount) * usableWidth);
            const y = fromBottom ? (startY - (rowIndex * rowStep)) : (startY + (rowIndex * rowStep));
            positions.set(captain.id, { x, y });
        });
    }

    const enemy = sortCaptains(captains.filter(c => c.side === 'ENEMY'));
    const allyMine = sortCaptains(captains.filter(c => c.side === 'ALLY' && c.is_mine));
    const allyOthers = sortCaptains(captains.filter(c => c.side === 'ALLY' && !c.is_mine));

    placeCaptainsInGrid(enemy, {
        startY: 20,
        rowStep: 12,
        fromBottom: false,
    });

    placeCaptainsInGrid(allyMine, {
        startY: 84,
        rowStep: 7,
        fromBottom: true,
    });

    placeCaptainsInGrid(allyOthers, {
        startY: 72,
        rowStep: 6,
        fromBottom: true,
    });

    return positions;
}

function clampArenaPosition(x, y){
    return {
        x: Math.max(8, Math.min(92, x)),
        y: Math.max(14, Math.min(86, y))
    };
}

function percentPositionToPixels(position, arenaRect){
    return {
        x: (position.x / 100) * arenaRect.width,
        y: (position.y / 100) * arenaRect.height
    };
}

function pixelPositionToPercent(position, arenaRect){
    return clampArenaPosition(
        arenaRect.width > 0 ? (position.x / arenaRect.width) * 100 : 50,
        arenaRect.height > 0 ? (position.y / arenaRect.height) * 100 : 50
    );
}

function clampArenaPixelPosition(x, y, arenaRect, radius){
    const paddingX = radius + 10;
    const paddingY = radius + 10;
    return {
        x: Math.max(paddingX, Math.min(Math.max(paddingX, arenaRect.width - paddingX), x)),
        y: Math.max(paddingY, Math.min(Math.max(paddingY, arenaRect.height - paddingY), y))
    };
}

function getCaptainRenderRadius(captain){
    if (!captain) return 34;
    if (captain.side === 'ALLY' && !captain.is_mine) return 24;
    return captain.side === 'ENEMY' ? 40 : 38;
}

function applyEngagementOffsets(basePositions, engagements, captainMap, arenaRect){
    const finalPositions = new Map();
    for (const [id, pos] of basePositions.entries()) {
        finalPositions.set(id, { ...pos });
    }

    const grouped = {};
    const outgoingByAttacker = {};
    (engagements || []).forEach(eng => {
        const attackerId = Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id);
        const defId = Number(eng.defender_captain_unit_id);
        grouped[defId] = grouped[defId] || [];
        grouped[defId].push(eng);
        outgoingByAttacker[attackerId] = outgoingByAttacker[attackerId] || [];
        outgoingByAttacker[attackerId].push(eng);
    });

    const groupedEntries = Object.keys(grouped)
        .map(defIdKey => [Number(defIdKey), grouped[Number(defIdKey)]])
        .sort((left, right) => {
            const leftCaptain = captainMap.get(left[0]);
            const rightCaptain = captainMap.get(right[0]);
            const leftPriority = leftCaptain && leftCaptain.side === 'ENEMY' ? 0 : 1;
            const rightPriority = rightCaptain && rightCaptain.side === 'ENEMY' ? 0 : 1;
            if (leftPriority !== rightPriority) {
                return leftPriority - rightPriority;
            }
            return left[0] - right[0];
        });

    for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass += 1) {
        groupedEntries.forEach(([defId, defenderEngagements]) => {
            const defenderPos = finalPositions.get(defId) || basePositions.get(defId);
            if (!defenderPos) return;
            const defenderCaptain = captainMap.get(defId);
            const defenderRadius = getCaptainRenderRadius(defenderCaptain);
            const defenderPixels = percentPositionToPixels(defenderPos, arenaRect);

            const orderedAttackers = defenderEngagements.slice().sort((left, right) => {
                const leftId = Number(left.attacker_captain_unit_id || 0);
                const rightId = Number(right.attacker_captain_unit_id || 0);
                const leftPos = finalPositions.get(leftId) || basePositions.get(leftId);
                const rightPos = finalPositions.get(rightId) || basePositions.get(rightId);
                return (leftPos?.x || 0) - (rightPos?.x || 0);
            });

            orderedAttackers.forEach((eng, index) => {
                const attackerId = Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id);
                const attackerBase = basePositions.get(attackerId);
                if (!attackerBase) return;
                const attackerCaptain = captainMap.get(attackerId);
                const attackerRadius = getCaptainRenderRadius(attackerCaptain);
                const attackerPos = finalPositions.get(attackerId) || attackerBase;

                const total = orderedAttackers.length;
                const defenderOutgoing = outgoingByAttacker[defId] || [];
                let centerAngle;
                let arcSpread;

                if ((defenderCaptain?.side || '') === 'ALLY' && defenderOutgoing.length > 0) {
                    const primaryOutgoing = defenderOutgoing[0];
                    const primaryTargetId = Number(primaryOutgoing.defender_captain_unit_id || 0);
                    const primaryTargetPos = finalPositions.get(primaryTargetId) || basePositions.get(primaryTargetId);
                    if (primaryTargetPos) {
                        const targetDx = primaryTargetPos.x - defenderPos.x;
                        const targetDy = primaryTargetPos.y - defenderPos.y;
                        centerAngle = Math.atan2(targetDy, targetDx) + Math.PI;
                        arcSpread = total === 1 ? 0 : Math.min(2.25, 0.88 + (0.48 * (total - 1)));
                    }
                }

                if (centerAngle === undefined) {
                    const attackerFromBelow = attackerPos.y >= defenderPos.y;
                    centerAngle = attackerFromBelow ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2;
                    arcSpread = total === 1 ? 0 : Math.min(1.34, 0.60 * (total - 1));
                }

                const angleOffset = total === 1 ? 0 : ((index / (total - 1)) - 0.5) * arcSpread;
                const orbitAngle = centerAngle + angleOffset;
                const orbitDistance = defenderRadius + attackerRadius + (total === 1 ? 4 : 10);
                const targetPixels = clampArenaPixelPosition(
                    defenderPixels.x + (Math.cos(orbitAngle) * orbitDistance),
                    defenderPixels.y + (Math.sin(orbitAngle) * orbitDistance),
                    arenaRect,
                    attackerRadius
                );
                finalPositions.set(attackerId, pixelPositionToPercent(targetPixels, arenaRect));
            });
        });
    }

    return finalPositions;
}

function ensureArenaLayers(){
    const arena = document.getElementById('arena');
    if (!arena) return null;

    let linesLayer = arena.querySelector('[data-layer="lines"]');
    if (!linesLayer) {
        linesLayer = document.createElement('div');
        linesLayer.dataset.layer = 'lines';
        linesLayer.style.position = 'absolute';
        linesLayer.style.inset = '0';
        linesLayer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        arena.appendChild(linesLayer);
    }

    let unitsLayer = arena.querySelector('[data-layer="units"]');
    if (!unitsLayer) {
        unitsLayer = document.createElement('div');
        unitsLayer.dataset.layer = 'units';
        unitsLayer.style.position = 'absolute';
        unitsLayer.style.inset = '0';
        arena.appendChild(unitsLayer);
    }

    let uiLayer = arena.querySelector('[data-layer="ui"]');
    if (!uiLayer) {
        uiLayer = document.createElement('div');
        uiLayer.dataset.layer = 'ui';
        uiLayer.style.position = 'absolute';
        uiLayer.style.inset = '0';
        uiLayer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        arena.appendChild(uiLayer);
    }

    return { arena, linesLayer, unitsLayer, uiLayer };
}

function createCaptainNode(captainId){
    const node = document.createElement('button');
    node.type = 'button';
    node.className = 'captain';
    node.dataset.captainId = String(captainId);
    node.innerHTML = `
        <span class="captain-core">
            <span class="captain-shockwave-burst"></span>
            <span class="captain-shadow-swarm"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></span>
            <span class="captain-ring">
                <span class="captain-shell">
                    <span class="captain-face"></span>
                    <span class="captain-fallback"></span>
                    <span class="captain-glow"></span>
                    <span class="captain-skill-slash"></span>
                </span>
            </span>
        </span>
    `;
    node.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => handleCaptainPointerDown(event, Number(node.dataset.captainId || 0)));
    node.addEventListener('click', () => handleCaptainClick(Number(node.dataset.captainId || 0)));
    captainNodeMap.set(Number(captainId), node);
    return node;
}

function renderArena(){
    const layers = ensureArenaLayers();
    if (!layers || !state) return;

    const { arena, linesLayer, unitsLayer } = layers;
    const arenaData = getVisibleArenaData();
    const captains = arenaData.captains;
    const engagements = arenaData.engagements;
    const captainMap = new Map(captains.map(captain => [Number(captain.id), captain]));
    const arenaRect = arena.getBoundingClientRect();
    const basePositions = buildBasePositions(captains);
    const finalPositions = applyEngagementOffsets(basePositions, engagements, captainMap, arenaRect);
    const engagedCaptainIds = new Set();

    engagements.forEach(eng => {
        engagedCaptainIds.add(Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id));
        engagedCaptainIds.add(Number(eng.defender_captain_unit_id));
    });
    latestCaptainPositions = new Map(finalPositions);

    const engagementHtml = engagements.map(eng => {
        const from = finalPositions.get(Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id));
        const to = finalPositions.get(Number(eng.defender_captain_unit_id));
        if (!from || !to) return '';
        const fromCaptain = captainMap.get(Number(eng.attacker_captain_unit_id));
        const toCaptain = captainMap.get(Number(eng.defender_captain_unit_id));
        const fromX = (from.x / 100) * arenaRect.width;
        const fromY = (from.y / 100) * arenaRect.height;
        const toX = (to.x / 100) * arenaRect.width;
        const toY = (to.y / 100) * arenaRect.height;
        const dx = toX - fromX;
        const dy = toY - fromY;
        const distance = Math.sqrt((dx * dx) + (dy * dy));
        if (distance <= 0.01) return '';
        const ux = dx / distance;
        const uy = dy / distance;
        const fromRadius = getCaptainRenderRadius(fromCaptain);
        const toRadius = getCaptainRenderRadius(toCaptain);
        const startX = fromX + (ux * fromRadius);
        const startY = fromY + (uy * fromRadius);
        const endX = toX - (ux * toRadius);
        const endY = toY - (uy * toRadius);
        const lineDx = endX - startX;
        const lineDy = endY - startY;
        const length = Math.sqrt((lineDx * lineDx) + (lineDy * lineDy));
        if (length <= 2) return '';
        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx) * 180 / Math.PI;
        const enemyTurn = Number(eng.turn_owner_unit_id) === Number(eng.defender_captain_unit_id);
        return `<div class="engagement-line ${enemyTurn ? 'enemy-turn' : ''}" style="left:${startX}px; top:${startY}px; width:${length}px; transform:rotate(${angle}deg);"></div>`;
    }).join('');
    linesLayer.innerHTML = engagementHtml;

    const seen = new Set();
    captains.forEach(captain => {
        const pos = finalPositions.get(Number(captain.id)) || { x: 50, y: 50 };
        const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, captain.squad_max_health > 0 ? (captain.squad_current_health / captain.squad_max_health) * 100 : 0));
        let node = captainNodeMap.get(Number(captain.id));
        const classes = [
            'captain',
            captain.side === 'ENEMY' ? 'enemy' : 'ally',
            captain.is_mine ? 'mine' : '',
            captain.side === 'ALLY' && !captain.is_mine ? 'small' : '',
            captain.side === 'ALLY' && !captain.is_mine ? 'shadow-particle' : '',
            engagedCaptainIds.has(Number(captain.id)) ? 'engaged' : '',
            captain.shield_value > 0 && captain.shield_hits_left > 0 ? 'shielded' : '',
            dragState && Number(dragState.hoverEnemyCaptainId) === Number(captain.id) ? 'drag-target' : '',
            node && node.classList.contains('skill-hit') ? 'skill-hit' : '',
            Number(selectedCaptainId) === Number(captain.id) ? 'selected' : '',
            captain.is_dead ? 'dead' : ''
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

        if (!node) {
            node = createCaptainNode(captain.id);
            unitsLayer.appendChild(node);
        }

        node.className = classes;
        node.dataset.captainId = String(captain.id);
        node.style.left = `${pos.x}%`;
        node.style.top = `${pos.y}%`;

        const face = node.querySelector('.captain-face');
        const fallback = node.querySelector('.captain-fallback');

        if (face) {
            face.style.backgroundImage = captain.image_src ? `url("${String(captain.image_src).replace(/"/g, '\\"')}")` : 'none';
        }
        if (fallback) {
            fallback.textContent = (captain.display_name || 'Captain').slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();
            fallback.style.display = captain.image_src ? 'none' : 'flex';
        }
        node.style.setProperty('--hp-angle', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(360, hpPct * 3.6))}deg`);

        seen.add(Number(captain.id));
    });

    for (const [captainId, node] of captainNodeMap.entries()) {
        if (seen.has(captainId)) continue;
        node.remove();
        captainNodeMap.delete(captainId);
    }
}

function getEnemyCaptainIdFromPoint(clientX, clientY){
    const element = document.elementFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const captainNode = element && element.closest ? element.closest('.captain') : null;
    if (!captainNode) return 0;
    const captainId = Number(captainNode.dataset.captainId || 0);
    const captain = getCaptainById(captainId);
    if (!captain || captain.side !== 'ENEMY' || captain.is_dead) {
        return 0;
    }
    return captainId;
}

function clearDragState(){
    dragState = null;
}

function handleCaptainPointerDown(event, captainId){
    const captain = getCaptainById(captainId);
    if (!captain || captain.side !== 'ALLY' || !captain.is_mine || captain.retreat_requested || captain.is_dead || !state || state.battle.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
        return;
    }
    if (event.button !== undefined && event.button !== 0) {
        return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    const captureNode = event.currentTarget && typeof event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture === 'function'
        ? event.currentTarget
        : null;
    if (captureNode) {
        try {
            captureNode.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        } catch (err) {
        }
    }

    dragState = {
        pointerId: event.pointerId,
        captureNode,
        captainId,
        startX: event.clientX,
        startY: event.clientY,
        currentX: event.clientX,
        currentY: event.clientY,
        active: false,
        hoverEnemyCaptainId: 0
    };
    selectedCaptainId = captainId;
    detailCaptainId = null;
    render();
}

function handleGlobalPointerMove(event){
    if (!dragState || dragState.pointerId !== event.pointerId) {
        return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();

    dragState.currentX = event.clientX;
    dragState.currentY = event.clientY;
    if (!dragState.active) {
        const moved = Math.hypot(event.clientX - dragState.startX, event.clientY - dragState.startY);
        if (moved >= 10) {
            dragState.active = true;
        }
    }

    if (dragState.active) {
        dragState.hoverEnemyCaptainId = getEnemyCaptainIdFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
        renderArena();
    }
    renderInteractionLayer();
}

function handleGlobalPointerUp(event){
    if (!dragState || dragState.pointerId !== event.pointerId) {
        return;
    }

    const releasedDrag = dragState;
    if (releasedDrag.captureNode && typeof releasedDrag.captureNode.releasePointerCapture === 'function') {
        try {
            releasedDrag.captureNode.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        } catch (err) {
        }
    }
    const enemyCaptainId = releasedDrag.active ? getEnemyCaptainIdFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY) : 0;
    clearDragState();
    suppressClickUntil = Date.now() + 220;
    renderArena();
    renderInteractionLayer();

    if (releasedDrag.active && enemyCaptainId > 0) {
        assignTarget(releasedDrag.captainId, enemyCaptainId);
    }
}

function renderInteractionLayer(){
    const layers = ensureArenaLayers();
    if (!layers) return;

    const { arena, uiLayer } = layers;
    uiLayer.innerHTML = '';
    const arenaRect = arena.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (state && Array.isArray(state.captains) && !(dragState && dragState.active)) {
        state.captains
            .filter(captain => (
                captain.is_mine
                && captain.side === 'ALLY'
                && isCaptainEngaged(captain.id)
                && !captain.retreat_requested
                && !captain.is_dead
                && Number(captain.id) !== Number(selectedCaptainId)
            ))
            .forEach(captain => {
                const pos = latestCaptainPositions.get(Number(captain.id));
                if (!pos) return;
                const retreatTop = Math.max(6, pos.y - 16);
                uiLayer.insertAdjacentHTML(
                    'beforeend',
                    `<div class="selection-actions" style="left:${pos.x}%; top:${retreatTop}%;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn retreat-action-btn" data-retreat-captain-id="${captain.id}">Retreat</button>
                    </div>`
                );
            });
    }

    if (selectedCaptainId) {
        const selectedCaptain = getCaptainById(selectedCaptainId);
        const selectedPos = latestCaptainPositions.get(Number(selectedCaptainId));
        if (selectedCaptain && selectedPos && !(dragState && dragState.active)) {
            const selectedIsMineEngaged = !!(selectedCaptain.is_mine && selectedCaptain.side === 'ALLY' && isCaptainEngaged(selectedCaptain.id) && !selectedCaptain.retreat_requested && !selectedCaptain.is_dead);
            const top = Math.max(10, selectedPos.y + (selectedIsMineEngaged ? -18 : -10));
            const actionButtons = selectedIsMineEngaged
                ? `<button type="button" class="btn retreat-action-btn" data-retreat-captain-id="${selectedCaptain.id}">Retreat</button>
                   <button type="button" class="btn selection-action-btn" data-selection-action="show-info">Show Info</button>`
                : `<button type="button" class="btn selection-action-btn" data-selection-action="show-info">Show Info</button>`;
            uiLayer.insertAdjacentHTML(
                'beforeend',
                `<div class="selection-actions" style="left:${selectedPos.x}%; top:${top}%;">
                    ${actionButtons}
                </div>`
            );
        }
    }

    if (dragState && dragState.active) {
        const attackerPos = latestCaptainPositions.get(Number(dragState.captainId));
        if (attackerPos) {
            const startCenter = percentPositionToPixels(attackerPos, arenaRect);
            const endX = Math.max(0, Math.min(arenaRect.width, dragState.currentX - arenaRect.left));
            const endY = Math.max(0, Math.min(arenaRect.height, dragState.currentY - arenaRect.top));
            const dx = endX - startCenter.x;
            const dy = endY - startCenter.y;
            const length = Math.sqrt((dx * dx) + (dy * dy));
            const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx) * 180 / Math.PI;
            const attackerCaptain = getCaptainById(dragState.captainId);
            const attackerRadius = getCaptainRenderRadius(attackerCaptain);
            const ux = length > 0.01 ? dx / length : 0;
            const uy = length > 0.01 ? dy / length : 0;
            const startX = startCenter.x + (ux * attackerRadius);
            const startY = startCenter.y + (uy * attackerRadius);
            const adjustedLength = Math.max(0, Math.sqrt(((endX - startX) * (endX - startX)) + ((endY - startY) * (endY - startY))));

            uiLayer.insertAdjacentHTML(
                'beforeend',
                `<div class="drag-line" style="left:${startX}px; top:${startY}px; width:${adjustedLength}px; transform:rotate(${angle}deg);"></div>
                 <div class="drag-cursor ${dragState.hoverEnemyCaptainId ? 'ready' : ''}" style="left:${endX}px; top:${endY}px;"></div>`
            );
        }
    }

    uiLayer.querySelector('[data-selection-action="show-info"]')?.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (!selectedCaptainId) return;
        panelMode = 'captain';
        detailCaptainId = selectedCaptainId;
        clearDetailState();
        renderDetailPanel();
        renderInteractionLayer();
        void loadCaptainDetail(detailCaptainId);
    });
    uiLayer.querySelectorAll('[data-retreat-captain-id]').forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', event => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            const captainId = Number(button.getAttribute('data-retreat-captain-id') || 0);
            if (captainId > 0) {
                retreatCaptain(captainId);
            }
        });
    });
}

function renderEffects(){
    if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.effects)) return;

    state.effects.forEach(effect => {
        const effectId = Number(effect.id || 0);
        if (effectId <= 0 || seenEffectIds.has(effectId)) {
            return;
        }
        seenEffectIds.add(effectId);

        if ((effect.effect_type || '') === 'skill_slash') {
            const targetNode = captainNodeMap.get(Number(effect.target_captain_unit_id));
            if (!targetNode) return;

            targetNode.classList.remove('skill-hit');
            void targetNode.offsetWidth;
            targetNode.classList.add('skill-hit');
            window.setTimeout(() => {
                targetNode.classList.remove('skill-hit');
            }, 860);
            return;
        }

        if ((effect.effect_type || '') === 'tyrant_shockwave') {
            const layers = ensureArenaLayers();
            const sourceNode = captainNodeMap.get(Number(effect.source_captain_unit_id));
            if (layers && sourceNode) {
                const arenaRect = layers.arena.getBoundingClientRect();
                const sourceRect = sourceNode.getBoundingClientRect();
                const wave = document.createElement('span');
                wave.className = `arena-shockwave${effect.empowered ? ' empowered' : ''}`;
                wave.style.left = `${(sourceRect.left - arenaRect.left) + (sourceRect.width / 2)}px`;
                wave.style.top = `${(sourceRect.top - arenaRect.top) + (sourceRect.height / 2)}px`;
                const waveSize = Math.max(320, Math.max(sourceRect.width, sourceRect.height) * (effect.empowered ? 4.8 : 4.2));
                wave.style.width = `${waveSize}px`;
                wave.style.height = `${waveSize}px`;
                layers.arena.appendChild(wave);
                window.setTimeout(() => wave.remove(), 1000);
            }

            const rawTargetIds = Array.isArray(effect.target_captain_unit_ids)
                ? effect.target_captain_unit_ids
                : [effect.target_captain_unit_id];
            rawTargetIds
                .map(value => Number(value || 0))
                .filter(value => value > 0)
                .forEach(targetCaptainId => {
                    const targetNode = captainNodeMap.get(targetCaptainId);
                    if (!targetNode) return;

                    targetNode.classList.remove('shockwave-hit');
                    void targetNode.offsetWidth;
                    targetNode.classList.add('shockwave-hit');
                    window.setTimeout(() => {
                        targetNode.classList.remove('shockwave-hit');
                    }, 920);
                });
        }
    });
}

function renderDetailPanel(){
    const panel = document.getElementById('detailPanel');
    const inner = document.getElementById('detailPanelInner');
    if (!panel || !inner) return;

    const captain = getCaptainById(detailCaptainId);
    if (!captain) {
        panel.classList.remove('open');
        inner.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }

    const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, captain.squad_max_health > 0 ? (captain.squad_current_health / captain.squad_max_health) * 100 : 0));
    const logs = (state.logs || []).slice(-8).map(log => `<div class="log-line">${log.CONTENT}</div>`).join('');
    const units = (captain.linked_units || []).map(unit => {
        const line = `${unit.current_health}/${unit.max_health} HP • ATK ${unit.attack} • DEF ${unit.defense}`;
        const bg = unit.image_src ? `style="background-image:url('${String(unit.image_src).replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"` : '';
        return `
            <div class="unit-row">
                <div class="unit-thumb" ${bg}></div>
                <div class="unit-meta">
                    <strong>${unit.display_name}</strong>
                    <small>${line}</small>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }).join('');

    inner.innerHTML = `
        <div class="side-title">
            <div>
                <h3>${captain.display_name}</h3>
                <div class="muted">${captain.owner_name || (captain.side === 'ENEMY' ? 'Enemy Captain' : 'Allied Captain')}</div>
            </div>
            <button class="btn" id="closeDetailBtn" type="button">Close</button>
        </div>
        <div class="status-pill">
            <span>Squad HP</span>
            <strong>${captain.squad_current_health}/${captain.squad_max_health}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="hpbar" style="position:relative;left:auto;right:auto;bottom:auto;height:10px;">
            <div class="hpfill" style="width:${hpPct}%;"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Squad Attack</span><strong>${captain.squad_attack}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Squad Defense</span><strong>${captain.squad_defense}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Captain HP</span><strong>${captain.captain_current_health}/${captain.captain_max_health}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Linked Shadows</span><strong>${captain.linked_alive_count}/${captain.linked_total_count}</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
            <span class="muted">Skill</span>
            <strong>${captain.power_name || 'None'}</strong>
            <div class="muted" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;">${captain.power_desc || 'This captain has no special battle skill yet.'}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Linked Shadows</div>
            <div class="unit-list">${units || '<div class="log-line">No linked shadows under this captain.</div>'}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Recent Battle Feed</div>
            <div class="battle-log">${logs || '<div class="log-line">No battle events yet.</div>'}</div>
        </div>
    `;

    panel.classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('closeDetailBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        detailCaptainId = null;
        renderDetailPanel();
    });
}

function renderDetailPanel(){
    const panel = document.getElementById('detailPanel');
    const inner = document.getElementById('detailPanelInner');
    if (!panel || !inner) return;

    const captain = getCaptainById(detailCaptainId);
    if (!captain) {
        panel.classList.remove('open');
        inner.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }

    const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, captain.squad_max_health > 0 ? (captain.squad_current_health / captain.squad_max_health) * 100 : 0));
    const canRetreat = !!(captain.is_mine && !captain.retreat_requested && isCaptainEngaged(captain.id) && state && state.battle && state.battle.status === 'ACTIVE');
    const shieldInfo = captain.shield_value > 0 && captain.shield_hits_left > 0
        ? `<div class="status-pill"><span>Shield</span><strong>${captain.shield_value} block left • ${captain.shield_hits_left} turn${captain.shield_hits_left === 1 ? '' : 's'}</strong></div>`
        : '';
    const logs = (state.logs || []).slice(-8).map(log => `<div class="log-line">${escapeHtml(log.CONTENT)}</div>`).join('');
    const units = (captain.linked_units || []).map(unit => {
        const line = `${unit.current_health}/${unit.max_health} HP - ATK ${unit.attack} - DEF ${unit.defense}`;
        const bg = unit.image_src ? `style="background-image:url('${String(unit.image_src).replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"` : '';
        return `
            <div class="unit-row">
                <div class="unit-thumb" ${bg}></div>
                <div class="unit-meta">
                    <strong>${escapeHtml(unit.display_name)}</strong>
                    <small>${escapeHtml(line)}</small>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }).join('');

    inner.innerHTML = `
        <div class="side-title">
            <div>
                <h3>${escapeHtml(captain.display_name)}</h3>
                <div class="muted">${escapeHtml(captain.owner_name || (captain.side === 'ENEMY' ? 'Enemy Captain' : 'Allied Captain'))}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="top-actions">
                ${canRetreat ? '<button class="btn primary" id="retreatCaptainBtn" type="button">Retreat</button>' : ''}
                <button class="btn" id="closeDetailBtn" type="button">Close</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="status-pill">
            <span>Squad HP</span>
            <strong>${captain.squad_current_health}/${captain.squad_max_health}</strong>
        </div>
        ${shieldInfo}
        <div class="hpbar" style="position:relative;left:auto;right:auto;bottom:auto;height:10px;">
            <div class="hpfill" style="width:${hpPct}%;"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Squad Attack</span><strong>${captain.squad_attack}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Squad Defense</span><strong>${captain.squad_defense}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Captain HP</span><strong>${captain.captain_current_health}/${captain.captain_max_health}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Linked Shadows</span><strong>${captain.linked_alive_count}/${captain.linked_total_count}</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
            <span class="muted">Skill</span>
            <strong>${escapeHtml(captain.power_name || 'None')}</strong>

        </div>

            <div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Recent Battle Feed</div>

    document.getElementById('closeDetailBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {

function renderDetailPanel(){
    const panel = document.getElementById('detailPanel');
    const inner = document.getElementById('detailPanelInner');
    if (!panel || !inner) return;

    if (panelMode === 'enemies') {
        const meta = getEnemyPageMeta();
        const attackCaptain = getDefaultAttackCaptain();
        const battleIsActive = !!(state && state.battle && state.battle.status === 'ACTIVE');
        const enemyRows = meta.pageEnemies.map(captain => {
            const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, captain.squad_max_health > 0 ? (captain.squad_current_health / captain.squad_max_health) * 100 : 0));
            const bg = captain.image_src ? `style="background-image:url('${String(captain.image_src).replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"` : '';
            const owner = captain.owner_name || 'Enemy force';
            const engaged = isCaptainEngaged(captain.id);
            return `
                <div class="enemy-force-row ${engaged ? 'engaged' : ''}">
                    <div class="enemy-force-thumb" ${bg}></div>
                    <div class="enemy-force-copy">
                        <strong>${escapeHtml(captain.display_name || 'Enemy Captain')}</strong>
                        <small>${escapeHtml(owner)}${engaged ? ' | Engaged' : ''}</small>
                        <div class="unit-health"><div class="unit-health-fill" style="width:${hpPct}%;"></div></div>
                        <small>${Number(captain.squad_current_health || 0).toLocaleString()} / ${Number(captain.squad_max_health || 0).toLocaleString()} squad HP</small>
                    </div>
                    <button class="btn primary enemy-force-target" type="button" data-enemy-target-id="${Number(captain.id)}" ${battleIsActive ? '' : 'disabled'}>Target</button>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join('');
        const attackerHint = attackCaptain
            ? `Targeting with ${escapeHtml(attackCaptain.display_name || 'your selected captain')}.`
            : 'Select one of your captains first if you command more than one.';

        inner.innerHTML = `
            <div class="side-title">
                <div>
                    <h3>Enemy Forces</h3>
                    <div class="muted">${meta.total.toLocaleString()} living enemy squad${meta.total === 1 ? '' : 's'}. ${attackerHint}</div>
                </div>
                <button class="btn" id="closeDetailBtn" type="button">Close</button>
            </div>
            <div class="enemy-browser-pager">
                <button class="btn" id="enemyBrowserPrevBtn" type="button" ${meta.pageIndex <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>Previous</button>
                <div class="status-pill"><strong>${meta.total > 0 ? `${meta.start}-${meta.end} of ${meta.total}` : 'No living enemies'}</strong></div>
                <button class="btn" id="enemyBrowserNextBtn" type="button" ${meta.pageIndex >= meta.pageCount - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}>Next</button>
            </div>
            <div class="enemy-force-list">${enemyRows || '<div class="log-line">No living enemy squads remain.</div>'}</div>
        `;

        panel.classList.add('open');
        document.getElementById('closeDetailBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
            panelMode = 'captain';
            renderDetailPanel();
        });
        document.getElementById('enemyBrowserPrevBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => setEnemyPage(meta.pageIndex - 1));
        document.getElementById('enemyBrowserNextBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => setEnemyPage(meta.pageIndex + 1));
        inner.querySelectorAll('[data-enemy-target-id]').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const attacker = getDefaultAttackCaptain();
                const enemyId = Number(button.dataset.enemyTargetId || 0);
                if (!attacker) {
                    showToast('Select one of your captains before choosing an enemy target.');
                    return;
                }
                if (enemyId > 0) {
                    void assignTarget(attacker.id, enemyId);
                }
            });
        });
        return;
    }

    if (panelMode === 'feed') {
        const feed = getCurrentFeedData();
        const summary = feedSummary || { participant_count: 0, total_damage: 0, total_kills: 0 };
        const feedRows = feed
            ? feed.map((item, index) => {
                const joinedAt = item.joined_at ? escapeHtml(String(item.joined_at).slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ')) : '-';
                const lastActionAt = item.last_action_at ? escapeHtml(String(item.last_action_at).slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ')) : '-';
                return `
                    <div class="log-line">
                        <strong style="display:block;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px;">#${index + 1} ${escapeHtml(item.username || `User #${item.user_id || 0}`)}</strong>
                        <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:rgba(237,243,255,0.92);margin-bottom:6px;">
                            <span>${Number(item.damage_dealt || 0).toLocaleString()} dmg</span>
                            <span>${Number(item.enemy_units_killed || 0).toLocaleString()} kills</span>
                        </div>
                        <small class="muted" style="display:block;">Joined: ${joinedAt}</small>
                        <small class="muted" style="display:block;">Last action: ${lastActionAt}</small>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('')
            : (feedLoading ? '<div class="log-line">Loading attacker board...</div>' : '<div class="log-line">Open this panel to load the attacker board for this fight.</div>');

        inner.innerHTML = `
            <div class="side-title">
                <div>
                    <h3>Attackers</h3>
                    <div class="muted">${Number(summary.participant_count || 0).toLocaleString()} members | ${Number(summary.total_damage || 0).toLocaleString()} total damage | ${Number(summary.total_kills || 0).toLocaleString()} enemy units killed.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="top-actions">
                    <button class="btn" id="closeDetailBtn" type="button">Close</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="battle-log">${feedRows || '<div class="log-line">No member contribution recorded yet.</div>'}</div>
        `;

        panel.classList.add('open');
        document.getElementById('closeDetailBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
            panelMode = 'captain';
            detailCaptainId = null;
            clearFeedState();
            renderDetailPanel();
        });
        return;
    }

    const captain = getCaptainById(detailCaptainId);
    if (!captain) {
        panel.classList.remove('open');
        inner.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }

    const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, captain.squad_max_health > 0 ? (captain.squad_current_health / captain.squad_max_health) * 100 : 0));
    const canRetreat = !!(captain.is_mine && isCaptainEngaged(captain.id) && state && state.battle && state.battle.status === 'ACTIVE');
    const detail = getCurrentDetailData();
    const shieldInfo = captain.shield_value > 0 && captain.shield_hits_left > 0
        ? `<div class="status-pill"><span>Shield</span><strong>${captain.shield_value} block left | ${captain.shield_hits_left} turn${captain.shield_hits_left === 1 ? '' : 's'}</strong></div>`
        : '';
    const retreatInfo = captain.retreat_requested
        ? `<div class="status-pill"><span>Retreat</span><strong>Queued for the next enemy hit</strong></div>`
        : '';
    const logs = detail
        ? (detail.logs || []).slice(-8).map(log => `<div class="log-line">${escapeHtml(log.CONTENT)}</div>`).join('')
        : (detailLoading ? '<div class="log-line">Loading recent battle feed...</div>' : '<div class="log-line">Open this panel to load recent battle feed.</div>');
    const units = detail
        ? (detail.linked_units || []).map(unit => {
            const hpLine = `${unit.current_health}/${unit.max_health} HP`;
            const statLine = `ATK ${unit.attack} | DEF ${unit.defense}`;
            const unitHpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, unit.max_health > 0 ? (unit.current_health / unit.max_health) * 100 : 0));
            const bg = unit.image_src ? `style="background-image:url('${String(unit.image_src).replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"` : '';
            return `
                <div class="unit-row ${unit.is_dead ? 'dead' : ''}">
                    <div class="unit-thumb" ${bg}></div>
                    <div class="unit-meta">
                        <strong>${escapeHtml(unit.display_name)}</strong>
                        <div class="unit-health"><div class="unit-health-fill" style="width:${unitHpPct}%;"></div></div>
                        <small>${escapeHtml(hpLine)} | ${escapeHtml(statLine)}${unit.is_dead ? ' | Defeated' : ''}</small>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }).join('')
        : (detailLoading ? '<div class="log-line">Loading linked shadows...</div>' : '<div class="log-line">Open this panel to load linked shadows.</div>');

    inner.innerHTML = `
        <div class="side-title">

            </div>
            <div class="top-actions">
                ${canRetreat ? '<button class="btn primary" id="retreatCaptainBtn" type="button">Retreat</button>' : ''}
                <button class="btn" id="closeDetailBtn" type="button">Close</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="status-pill">
            <span>Squad HP</span>
            <strong>${captain.squad_current_health}/${captain.squad_max_health}</strong>
        </div>
        ${shieldInfo}
        ${retreatInfo}
        <div class="hpbar" style="position:relative;left:auto;right:auto;bottom:auto;height:10px;">
            <div class="hpfill" style="width:${hpPct}%;"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Squad Attack</span><strong>${captain.squad_attack}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Squad Defense</span><strong>${captain.squad_defense}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Captain HP</span><strong>${captain.captain_current_health}/${captain.captain_max_health}</strong></div>
            <div class="stat"><span class="muted">Linked Shadows</span><strong>${captain.linked_alive_count}/${captain.linked_total_count}</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
            <span class="muted">Skill</span>
            <strong>${escapeHtml(captain.power_name || 'None')}</strong>
            <div class="muted" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;">${escapeHtml((detail && detail.power_desc) || 'This captain has no special battle skill yet.')}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Linked Shadows</div>
            <div class="unit-list">${units || '<div class="log-line">No linked shadows under this captain.</div>'}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Recent Battle Feed</div>

        </div>

    panel.classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('closeDetailBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        detailCaptainId = null;
        clearDetailState();
        renderDetailPanel();
    });
    document.getElementById('retreatCaptainBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => retreatCaptain(captain.id));
}

function updateEnemyPageControls(){
    const meta = getEnemyPageMeta();
    const controls = document.getElementById('enemyPageControls');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('enemyPagePrevBtn');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('enemyPageNextBtn');
    const labelBtn = document.getElementById('enemyPageLabelBtn');
    const forcesBtn = document.getElementById('enemyForcesBtn');

    if (forcesBtn) {
        forcesBtn.textContent = `Enemy Forces (${meta.total.toLocaleString()})`;
    }
    if (!controls || !prevBtn || !nextBtn || !labelBtn) return;

    controls.hidden = meta.total <= 0;
    prevBtn.disabled = meta.pageIndex <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = meta.pageIndex >= meta.pageCount - 1;
    labelBtn.textContent = meta.total > 0
        ? `Enemies ${meta.start}-${meta.end} / ${meta.total}`
        : 'No enemies';
}

function renderHeader(){
    if (!state) return;
    const statusText = document.getElementById('battleStatusText');
    const banner = document.getElementById('battleBanner');
    const joinBtn = document.getElementById('joinBattleBtn');
    if (statusText) statusText.textContent = state.battle.status;
    if (joinBtn) {
        joinBtn.style.display = state.viewer && state.viewer.can_join ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
    if (banner) {
        if (state.battle.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
            banner.textContent = `Battle Finished • Winner: ${state.battle.winner_side || 'UNKNOWN'}`;
        } else {
            const selected = getCaptainById(selectedCaptainId);
            banner.textContent = selected && selected.side === 'ALLY' && selected.is_mine
                ? `Selected ${selected.display_name}. Drag this captain onto an enemy to attack.`
                : 'Select a captain to inspect it, or drag one of your captains onto an enemy to attack.';
        }
    }
}

function renderHeader(){
    if (!state) return;
    const statusText = document.getElementById('battleStatusText');
    const banner = document.getElementById('battleBanner');
    const joinBtn = document.getElementById('joinBattleBtn');
    const enemyUnitsKilledText = document.getElementById('enemyUnitsKilledText');
    if (statusText) statusText.textContent = state.battle.status;
    if (joinBtn) {
        joinBtn.style.display = state.viewer && state.viewer.can_join ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
    if (enemyUnitsKilledText) {
        enemyUnitsKilledText.textContent = String((state.viewer && state.viewer.enemy_units_killed) || 0);
    }
    updateEnemyPageControls();
    if (banner) {
        if (state.battle.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
            banner.textContent = `Battle Finished | Winner: ${state.battle.winner_side || 'UNKNOWN'}`;
        } else {
            const selected = getCaptainById(selectedCaptainId);
            banner.textContent = selected && selected.side === 'ALLY' && selected.is_mine
                ? `Selected ${selected.display_name}. Drag this captain onto an enemy to attack.`
                : 'Select a captain to inspect it, or drag one of your captains onto an enemy to attack.';
        }
    }
}

function render(){
    renderHeader();
    renderArena();
    renderInteractionLayer();
    renderDetailPanel();
    renderEffects();
}

function getBattlePollIntervalMs(){
    const captainCount = state && Array.isArray(state.captains) ? state.captains.length : 0;
    const engagementCount = state && Array.isArray(state.engagements) ? state.engagements.length : 0;

    if (captainCount >= 120 || engagementCount >= 180) return 4500;
    if (captainCount >= 80 || engagementCount >= 120) return 3200;
    if (captainCount >= 40 || engagementCount >= 60) return 2200;
    return 1500;
}

function scheduleRefreshState(delayMs){
    if (!hasBattle) return;
    if (pollTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(pollTimer);
    }
    pollTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        pollTimer = 0;
        void refreshState();
    }, Math.max(600, Number(delayMs || 0)));
}

async function refreshState(){
    if (!hasBattle) return;
    if (pollBusy) {
        scheduleRefreshState(getBattlePollIntervalMs());
        return;
    }
    pollBusy = true;
    try {
        const data = await postAction('get_state', { battle_id: String(battleId) });
        state = data.state;
        if (selectedCaptainId && !getCaptainById(selectedCaptainId)) selectedCaptainId = null;
        if (detailCaptainId && !getCaptainById(detailCaptainId)) {
            detailCaptainId = null;
            clearDetailState();
        }
        render();
        if (
            detailCaptainId
            && !detailLoading
            && (
                !getCurrentDetailData()
                || (Date.now() - detailLoadedAt) >= 6000
            )
        ) {
            void loadCaptainDetail(detailCaptainId, {
                silent: !!getCurrentDetailData(),
                preserveExisting: !!getCurrentDetailData()
            });
        }
        if (
            panelMode === 'feed'
            && !feedLoading
            && (
                !getCurrentFeedData()
                || (Date.now() - feedLoadedAt) >= 6000
            )
        ) {
            void loadBattleFeed({
                silent: !!getCurrentFeedData(),
                preserveExisting: !!getCurrentFeedData()
            });
        }
    } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Failed to refresh battle.');
    } finally {
        pollBusy = false;
        scheduleRefreshState(getBattlePollIntervalMs());
    }
}

async function joinBattle(){
    try {
        const data = await postAction('join_battle', { battle_id: String(battleId) });
        state = data.state;
        clearDetailState();
        clearFeedState();
        showToast('Your army joined the battle.');
        render();
    } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Could not join battle.');
    }
}

async function assignTarget(attackerId, defenderId){
    try {
        const data = await postAction('assign_target', {
            battle_id: String(battleId),
            attacker_captain_unit_id: String(attackerId),
            defender_captain_unit_id: String(defenderId)
        });
        state = data.state;
        if (detailCaptainId) {
            clearDetailState();
        }
        render();
        if (data.message) {
            showToast(data.message);
        }
        if (detailCaptainId) {
            void loadCaptainDetail(detailCaptainId);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Could not assign target.');
    }
}

function handleCaptainClick(captainId){
    const clicked = getCaptainById(captainId);
    if (!clicked) return;

    const selected = getCaptainById(selectedCaptainId);
    if (clicked.side === 'ENEMY' && selected && selected.side === 'ALLY' && selected.is_mine && state && state.battle.status === 'ACTIVE') {
        assignTarget(selected.id, clicked.id);
        return;
    }

    if (Number(selectedCaptainId) === Number(clicked.id)) {
        detailCaptainId = Number(detailCaptainId) === Number(clicked.id) ? null : clicked.id;
    } else {
        selectedCaptainId = clicked.id;
        detailCaptainId = null;
    }
    clearDetailState();
    render();
    if (detailCaptainId) {
        void loadCaptainDetail(detailCaptainId);
    }
}

async function retreatCaptain(captainId){
    try {
        const data = await postAction('retreat_captain', {
            battle_id: String(battleId),
            captain_unit_id: String(captainId)
        });
        state = data.state;
        if (detailCaptainId) {
            clearDetailState();
        }
        showToast(data.message || 'Retreat updated.');
        render();
        if (detailCaptainId) {
            void loadCaptainDetail(detailCaptainId);
        }
    } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Could not retreat captain.');
    }
}

function clearEnemyClickTimers(){
    for (const timer of enemyClickTimers.values()) {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    enemyClickTimers.clear();
}

function handleEnemyDoubleClick(captainId){
    const clicked = getCaptainById(captainId);
    if (!clicked) return;
    selectedCaptainId = clicked.id;
    detailCaptainId = clicked.id;
    render();
}

function handleCaptainClick(captainId){
    const clicked = getCaptainById(captainId);
    if (!clicked) return;

    if (Date.now() < suppressClickUntil) {
        return;
    }

    if (clicked.side === 'ENEMY' && state && state.battle && state.battle.status === 'ACTIVE') {
        const attackCaptain = getDefaultAttackCaptain();
        if (attackCaptain) {
            panelMode = 'captain';
            selectedCaptainId = attackCaptain.id;
            detailCaptainId = null;
            clearDetailState();
            render();
            assignTarget(attackCaptain.id, clicked.id);
            return;
        }
    }

    panelMode = 'captain';
    selectedCaptainId = clicked.id;
    detailCaptainId = null;
    render();
}

function handleBattleWrapClick(event){
    if (Date.now() < suppressClickUntil) {
        return;
    }
    if (dragState) {
        return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('.captain') || event.target.closest('[data-selection-action]') || event.target.closest('[data-retreat-captain-id]') || event.target.closest('#detailPanel') || event.target.closest('#enemyPageControls')) {
        return;
    }
    if (!selectedCaptainId && !detailCaptainId) {
        return;
    }
    selectedCaptainId = null;
    detailCaptainId = null;
    panelMode = 'captain';
    render();
}

function isBattleFullscreenActive(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('battleWrap');
    if (!wrap) {
        return false;
    }
    return document.fullscreenElement === wrap
        || document.webkitFullscreenElement === wrap
        || wrap.classList.contains('pseudo-fullscreen');
}

function syncBattleFullscreenUi(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('battleWrap');
    const enterBtn = document.getElementById('fullscreenBattleBtn');
    if (!wrap || !enterBtn) {
        return;
    }
    const active = isBattleFullscreenActive();
    enterBtn.textContent = active ? 'Exit Full Screen' : 'Full Screen';
    if (!active) {
        wrap.classList.remove('pseudo-fullscreen');
        document.body.classList.remove('fullscreen-battle');
    }
}

async function toggleBattleFullscreen(forceExit = false){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('battleWrap');
    if (!wrap) {
        return;
    }

    const isNativeFullscreen = document.fullscreenElement === wrap || document.webkitFullscreenElement === wrap;
    const isPseudoFullscreen = wrap.classList.contains('pseudo-fullscreen');
    const active = isNativeFullscreen || isPseudoFullscreen;

    if (active || forceExit) {
        if (isNativeFullscreen) {
            if (document.exitFullscreen) {
                await document.exitFullscreen();
            } else if (document.webkitExitFullscreen) {
                document.webkitExitFullscreen();
            }
        } else {
            wrap.classList.remove('pseudo-fullscreen');
            document.body.classList.remove('fullscreen-battle');
        }
        syncBattleFullscreenUi();
        return;
    }

    if (wrap.requestFullscreen) {
        await wrap.requestFullscreen();
    } else if (wrap.webkitRequestFullscreen) {
        wrap.webkitRequestFullscreen();
    } else {
        wrap.classList.add('pseudo-fullscreen');
        document.body.classList.add('fullscreen-battle');
    }

    syncBattleFullscreenUi();
}

document.getElementById('createDemoBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
        const data = await postAction('create_demo_battle');
        window.location.href = data.redirect_url;
    } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || 'Could not create battle.');
    }
});

document.getElementById('joinBattleBtn')?.addEventListener('click', joinBattle);
document.getElementById('battleFeedBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {

        panelMode = 'captain';
        clearFeedState();
        renderDetailPanel();
        return;
    }
    openBattleFeed();
});

document.getElementById('enemyPageNextBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => setEnemyPage(enemyPageIndex + 1));

    toggleBattleFullscreen().catch(() => {
    });
});
document.getElementById('fullscreenExitBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {

    });
});
