let activeMatchNo = 0;
let busyMatches = new Set();
let contributorsMatchNo = 0;
let contributorsState = null;
let contributorsLoading = false;
let contributorsLoadedAt = 0;

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

function formatNumber(value) {
  const num = Number(value || 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '0';
  return num.toLocaleString();
}

function showToast(message) {
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  if (!toast) return;
  toast.textContent = message;
  toast.classList.add('show');
  window.clearTimeout(showToast._timer);
  showToast._timer = window.setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2800);
}

function statusLabel(status) {
  if (status === 'active') return 'Live';
  if (status === 'cleared') return 'Cleared';
  if (status === 'failed') return 'Failed';
  return 'Open';
}

function buildCaptainRow(captain) {
  const hpMax = Math.max(1, parseInt(captain.squad_max_health || 1, 10));
  const hpCur = Math.max(0, parseInt(captain.squad_current_health || 0, 10));
  const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((hpCur * 100) / hpMax)));
  const mini = `${captain.squad_attack || 0} ATK | ${captain.squad_defense || 0} DEF | ${captain.linked_total_count || 0} linked`;
  return `
    <div class="captain-row">
      <img src="${escapeHtml(captain.image_src || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp')}" alt="">
      <div class="captain-meta">
        <strong>${escapeHtml(captain.display_name || 'Captain')}</strong>
        <div class="mini">${escapeHtml(mini)}</div>
        <div class="hpbar"><div class="hpfill" style="width:${hpPct}%;"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="hpnum">${hpCur}/${hpMax}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function buildAttackersPreview(card) {
  const totalDamage = Number(card.total_damage || 0);
  const participantCount = Number(card.participant_count || 0);
  const totalKills = Number(card.total_kills || 0);
  const preview = Array.isArray(card.attackers_preview) ? card.attackers_preview : [];
  const rows = preview.length
    ? preview.map((entry) => `
        <div class="fight-contrib-row">
          <div>
            <strong>${escapeHtml(entry.username || `User #${entry.user_id || 0}`)}</strong>
            <small>${formatNumber(entry.enemy_units_killed || 0)} kills</small>
          </div>
          <div>${formatNumber(entry.damage_dealt || 0)} dmg</div>
        </div>
      `).join('')
    : '<div class="fight-contrib-empty">No guild member has dealt damage here yet.</div>';
  const moreCount = Math.max(0, participantCount - preview.length);

  return `
    <div class="fight-contrib">
      <div class="fight-contrib-head">
        <div>
          <div class="fight-contrib-title">Attackers</div>
          <div class="fight-contrib-totals">${formatNumber(participantCount)} members | ${formatNumber(totalDamage)} total damage | ${formatNumber(totalKills)} kills</div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn subtle" data-view-attackers="${Number(card.match_no || 0)}"${Number(card.battle_id || 0) > 0 ? '' : ' disabled'}>View Attackers</button>
      </div>
      <div class="fight-contrib-list">
        ${rows}
        ${moreCount > 0 ? `<div class="fight-contrib-empty">+${formatNumber(moreCount)} more member${moreCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function buildBattleRewards() {
  const rewards = Array.isArray(BATTLE_REWARDS) ? BATTLE_REWARDS : [];
  if (!rewards.length) {
    return '';
  }

  return `
    <div class="fight-rewards">
      <div class="fight-rewards-head">Win Rewards</div>
      <div class="fight-rewards-note">Every allied player who deals damage in this fight and wins receives these rewards.</div>
      <div class="fight-reward-list">
        ${rewards.map((reward) => `
          <div class="fight-reward-chip">
            <img src="${escapeHtml(reward.image || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp')}" alt="">
            <div class="fight-reward-copy">
              <strong>${formatNumber(reward.quantity || 0)}x ${escapeHtml(reward.name || 'Reward')}</strong>
              <small>${escapeHtml(reward.description || '')}</small>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function buildFightCard(card) {
  const status = String(card.status || 'open');
  const buttonDisabled = status === 'cleared' || (activeMatchNo > 0 && activeMatchNo !== Number(card.match_no || 0));
  const buttonText = status === 'active'
    ? 'Enter Fight'
    : (status === 'failed' ? 'Retry Fight' : 'Launch Fight');
  const buttonClass = status === 'active' ? 'btn live' : (status === 'failed' ? 'btn retry' : 'btn');
  const note = status === 'cleared'
    ? 'This fight is already won.'
    : (buttonDisabled ? `Locked while you are committed to fight #${activeMatchNo}.` : 'Multiple guild members can join and focus the same enemy captains.');
  const badgeClass = status === 'active' ? 'badge active' : (status === 'cleared' ? 'badge clear' : (status === 'failed' ? 'badge failed' : 'badge'));
  const captains = Array.isArray(card.captains) ? card.captains.map(buildCaptainRow).join('') : '';

  return `
    <div class="fight" data-match-no="${Number(card.match_no || 0)}">
      <div class="fight-banner" style="background-image:url('${escapeHtml(card.banner_image || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp')}')">
        <div class="fight-top">
          <span class="${badgeClass}">${escapeHtml(statusLabel(status))}</span>
          <div class="fight-title">
            <h3>Fight #${Number(card.match_no || 0)}</h3>
            <div class="muted">${escapeHtml(card.banner_name || 'Army Encounter')}${card.banner_power ? ` | ${escapeHtml(card.banner_power)}` : ''}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="fight-body">
        <div class="captain-list">${captains || '<div class="fight-status-note">No enemy captains configured.</div>'}</div>
        ${buildAttackersPreview(card)}
        ${buildBattleRewards()}
        <div class="fight-actions">
          <div class="fight-status-note">${escapeHtml(note)}</div>
          <button type="button" class="${buttonClass}" data-enter-match="${Number(card.match_no || 0)}"${buttonDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''}>
            ${escapeHtml(buttonText)}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderCards() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('fightGrid');
  if (!grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = fightCards.map(buildFightCard).join('');

  const clearedMatches = fightCards.filter(card => String(card.status || '') === 'cleared').length;
  document.getElementById('progressValue').textContent = `${clearedMatches}/${REQUIRED_MATCHES} Cleared`;
  document.getElementById('activeFightValue').textContent = activeMatchNo > 0 ? `Fight #${activeMatchNo}` : 'None';
  const note = document.getElementById('commitNote');
  if (note) {
    if (activeMatchNo > 0) {
      note.style.display = '';
      note.textContent = `You are currently committed to army fight #${activeMatchNo} in this node. Finish or leave that live battle before starting another one.`;
    } else {
      note.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
}

function renderContributorsModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('contributorsModal');
  const title = document.getElementById('contributorsTitle');
  const summary = document.getElementById('contributorsSummary');
  const body = document.getElementById('contributorsBody');
  if (!modal || !title || !summary || !body) return;

  if (contributorsMatchNo <= 0) {
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    body.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  modal.classList.add('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  title.textContent = `Fight #${contributorsMatchNo} Attackers`;

  if (!contributorsState) {
    summary.textContent = contributorsLoading ? 'Loading attacker contribution data...' : 'Open this panel to load attacker contribution data.';
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="fight-contrib-empty">No attacker data loaded yet.</div>';
    return;
  }

  summary.textContent = `${formatNumber(contributorsState.participant_count || 0)} members | ${formatNumber(contributorsState.total_damage || 0)} total damage | ${formatNumber(contributorsState.total_kills || 0)} enemy units killed`;

  const rows = Array.isArray(contributorsState.attackers) ? contributorsState.attackers : [];
  body.innerHTML = rows.length
    ? rows.map((entry, index) => `
        <div class="leader-row">
          <div>
            <strong>#${index + 1} ${escapeHtml(entry.username || `User #${entry.user_id || 0}`)}</strong>
            <small>Joined: ${escapeHtml(entry.joined_at || '-')} | Last action: ${escapeHtml(entry.last_action_at || '-')}</small>
          </div>
          <div class="leader-metric">${formatNumber(entry.damage_dealt || 0)} dmg</div>
          <div class="leader-metric">${formatNumber(entry.enemy_units_killed || 0)} kills</div>
        </div>
      `).join('')
    : '<div class="fight-contrib-empty">No guild member has dealt damage in this fight yet.</div>';
}

async function postAction(payload) {
  const body = new URLSearchParams(payload);
  const res = await fetch(ACTION_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    body: body.toString()
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !json || !json.ok) {
    throw new Error((json && (json.error || json.message)) ? (json.error || json.message) : `Action failed (${res.status})`);
  }
  return json;
}

async function loadContributors(matchNo, options = {}) {
  const silent = !!options.silent;
  contributorsLoading = true;
  if (!silent) {
    contributorsState = null;
    renderContributorsModal();
  }
  try {
    const res = await postAction({
      action: 'contributors',
      instance_id: String(INSTANCE_ID),
      node_id: String(NODE_ID),
      match_no: String(matchNo)
    });
    if (Number(matchNo) !== Number(contributorsMatchNo)) {
      return;
    }
    contributorsState = res.board || { participant_count: 0, total_damage: 0, total_kills: 0, attackers: [] };
    contributorsLoadedAt = Date.now();
    renderContributorsModal();
  } catch (error) {
    if (!silent) {
      showToast(error.message || 'Could not load attacker list.');
      contributorsState = { participant_count: 0, total_damage: 0, total_kills: 0, attackers: [] };
      renderContributorsModal();
    }
  } finally {
    contributorsLoading = false;
  }
}

function openContributors(matchNo) {
  contributorsMatchNo = Number(matchNo || 0);
  contributorsState = null;
  contributorsLoadedAt = 0;
  renderContributorsModal();
  if (contributorsMatchNo > 0) {
    void loadContributors(contributorsMatchNo);
  }
}

function closeContributors() {
  contributorsMatchNo = 0;
  contributorsState = null;
  contributorsLoadedAt = 0;
  contributorsLoading = false;
  renderContributorsModal();
}

async function refreshState() {
  try {
    const res = await postAction({
      action: 'state',
      instance_id: String(INSTANCE_ID),
      node_id: String(NODE_ID)
    });
    fightCards = Array.isArray(res.cards) ? res.cards : [];
    activeMatchNo = parseInt(res.active_match_no || 0, 10);
    renderCards();
    if (contributorsMatchNo > 0 && !contributorsLoading && ((Date.now() - contributorsLoadedAt) >= 5000)) {
      void loadContributors(contributorsMatchNo, { silent: true });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Could not refresh army fights.');
  }
}

async function enterFight(matchNo) {
  if (busyMatches.has(matchNo)) return;
  busyMatches.add(matchNo);
  try {
    const res = await postAction({
      action: 'enter_fight',
      instance_id: String(INSTANCE_ID),
      node_id: String(NODE_ID),
      match_no: String(matchNo)
    });
    if (res.redirect) {
      window.location.href = res.redirect;
      return;
    }
    await refreshState();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Could not open that army fight.');
    await refreshState();
  } finally {
    busyMatches.delete(matchNo);
  }
}

document.getElementById('fightGrid')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  const contribBtn = event.target.closest('[data-view-attackers]');
  if (contribBtn && !contribBtn.disabled) {
    const matchNo = parseInt(contribBtn.getAttribute('data-view-attackers') || '0', 10);
    if (matchNo > 0) {
      openContributors(matchNo);
    }
    return;
  }
  const btn = event.target.closest('[data-enter-match]');
  if (!btn || btn.disabled) return;
  const matchNo = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-enter-match') || '0', 10);
  if (matchNo > 0) {
    enterFight(matchNo);
  }
});

renderCards();
window.setInterval(refreshState, 1000);

document.getElementById('adminCompleteNodeBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  try {
    const body = new URLSearchParams();
    body.append('action', 'admin_complete_node');
    body.append('instance_id', String(INSTANCE_ID));
    body.append('node_id', String(NODE_ID));
    const raw = await fetch('guild_dungeon_cube_action.php', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      body: body.toString()
    });
    const res = await raw.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!raw.ok || !res || !res.ok) {
      throw new Error((res && (res.error || res.message)) ? (res.error || res.message) : 'Could not auto-complete this node.');
    }
    showToast(res.message || 'Army node auto-completed.');
    window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 300);
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Could not auto-complete this node.');
  }
});
document.getElementById('contributorsCloseBtn')?.addEventListener('click', closeContributors);
document.getElementById('contributorsModal')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
    closeContributors();
  }
});

<script>
const SOURCE = "cube";
const ENCOUNTER_CSRF = "";
const ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT = "";
let encounterRevision = 0;
const SOURCE_PARAMS = {"instance_id":"16126","node_id":"8","match_no":"2"};
const USER_ID = 159129;
const ROOM_STATUS = "open";
const CAN_CLASH_AUTO_BATTLE = false;
const HAS_SNAPSHOT = false;
const STATE_URL = 'pvp_style_state.php';
const ACTION_URL = 'pvp_style_action.php';
const LOG_DETAILS = [];
const JOIN_HINT_KEY = `veyra_pvp_style_join_hint_seen_v2_${USER_ID}`;
const ROOM_ID = 132885;
const PVP_REWARD_ITEMS = [{"item_id":251,"qty":1,"name":"Large Stamina Potion","image":"images/items/1768627855_stamina_xl.webp","rarity":"Epic"},{"item_id":337,"qty":50,"name":"Crucible Sigil","image":"/images/items/Crucible Sigil.webp","rarity":"Legendary"}];
const REWARD_MODAL_KEY = `veyra_pvp_style_reward_seen_room_${ROOM_ID}_${USER_ID}`;

let isMyTurn = false;
let myAlive = false;
let myTokens = 0;
let mySkills = [];
let selectedTargetKey = '';
let selectedTargetName = '—';
let healTargetKey = '';
let healTargetName = '—';
let reviveTargetKey = '';
let reviveTargetName = '—';
let pollMs = 2500;
let pollHandle = null;
let lastLogId = 0;
let currentRoomStatus = ROOM_STATUS;
let currentRoomJoined = false;
let rewardsModalShown = false;
let clashReturnScheduled = false;
let currentAutoBattle = false;

function shouldShowJoinHint() {
  if (currentRoomStatus === 'live') return false;
  if (currentRoomJoined) return false;
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem(JOIN_HINT_KEY) !== '1';
  } catch (error) {
    return true;
  }
}

function closeJoinHint(markSeen = false) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('joinHintModal');
  if (modal) {
    modal.classList.remove('show');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }
  if (markSeen) {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(JOIN_HINT_KEY, '1');
    } catch (error) {
      // ignore storage issues and allow the hint to reappear if needed
    }
  }
}

function maybeShowJoinHint() {
  if (!shouldShowJoinHint()) return;
  const modal = document.getElementById('joinHintModal');
  if (!modal) return;
  modal.classList.add('show');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
}

function forceShowJoinHint() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('joinHintModal');
  if (!modal) return;
  modal.classList.add('show');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
}

function renderRewardItems(items) {
  return (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).map((reward) => {
    const image = reward.image || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
    const qty = Number(reward.qty || 0);
    const rarity = reward.rarity ? `<div class="rewardRarity">${escapeHtml(reward.rarity)}</div>` : '';
    return `
      <div class="rewardCard">
        <img src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="">
        <div class="rewardMeta">
          <div class="rewardName">${escapeHtml(reward.name || 'Reward')}</div>
          <div class="rewardQty">x${escapeHtml(String(qty))}</div>
          ${rarity}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function closeRewardsModal(markSeen = false) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('rewardsModal');
  if (modal) {
    modal.classList.remove('show');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }
  if (markSeen) {
    rewardsModalShown = true;
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(REWARD_MODAL_KEY, '1');
    } catch (error) {
      // ignore storage issues
    }
  }
}

function maybeShowRewardsModal(state) {
  if (rewardsModalShown) return;
  if (!Array.isArray(PVP_REWARD_ITEMS) || !PVP_REWARD_ITEMS.length) return;
  if (!state || !state.match || !state.room_joined) return;
  if (!state.match.ended || String(state.match.winner_side || '') !== 'ally') return;
  if (String(state.room_status || '') !== 'cleared') return;
  try {
    if (window.localStorage.getItem(REWARD_MODAL_KEY) === '1') {
      rewardsModalShown = true;
      return;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore storage issues and still show the modal once in memory
  }
  const modal = document.getElementById('rewardsModal');
  const grid = document.getElementById('rewardsGrid');
  if (!modal || !grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = renderRewardItems(PVP_REWARD_ITEMS);
  modal.classList.add('show');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  rewardsModalShown = true;
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = String(value ?? '');
  return div.innerHTML;
}

function formatNum(value, decimals = 0) {
  const num = Number(value || 0);
  if (decimals > 0) {
    return num.toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
      maximumFractionDigits: decimals
    });
  }
  return Math.round(num).toLocaleString();
}

function formatPct(value, decimals = 1) {
  const pct = Number(value || 0) * 100;
  return `${pct.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals
  })}%`;
}

function detailRows(rows) {
  return `<div class="detailList">${rows.map((row) => `
    <div class="detailRow">
      <div class="detailLabel">${escapeHtml(row.label)}</div>
      <div class="detailValue">${escapeHtml(row.value)}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('')}</div>`;
}

function detailCard(title, bodyHtml, full = false) {
  return `<div class="detailCard${full ? ' full' : ''}">
    <div class="detailTitle">${escapeHtml(title)}</div>
    ${bodyHtml}
  </div>`;
}

function detailStep(title, text) {
  return `<div class="detailStep">
    <div class="detailStepHead">${escapeHtml(title)}</div>
    <div class="detailStepText">${escapeHtml(text)}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function sanitizeLogHTML(value) {
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = String(value || '');
  return div.innerHTML
    .replace(/&lt;(\/?b)&gt;/gi, '<$1>')
    .replace(/&lt;br\s*\/?&gt;/gi, '<br>');
}

function renderAttackDetails(content, details) {
  const actor = details.actor || {};
  const target = details.target || {};
  const skill = details.skill || {};
  const formula = details.formula || {};
  const attackNotes = Array.isArray(formula.attack_notes) ? formula.attack_notes.filter(Boolean) : [];
  const defenseNotes = Array.isArray(formula.defense_notes) ? formula.defense_notes.filter(Boolean) : [];
  const exchangeWinner = String(formula.exchange_winner || '');
  const attackerWon = exchangeWinner === 'attacker';
  const defenderStunned = Number(formula.defender_stunned_before_exchange || 0) > 0;
  const supportFollowup = Number(skill.is_support_followup || formula.support_followup || 0) > 0;
  const supportSourceSkill = String(skill.source_name || formula.support_source_skill_name || skill.name || 'the no-damage skill');
  const skillLabel = supportFollowup ? `Forced Slash (from ${supportSourceSkill})` : (skill.name || '-');
  const armorPenChanged =
    Number(formula.armor_penetration_core_ignored || 0) > 0 ||
    Number(formula.armor_penetration_eq_ignored || 0) > 0 ||
    Number(formula.armor_penetration_pet_ignored || 0) > 0;
  const stepCards = [
    detailStep(
      'Attack Build',
      `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} begins with ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_base)} raw core attack. Pre-battle pet, equipment, and guild effects shift that by ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_legacy_bonus)} to ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_before_live_buffs)} before temporary buffs. Formation adds ${formatPct(formula.attack_slot_buff_pct || 0)} and temporary attack buffs add ${formatPct(formula.attack_skill_buff_pct || 0)}, so the effective attack stat used in this exchange is ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_effective)}. Equipment attack contributes ${formatNum(formula.equipment_attack)}${Number(formula.equipment_attack_legacy_bonus || 0) !== 0 ? `, including ${formatNum(formula.equipment_attack_legacy_bonus)} from passive effects` : ''}. Raw pet attack is ${formatNum(formula.pet_attack_raw_total)} and contributes ${formatNum(formula.pet_attack_contribution)} to damage only. The score check uses only base attack and base equipment attack after class passive adjustments.`
    ),
    ...(attackNotes.length ? [detailStep('Attack-Side Buff Sources', attackNotes.join(' '))] : []),
    detailStep(
      'Defense Build',
      `${target.name || 'Target'} begins with ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_base)} raw core defense. Pre-battle pet, equipment, and guild effects shift that by ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_legacy_bonus)} to ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_before_live_buffs)} before temporary buffs. Formation adds ${formatPct(formula.defense_slot_buff_pct || 0)} and temporary defense buffs add ${formatPct(formula.defense_skill_buff_pct || 0)}, so the effective defense stat used in this exchange is ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_effective)}. Equipment defense contributes ${formatNum(formula.equipment_defense)}${Number(formula.equipment_defense_legacy_bonus || 0) !== 0 ? `, including ${formatNum(formula.equipment_defense_legacy_bonus)} from passive effects` : ''}. Raw pet defense is ${formatNum(formula.pet_defense_raw_total)} and contributes ${formatNum(formula.pet_defense_contribution)} to damage back only.${armorPenChanged ? ` Armor penetration reduced defense values from core ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_defense_core_raw)}, equipment ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_equipment_defense_raw)}, and pet ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_pet_defense_raw_total)} to ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_defense_core_used)}, ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_equipment_defense_used)}, and ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_pet_defense_used_total)} before damage back was calculated.` : ''} The score check uses only base defense and base equipment defense after class passive adjustments.`
    ),
    ...(defenseNotes.length ? [detailStep('Defense-Side Buff Sources', defenseNotes.join(' '))] : []),
    detailStep(
      'Score Inputs vs Damage Back',
      `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} score = ${formatNum(formula.score_attacker_attack_core ?? formula.attack_core_base)} base attack after class passive + 50% of ${formatNum(formula.score_attacker_equipment_attack ?? formula.equipment_attack_base)} base equipment attack = ${formatNum(formula.exchange_attacker_score, 2)}. ${target.name || 'Target'} score = ${formatNum(formula.score_defender_defense_core ?? formula.defense_core_base)} base defense after class passive + 50% of ${formatNum(formula.score_defender_equipment_defense ?? formula.equipment_defense_base)} base equipment defense = ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_score, 2)}. Pets, guild bonuses, equipment passives, formation bonuses, temporary buffs, and armor penetration do not enter this score.${defenderStunned ? ` ${target.name || 'The defender'} was already stunned at the start of this exchange, so retaliation was suppressed entirely.` : ''}`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Exchange Score',
      `The higher score picks the rule for this hit. The score difference was ${formatNum(formula.exchange_advantage_score, 2)}, so the ${attackerWon ? 'attacker' : 'defender'} won the score phase.`
    ),
    ...(supportFollowup ? [detailStep('Forced Slash Trigger', `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} used ${supportSourceSkill}, which does not deal direct damage in PvP. That no-damage skill forced a slash exchange against ${target.name || 'the target'}.`)] : []),
    detailStep(
      'Base Exchange Damage',
      attackerWon
? `Because the attacker won the score check, base target damage uses attack core + 20% pet attack + equipment attack, while damage back uses 30% defense core + 20% pet defense + 50% equipment defense from ${target.name || 'the defender'}. That creates ${formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_base)} base damage to the target and ${formatNum(formula.exchange_self_damage_base)} base damage back to the attacker.${defenderStunned ? ` Because ${target.name || 'the defender'} was stunned, that damage back was overridden to 0 for this exchange.` : ''}`
: `Because the defender won the score check, base target damage uses 50% attack core + 20% pet attack + 50% equipment attack, while damage back uses 60% defense core + 20% pet defense + full equipment defense from ${target.name || 'the defender'}. That creates ${formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_base)} base damage to the target and ${formatNum(formula.exchange_self_damage_base)} base damage back to the attacker.${defenderStunned ? ` Because ${target.name || 'the defender'} was stunned, that damage back was overridden to 0 for this exchange.` : ''}`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Skill And Multipliers',
      `${supportFollowup ? `${supportSourceSkill} did not add direct skill damage, so this follow-up used a normal slash exchange before multipliers.` : `${formatNum(formula.skill_extra_damage)} extra skill damage is added to the target side only, moving target damage to ${formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_after_skill)} before multipliers.`} Outgoing damage then pushes the target side to ${formatNum(formula.after_outgoing_target_damage)}. Power Slash applies x${formatNum(formula.power_slash_multiplier, 2)} to both sides, the turn bonus applies x${formatNum(formula.turn_bonus_multiplier, 2)} to both sides (${formatNum(formula.turn_bonus_steps || 0)} step(s), every ${formatNum(formula.turn_bonus_interval || 10)} turns), and the match pacing multiplier applies x${formatNum(formula.global_damage_multiplier || 1, 2)} to both sides, leaving ${formatNum(formula.pre_critical_target_damage)} target damage before the crit check and ${formatNum(formula.pre_critical_self_damage ?? formula.self_damage_input)} damage back from the defender before shields${defenderStunned ? ', which stays at 0 because the defender was stunned' : ''}. Attacker crits only multiply target damage, not damage back.`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Critical Check',
      Number(formula.critical_triggered || 0)
        ? `Critical chance was ${formatPct(formula.critical_chance || 0)} and it triggered, multiplying target damage by x${formatNum(formula.critical_multiplier, 2)} to ${formatNum(formula.target_damage_input)} before shields.`
        : `Critical chance was ${formatPct(formula.critical_chance || 0)} and it did not trigger, so target damage stayed at ${formatNum(formula.target_damage_input)} before shields.`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Shield And HP',
      `${target.name || 'Target'} blocks ${formatNum(formula.target_blocked)} with shield and takes ${formatNum(formula.target_damage_dealt)} HP damage. ${Number(formula.self_damage_input || 0) > 0 || Number(formula.self_blocked || 0) > 0 || Number(formula.self_damage_dealt || 0) > 0 ? `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} also takes ${formatNum(formula.self_damage_input)} damage back from ${target.name || 'the defender'}, with ${formatNum(formula.self_blocked)} blocked and ${formatNum(formula.self_damage_dealt)} dealt.` : defenderStunned ? `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} takes no damage back because ${target.name || 'the defender'} was stunned before the exchange.` : `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} takes no damage back from ${target.name || 'the defender'}.`}`
    )
  ].join('');

  return `<div class="detailGrid">
    ${detailCard('Log Entry', `<div class="detailSummary">${escapeHtml(content)}</div>`, true)}
    ${detailCard('Summary', detailRows([
      { label: 'Actor', value: actor.name || '-' },
      { label: 'Target', value: target.name || '-' },
      { label: 'Skill', value: skillLabel },
      { label: 'Auto Action', value: details.auto ? 'Yes' : 'No' }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Exchange Score', detailRows([
      { label: 'Attacker Score', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_attacker_score, 2) },
      { label: 'Defender Score', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_score, 2) },
      { label: 'Advantage', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_advantage_score, 2) },
      { label: 'Winner', value: exchangeWinner ? `${exchangeWinner.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${exchangeWinner.slice(1)}` : '-' }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Outcome', detailRows([
      { label: 'Target HP', value: `${formatNum(target.hp_before)} -> ${formatNum(target.hp_after)}` },
      { label: 'Target Shield', value: `${formatNum(target.shield_before)} -> ${formatNum(target.shield_after)}` },
      { label: 'Attacker HP', value: `${formatNum(actor.hp_before)} -> ${formatNum(actor.hp_after)}` },
      { label: 'Attacker Shield', value: `${formatNum(actor.shield_before)} -> ${formatNum(actor.shield_after)}` }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Damage Numbers', detailRows([
      { label: 'Base Target Damage', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_base) },
      { label: 'Base Damage Back', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_self_damage_base) },
      { label: 'Skill Bonus', value: formatNum(formula.skill_extra_damage) },
      { label: 'Target Damage Before Shields', value: formatNum(formula.target_damage_input) },
      { label: 'Damage Back Before Shields', value: formatNum(formula.self_damage_input) },
      { label: 'Blocked By Target', value: formatNum(formula.target_blocked) },
      { label: 'Final Target Damage', value: formatNum(formula.target_damage_dealt) },
      { label: 'Final Damage Back', value: formatNum(formula.self_damage_dealt) }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Formula Steps', `<div class="detailSteps">${stepCards}</div>`, true)}
  </div>`;
}

function renderLogDetail(content, details) {
  if (!details || typeof details !== 'object') {
    return `<div class="detailGrid">
      ${detailCard('Log Entry', `<div class="detailSummary">${escapeHtml(content)}</div>`, true)}
      ${detailCard('Details', `<div class="detailNote">This entry is informational only, or it was created before detailed combat math was attached to the log. New damage, heal, revive, and skill-trigger lines will show their breakdown here.</div>`, true)}
    </div>`;
  }
  switch (details.kind) {
    case 'attack':
      return renderAttackDetails(content, details);
    case 'splash':
      return renderSplashDetails(content, details);
    case 'npc_skill_damage':
      return renderNpcSkillDamageDetails(content, details);
    case 'heal':
      return renderHealDetails(content, details);
    case 'revive':
      return renderReviveDetails(content, details);
    case 'support':
    case 'npc_support':
      return renderSupportDetails(content, details);
    default:
      return `<div class="detailGrid">
        ${detailCard('Log Entry', `<div class="detailSummary">${escapeHtml(content)}</div>`, true)}
        ${detailCard('Stored Data', `<pre class="detailNote" style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin:0;">${escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(details, null, 2))}</pre>`, true)}
      </div>`;
  }
}

function showToast(message) {
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  toast.textContent = message;
  toast.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
}

function closeLogDetail() {
  document.getElementById('logDetailModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openLogDetail(logLine) {
  if (!logLine) return;
  const logId = String(logLine.dataset.logId || '');
  const content = logLine.querySelector('.logText')?.textContent || '';
  const stamp = logLine.querySelector('.logTime')?.textContent || '-';
  const details = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LOG_DETAILS, logId) ? LOG_DETAILS[logId] : null;
  document.getElementById('logDetailTime').textContent = stamp || '-';
  const body = document.getElementById('logDetailBody');
  body.innerHTML = renderLogDetail(content, details);
  body.scrollTop = 0;
  document.getElementById('logDetailModal').classList.add('show');
}

function clearTarget() {
  selectedTargetKey = '';
  selectedTargetName = '—';
  document.getElementById('targetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  document.getElementById('modalTargetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  document.querySelectorAll('#topTeamCard .pSlot.targeted').forEach((slot) => slot.classList.remove('targeted'));
}

function roomAction(action, extra = {}) {
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    source: SOURCE,
    action
  });
  Object.entries(SOURCE_PARAMS || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => body.set(key, String(value)));
  Object.entries(extra).forEach(([key, value]) => body.set(key, String(value)));
  if ((SOURCE === 'event' || SOURCE === 'event_army') && ENCOUNTER_CSRF) {
    body.set('csrf', ENCOUNTER_CSRF);
    body.set('encounter_attempt', ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT);
    if (SOURCE === 'event_army') body.set('encounter_revision', String(encounterRevision));
  }
  return fetch(ACTION_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    body: body.toString()
  }).then(async (res) => {
    const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!res.ok || !json || !json.ok) {
      throw new Error((json && (json.error || json.message)) ? (json.error || json.message) : `Action failed (${res.status})`);
    }
    if (json.state && Number.isInteger(json.state.encounter_revision)) {
      encounterRevision = Math.max(encounterRevision, json.state.encounter_revision);
    }
    return json;
  });
}

function closeSkills() {
  document.getElementById('skillsModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openSkills() {
  const hasSelfSkill = mySkills.some((skill) => skill.target === 'self');
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose skills manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Not your turn.');
    return;
  }
  if (!selectedTargetKey && !hasSelfSkill) {
    showToast('Click an enemy card to select your target.');
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('modalTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  document.getElementById('modalTargetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  refreshSkillPanels();
  document.getElementById('skillsModal').classList.add('show');
  refreshSkillDisabled();
}

function openHeal(targetKey, targetName) {
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose skills manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Not your turn.');
    return;
  }
  const healSkills = mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_alive');
  if (!healSkills.length) {
    showToast("You don't have any heal skill.");
    return;
  }
  healTargetKey = targetKey;
  healTargetName = targetName || 'Ally';
  document.getElementById('healTargetName').textContent = healTargetName;
  document.getElementById('healTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  refreshSkillPanels();
  document.getElementById('healModal').classList.add('show');
  refreshHealDisabled();
}

function closeHeal() {
  document.getElementById('healModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openRevive(targetKey, targetName) {
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose skills manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Not your turn.');
    return;
  }
  const reviveSkills = mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_dead');
  if (!reviveSkills.length) {
    showToast("You don't have any revive skill.");
    return;
  }
  reviveTargetKey = targetKey;
  reviveTargetName = targetName || 'Ally';
  document.getElementById('reviveTargetName').textContent = reviveTargetName;
  document.getElementById('reviveTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  refreshSkillPanels();
  document.getElementById('reviveModal').classList.add('show');
  refreshReviveDisabled();
}

function closeRevive() {
  document.getElementById('reviveModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function createSkillButton(skill, clickHandler) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.type = 'button';
  button.className = 'skillCard';
  button.dataset.skillId = String(skill.id);
  button.dataset.cost = String(skill.cost || 0);
  button.dataset.needsTarget = skill.target === 'enemy' ? '1' : '0';
  button.addEventListener('click', clickHandler);

  const metaLabel = skill.target === 'ally_alive'
    ? 'Heal'
    : (skill.target === 'ally_dead' ? 'Revive' : (skill.target === 'self' ? 'Self Cast' : 'Active'));

  button.innerHTML = `
    <div class="skillTop">
      <img class="skillIco" src="${sanitizeLogHTML(skill.icon || 'images/skills/slash.webp')}" alt="">
      <div class="skillName">${sanitizeLogHTML(skill.name || 'Skill')}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="skillMeta">
      <span class="chip">${metaLabel}</span>
      <span class="chip">Cost: ×${parseInt(skill.cost || 0, 10)}</span>
    </div>
  `;
  return button;
}

function refreshSkillPanels() {
  const attackGrid = document.getElementById('skillsGrid');
  const healGrid = document.getElementById('healGrid');
  const reviveGrid = document.getElementById('reviveGrid');
  attackGrid.innerHTML = '';
  healGrid.innerHTML = '';
  reviveGrid.innerHTML = '';

  mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'enemy' || skill.target === 'self').forEach((skill) => {
    attackGrid.appendChild(createSkillButton(skill, () => useSkill(String(skill.id))));
  });
  mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_alive').forEach((skill) => {
    healGrid.appendChild(createSkillButton(skill, () => useHealSkill(String(skill.id))));
  });
  mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_dead').forEach((skill) => {
    reviveGrid.appendChild(createSkillButton(skill, () => useReviveSkill(String(skill.id))));
  });
}

function refreshSkillDisabled() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#skillsGrid button.skillCard').forEach((button) => {
    const cost = parseInt(button.dataset.cost || '0', 10);
    const needsTarget = button.dataset.needsTarget === '1';
    button.disabled = (currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive || myTokens < cost || (needsTarget && !selectedTargetKey));
  });
}

function refreshHealDisabled() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#healGrid button.skillCard').forEach((button) => {
    const cost = parseInt(button.dataset.cost || '0', 10);
    button.disabled = (currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive || !healTargetKey || myTokens < cost);
  });
}

function refreshReviveDisabled() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#reviveGrid button.skillCard').forEach((button) => {
    const cost = parseInt(button.dataset.cost || '0', 10);
    button.disabled = (currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive || !reviveTargetKey || myTokens < cost);
  });
}

function refreshSurrenderDisabled() {
  const button = document.getElementById('surrenderBtn');
  if (!button) return;
  button.disabled = (currentRoomStatus !== 'live') || (SOURCE === 'cube' && !currentRoomJoined);
}

function refreshRetryDisabled() {
  const button = document.getElementById('retryPhaseDuelBtn');
  if (!button) return;
  button.disabled = !(SOURCE === 'monster_phase' || SOURCE === 'hermes') || currentRoomStatus !== 'lost';
}

function refreshAutoBattleButton(state = null) {
  const button = document.getElementById('autoBattleBtn');
  if (!button) return;
  const ended = !!(state && state.match && state.match.ended);
  const enabled = !!(state && state.match && state.match.auto_play);
  button.disabled = !CAN_CLASH_AUTO_BATTLE || currentRoomStatus !== 'live' || ended;
  button.classList.toggle('autoOn', enabled);
  button.textContent = enabled ? 'Auto Battle On' : 'Auto Battle';
}

function refreshAutoBattlePolling(enabled, ended = false) {
  const nextPollMs = (SOURCE === 'clash' && enabled && !ended) ? 1100 : 2500;
  if (pollMs === nextPollMs) return;
  pollMs = nextPollMs;
  restartPolling();
}

async function useSkill(skillId) {
  try {
    const res = await roomAction('use_skill', { skill_id: skillId, target_key: selectedTargetKey });
    showToast(res.message || 'Action success!');
    closeSkills();
    await tick();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Action failed.');
  } finally {
    refreshSkillDisabled();
    refreshHealDisabled();
    refreshReviveDisabled();
  }
}

async function useHealSkill(skillId) {
  try {
    const res = await roomAction('use_skill', { skill_id: skillId, target_key: healTargetKey });
    showToast(res.message || 'Heal success!');
    closeHeal();
    await tick();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Heal failed.');
  } finally {
    refreshHealDisabled();
  }
}

async function useReviveSkill(skillId) {
  try {
    const res = await roomAction('use_skill', { skill_id: skillId, target_key: reviveTargetKey });
    showToast(res.message || 'Revive success!');
    closeRevive();
    await tick();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Revive failed.');
  } finally {
    refreshReviveDisabled();
  }
}

function applySlot(side, slot, pdata, currentKey) {
  const el = document.getElementById(`slot_${side}_${slot}`);
  if (!el) return;

  const img = el.querySelector('img.pfp');
  const name = el.querySelector('.uname');
  const hpFill = el.querySelector('.hpFill');
  const hpVal = el.querySelector('.hpVal');
  const hpMaxVal = el.querySelector('.hpMaxVal');
  const tokChip = el.querySelector('.tokChip');
  const aliveTag = el.querySelector('.aliveTag');
  const buff = el.querySelector('.buff');
  const defaultBuff = el.dataset.defaultBuff || '';

  el.classList.remove('turn', 'targeted', 'dead', 'joinable');
  el.dataset.key = '';
  el.dataset.userId = '0';
  el.dataset.alive = '0';
  el.dataset.username = '';
  img.src = '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
  name.textContent = 'Empty';
  hpFill.style.width = '0%';
  hpVal.textContent = '0';
  hpMaxVal.textContent = '1';
  tokChip.textContent = side === 'ally' ? '⚔️ 0' : '🛡️ 0';
  aliveTag.textContent = 'EMPTY';
  buff.textContent = defaultBuff;

  if (!pdata || !pdata.key) {
    if (side === 'ally' && currentRoomStatus !== 'live' && !currentRoomJoined) {
      el.classList.add('joinable');
      name.textContent = 'Open Slot';
      hpVal.textContent = '-';
      hpMaxVal.textContent = '-';
      tokChip.textContent = 'OPEN';
      aliveTag.textContent = 'JOIN';
      buff.textContent = defaultBuff;
      return;
    }
    el.classList.add('dead');
    return;
  }

  const alive = !!pdata.alive;
  el.dataset.key = pdata.key || '';
  el.dataset.userId = String(pdata.user_id || 0);
  el.dataset.alive = alive ? '1' : '0';
  el.dataset.username = pdata.username || '';
  img.src = pdata.picture || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
  name.textContent = pdata.username || 'Unknown';
  hpFill.style.width = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(((pdata.hp || 0) * 100) / Math.max(1, pdata.hp_max || 1))))}%`;
  hpVal.textContent = String(pdata.hp || 0);
  hpMaxVal.textContent = String(pdata.hp_max || 0);
  tokChip.textContent = side === 'ally' ? `⚔️ ${pdata.tokens || 0}` : `🛡️ ${pdata.shield || 0}`;
  aliveTag.textContent = alive ? 'ALIVE' : 'OUT';
  buff.textContent = pdata.effect_badge ? (defaultBuff ? `${defaultBuff} • ${pdata.effect_badge}` : pdata.effect_badge) : defaultBuff;

  if (!alive) {
    el.classList.add('dead');
  }
  if ((pdata.key || '') === currentKey) {
    el.classList.add('turn');
  }
  if (selectedTargetKey && selectedTargetKey === pdata.key) {
    el.classList.add('targeted');
  }
}

function appendLogs(rows) {
  const box = document.getElementById('logBox');
  const empty = document.getElementById('emptyLog');
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) {
    return;
  }
  if (empty) {
    empty.remove();
  }
  rows.forEach((row) => {
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'logLine';
    line.dataset.logId = String(row.id || 0);
    line.tabIndex = 0;
    line.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    line.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open battle log details');
    LOG_DETAILS[String(row.id || 0)] = row.details || null;

    const text = document.createElement('div');
    text.className = 'logText';
    text.innerHTML = sanitizeLogHTML(row.content || '');

    const time = document.createElement('div');
    time.className = 'logTime';
    time.textContent = row.datetime || '';

    line.appendChild(text);
    line.appendChild(time);
    box.appendChild(line);
    lastLogId = Math.max(lastLogId, parseInt(row.id || 0, 10));
  });
  while (box.children.length > 80) {
    box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
  }
  box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
}

async function fetchState() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ source: SOURCE, since_log_id: String(lastLogId) });
  Object.entries(SOURCE_PARAMS || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => params.set(key, String(value)));
  const res = await fetch(`${STATE_URL}?${params.toString()}`, {
    credentials: 'same-origin'
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !json || !json.ok) {
    throw new Error((json && (json.error || json.message)) ? (json.error || json.message) : `State error (${res.status})`);
  }
  return json;
}

function updateUI(state) {
  if (Number.isInteger(state.encounter_revision) && state.encounter_attempt === ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT) {
    encounterRevision = Math.max(encounterRevision, state.encounter_revision);
  }
  const turn = state.turn || {};
  const me = state.me || {};
  const ended = !!(state.match && state.match.ended);
  const autoBattle = SOURCE === 'clash' && !!(state.match && state.match.auto_play);
  const currentKey = turn.key || '';
  const roomStatus = state.room_status || ROOM_STATUS;
  const roomJoined = !!state.room_joined;
  const roomSlot = parseInt(state.room_slot || 0, 10);
  currentRoomStatus = roomStatus;
  currentRoomJoined = roomJoined;
  currentAutoBattle = autoBattle;
  if (roomJoined || roomStatus === 'live' || ended) {
    closeJoinHint(true);
  }
  maybeShowRewardsModal(state);

  isMyTurn = !!(me.in_match && turn.user_id === USER_ID && turn.side === 'ally' && !ended);
  myAlive = !!me.alive;
  myTokens = parseInt(me.tokens || 0, 10);
  mySkills = Array.isArray(me.skills) ? me.skills : [];
  updateClashFatigue(state.clash_fatigue || null);

  document.getElementById('turnWho').textContent = turn.username || '—';
  document.getElementById('turnMeta').textContent = turn.side ? `${turn.side === 'ally' ? 'Allied' : 'Enemy'} turn • Slot ${turn.num_in_formation || '?'}` : 'Waiting for launch.';
  document.getElementById('turnTimer').textContent = String(turn.seconds_left || 0).padStart(2, '0');
  document.getElementById('turnTimer').classList.toggle('danger', (turn.seconds_left || 0) <= 3);
  document.getElementById('myTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  document.getElementById('matchStatusBadge').textContent = ended
    ? ((state.match.winner_side || 'draw') === 'ally'
      ? 'Room cleared'
      : ((SOURCE === 'monster_phase' || SOURCE === 'hermes') && roomStatus === 'lost' ? 'Duel failed - retry available' : 'Trial failed'))
    : (roomStatus === 'live' ? 'Live / Updating' : 'Awaiting launch');

  if (ended) {
    if (SOURCE === 'clash' && !clashReturnScheduled) {
      clashReturnScheduled = true;
      const nextUrl = state.clash_next_url || "pvp_style_node.php?source=cube&instance_id=16126&node_id=8";
      setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = nextUrl; }, 1800);
    }
    if ((SOURCE === 'monster_phase' || SOURCE === 'hermes') && state.match.winner_side === 'enemy' && roomStatus === 'lost') {
      document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'You were defeated. Retry restarts only your own phase duel and heals both sides.';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = (state.match.winner_side === 'ally')
        ? 'The allied team cleared the room.'
        : (state.match.winner_side === 'enemy' ? 'The enemy team held the room. Regroup and try again.' : 'The room ended in a draw.');
    }
  } else if (roomStatus !== 'live') {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = (SOURCE === 'event' || SOURCE === 'event_army' || SOURCE === 'clash')
      ? "This story duel has already been resolved. Return to the event page when you are ready."      : (roomJoined
        ? `This match is waiting to start. Your slot #${roomSlot || '?'} is reserved here.`
        : 'This match is waiting to start. Click one empty ally card below to join it.');
  } else if (!me.in_match) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Spectating mode. Joined hunters will take turns here once the room goes live.';
  } else if (!myAlive) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Your hunter is down. You can still spectate the battle.';
  } else if (currentAutoBattle) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Auto Battle is running. The battle AI will pick skills for both sides until you turn it off.';
  } else if (isMyTurn) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Your turn. Click an enemy card and choose a skill before the timer ends.';
  } else if (turn.side === 'enemy') {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Enemy turn. The NPC strikes after a brief 3-second wind-up.';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Waiting for your teammates to act.';
  }

  document.getElementById('bottomBadge').textContent = (SOURCE === 'event' || SOURCE === 'event_army' || SOURCE === 'clash')
    ? 'Your side'
    : ((roomStatus !== 'live' && !ended)
      ? (roomJoined ? `Your slot #${roomSlot || '?'}` : 'Click an empty card to join')
      : (roomJoined ? 'Your side' : 'Guild side'));

  const enemyMap = (((state.teams || {}).enemy || {}).players_by_num) || {};
  const allyMap = (((state.teams || {}).ally || {}).players_by_num) || {};
  (Array.isArray(state.template_numbers) ? state.template_numbers : [1,2,3,4,5]).forEach((slot) => {
    const normalized = parseInt(slot, 10);
    applySlot('enemy', normalized, enemyMap[String(normalized)] || null, currentKey);
    applySlot('ally', normalized, allyMap[String(normalized)] || null, currentKey);
  });

  document.getElementById('attackBtn').disabled = currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive;
  refreshSkillPanels();
  refreshSkillDisabled();
  refreshHealDisabled();
  refreshReviveDisabled();
  refreshSurrenderDisabled();
  refreshRetryDisabled();
  refreshAutoBattleButton(state);
  refreshAutoBattlePolling(currentAutoBattle, ended);
  appendLogs(state.new_logs || []);
}

function updateClashFatigue(payload) {
  if (SOURCE !== 'clash' || !payload) return;
  const value = Number(payload.fatigue || 0);
  const statReduction = Number(payload.stat_reduction_pct || value);
  const damageTaken = Number(payload.damage_received_increase_pct || (value * 2));
  const healingReduction = Number(payload.healing_reduction_pct || value);
  const valueEl = document.getElementById('clashFatigueValue');
  const textEl = document.getElementById('clashFatigueText');
  if (valueEl) valueEl.textContent = String(value);
  if (textEl) {
    textEl.textContent = `Stats reduced by ${statReduction}%. Damage received increased by ${damageTaken}%. Healing reduced by ${healingReduction}%.`;
  }
}

async function tick() {
  try {
    const state = await fetchState();
    updateUI(state);
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'State error.');
  }
}

function restartPolling() {
  if (pollHandle) clearInterval(pollHandle);
  pollHandle = setInterval(tick, pollMs);
}

document.getElementById('topTeamCard').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  const slot = event.target.closest('.pSlot');
  if (!slot) return;
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose targets manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Wait for your turn.');
    return;
  }
  if (!slot.dataset.key) {
    showToast('Empty slot.');
    return;
  }
  if (slot.dataset.alive !== '1') {
    showToast('That enemy is already down.');
    return;
  }
  clearTarget();
  selectedTargetKey = slot.dataset.key || '';
  selectedTargetName = slot.dataset.username || 'Enemy';
  slot.classList.add('targeted');
  document.getElementById('targetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  document.getElementById('modalTargetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  openSkills();
});

document.getElementById('bottomTeamCard').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  const slot = event.target.closest('.pSlot');
  if (!slot) return;
  if (currentRoomStatus !== 'live') {
    if (SOURCE !== 'cube') {
      return;
    }
    const slotNum = parseInt(slot.dataset.slot || '0', 10);
    if (!slotNum) return;
    if (slot.dataset.key && String(slot.dataset.userId || '0') !== String(USER_ID)) {
      showToast('That formation slot is already taken.');
      return;
    }
    if (slot.dataset.key && String(slot.dataset.userId || '0') === String(USER_ID)) {
      showToast('This is your current slot.');
      return;
    }
    roomAction('pick_slot', { slot_index: slotNum })
      .then((res) => {
        showToast(res.message || 'Formation slot claimed.');
        window.location.reload();
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        showToast(error.message || 'Could not claim that slot.');
      });
    return;
  }
  if (!slot.dataset.key) return;
  if (slot.dataset.alive !== '1') {
    openRevive(slot.dataset.key, slot.dataset.username || 'Ally');
    return;
  }
  openHeal(slot.dataset.key, slot.dataset.username || 'Ally');
});

<script>
// --- endpoint + payload helpers ---
const BCFG = window.BATTLE_CFG || {};
const EP   = BCFG.endpoints || {};
const IS_DG = !!BCFG.isDungeon;

function ep(name){
  // name is one of: ATTACK, JOIN, LOOT, HEAL, HEAL_POTION
  return EP[name] || '';
}

// Always include the right identifiers for the current mode.
// Global: monster_id
// Dungeon: instance_id + dgmid  (and we also send monster_id if you want)
function baseQS(){
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (IS_DG) {
    p.set('instance_id', String(BCFG.instanceId));
    p.set('dgmid',      String(BCFG.dgmid      || 0));
  } else {
    p.set('monster_id', String(BCFG.id || 0));
  }
  return p;
}

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 1520;
  const refillAmt = 344;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; 
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>

    })

  });
})();

<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){
  const drawer   = document.getElementById('sideDrawer');
  const fabOpen  = document.getElementById('nav_fab');       // 👈 bottom-left button
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('sideCloseBtn');  // ✕ inside drawer header
  const overlay  = document.getElementById('sideOverlay');   // dark backdrop on mobile

  if (!drawer) return;

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','true');
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','false');
  }

  if (fabOpen){
    fabOpen.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  }
  if (closeBtn){
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }
  if (overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }

  // ESC closes only on mobile view (doesn't really matter to check width though)
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();
