function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-31";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>

  });
})();

<script>
    function fxIsOff(){ return document.body.classList.contains('fx-off'); }

function setFxOff(off){
  document.body.classList.toggle('fx-off', !!off);
  // persist both ways
  try { localStorage.setItem('fx_off', off ? '1' : '0'); } catch(e){}
  setCookie('fx_off', off ? '1' : '0', 60*60*24*365); // 1 year

  const btn = document.getElementById('fxToggleBtn');
  if (btn){
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', (!off).toString());
    btn.textContent = off ? '⚡ Attack FX: OFF' : '⚡ Attack FX: ON';
  }
}

// Initialize preference (auto-off if user prefers reduced motion)
(function initFxPref(){
  let off = false;
  try { off = (localStorage.getItem('fx_off') === '1'); } catch(e){}
  if (!off) off = (getCookie('fx_off') === '1');
  if (!off && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
    off = true;
  }
  setFxOff(off);

  const btn = document.getElementById('fxToggleBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', () => setFxOff(!fxIsOff()));
})();

function triggerSlashFX(mode='slash'){
    if (fxIsOff()) return;
  const box = document.getElementById('slashFX');
  if (!box) return;

  // Set mode class for palette/intensity
  box.classList.remove('mode-power','mode-heroic','mode-legend','mode-ultimate');
  if (mode === 'power')    box.classList.add('mode-power');
  if (mode === 'heroic')   box.classList.add('mode-heroic');
  if (mode === 'legend')   box.classList.add('mode-legend');
  if (mode === 'ultimate') box.classList.add('mode-ultimate');
  if (mode === 'world') box.classList.add('mode-world');

  // Base nodes present in all modes
  const parts = [];

  // Helper to add N diagonal slashes
  const addSlash = (klass='') => `<div class="fx-slash ${klass}"></div>`;

  switch(mode){
    case 'power':
      parts.push(
        addSlash('long'),
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(10) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(2);
      break;

    case 'heroic':
      parts.push(
        addSlash('long'),
        addSlash('long late'),
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(16) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(2);
      break;

    case 'legend':
      parts.push(
        addSlash('ultra'),
        addSlash('ultra late'),
        addSlash('ultra later'),
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(24) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(3);
      break;

    case 'ultimate':
      parts.push(
        // Cross slash + vertical rift + big ring + tint
        addSlash('ultra'),
        addSlash('ultra rev late'),
        '<div class="fx-rift"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(32) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-tint"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(3);
      break;

    default: // normal slash
      parts.push(addSlash(), '<div class="fx-flash"></div>');
      bodyShake(1);
  }

  // Build + (re)start animations
  box.innerHTML = parts.join('');
  box.classList.remove('animate');
  void box.offsetWidth; // reflow
  box.classList.add('animate');

  // Clear overlay once done
  setTimeout(() => { box.classList.remove('animate'); box.innerHTML=''; }, 750);
}

function bodyShake(level=1){
    if (fxIsOff()) return;
  document.body.classList.remove('shake','shake-1','shake-2','shake-3');
  if (level === 1) document.body.classList.add('shake-1');
  if (level === 2) document.body.classList.add('shake-2');
  if (level >= 3)  document.body.classList.add('shake-3');
  setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove('shake','shake-1','shake-2','shake-3'), 420);
}

function createSparks(n=12){
  // Random short shards radiating from center
  let html = '';
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const ang = Math.random()*360;
    const dist = 20 + Math.random()*40; // vmin-ish
    const x = 50 + Math.cos(ang*Math.PI/180)*dist;
    const y = 50 + Math.sin(ang*Math.PI/180)*dist;
    const rot = Math.random()*360;
    const w = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random()*9);
    const top = `${y}vmin`, left = `${x}vmin`;
    html += `<i style="top:${top};left:${left};transform:rotate(${rot}deg);width:${w}px;"></i>`;
  }
  return html;
}


/* --- simple helpers --- */
function getCookie(name) {
  const m = document.cookie.split('; ').find(r => r.startsWith(name + '='));
  return m ? decodeURIComponent(m.split('=')[1]) : '';
}
function setCookie(name, value, maxAgeSeconds = 86400) {
  document.cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; max-age=${maxAgeSeconds}; SameSite=Lax`;
}
function deleteCookie(name) {
  document.cookie = `${name}=; path=/; max-age=0; SameSite=Lax`;
}
function getDailyCookieKey() {
  const now = new Date();
  const year = now.getFullYear();
  const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}
function canAttackNow() {
  const raw = getCookie('last_attack');
  const last = parseInt(raw || '0', 10) || 0;
  const now  = Date.now();
  if (!Number.isFinite(last) || last <= 0) {
    return { ok: true, now };
  }
  // A future attack timestamp means the browser clock changed or the cookie is corrupted.
  // Clear it so players do not get fake waits like "3000s".
  if (last > now + 1000) {
    deleteCookie('last_attack');
    return { ok: true, now };
  }
  if (last && now - last < 500) {
    return { ok: false, waitMs: 500 - (now - last) };
  }
  return { ok: true, now };
}
function lockAttackButtons(lock = true) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.attack-btn').forEach(b => {
    b.disabled = lock;
    if (lock) { b.classList.add('is-loading'); b.setAttribute('aria-busy','true'); }
    else { b.classList.remove('is-loading'); b.removeAttribute('aria-busy'); }
  });
}
function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = type === 'error' ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, type === 'error' ? 8000 : 3000);
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

function setDamageDebugOutput(msg) {
  if (!DAMAGE_DEBUG) return;
  const box = document.getElementById('damageDebugBox');
  const content = document.getElementById('damageDebugContent');
  if (!box || !content) return;
  content.textContent = String(msg || '');
  box.classList.add('is-visible');
  try { console.error('damage.php debug:', msg); } catch (e) {}
}

function clearDamageDebugOutput() {
  if (!DAMAGE_DEBUG) return;
  const box = document.getElementById('damageDebugBox');
  const content = document.getElementById('damageDebugContent');
  if (content) content.textContent = '';
  if (box) box.classList.remove('is-visible');
}

function buildDamageDebugMessage(raw, data, res) {
  const parts = [];
  const msg = (data && typeof data.message === 'string') ? data.message.trim() : '';
  if (msg) parts.push(msg);
  if (data && typeof data.req_id === 'string' && data.req_id.trim()) {
    parts.push(`req_id: ${data.req_id.trim()}`);
  }
  const rawText = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : '';
  if (rawText) {
    const normalizedMsg = msg.trim();
    if (!normalizedMsg || rawText !== normalizedMsg) {
      parts.push(rawText);
    }
  }
  if (!parts.length && res) {
    parts.push(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  }
  return parts.join("\n\n");
}

function showDamageDebugFailure(raw, data, res) {
  const debugMsg = buildDamageDebugMessage(raw, data, res) || 'Unknown attack error.';
  setDamageDebugOutput(debugMsg);
  showNotification(
    `<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;">Attack failed</div><div style="max-width:520px;white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:Consolas,Monaco,monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;">${escapeHtml(debugMsg)}</div>`,
    'error'
  );
}

/* EXP cap updater (DOM) */
function updateCapNotice(newDamage) {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('yourStats');
  if (!wrap) return;
  const cont = document.getElementById('capNotice');
  if (!cont) return;

  const maxhp    = Number(wrap.dataset.maxhp || 0);
  const capFrac  = parseFloat(wrap.dataset.capfraction || '0.2');
  const capPerc  = wrap.dataset.capperc || String(Math.round(capFrac * 100));

  if (!maxhp || capFrac <= 0) { cont.innerHTML=''; return; }

  const need = Math.ceil(capFrac * maxhp);
  if (Number(newDamage) >= need) {
    cont.innerHTML =
      `<span class="chip" style="font-size:14px; background:#3b1f1f; border-color:#6a2b2b; color:#ffb3b3;">
         ⚠ EXP cap reached (${capPerc}%). Extra damage won't increase your EXP share.
       </span>`;
  } else {
    cont.innerHTML = '';
  }
}

  "Slow down, you are attacking too quickly"
]);

function isSafeUserMsg(m){
  if (typeof m !== "string") return false;
  const clean = m.trim();
  if (!clean) return false;
  if (SAFE_ERROR_MESSAGES.has(clean)) return true;
  return (
    / is still sealed\.$/.test(clean) ||
    /^This run is .+\. Combat is disabled\.$/.test(clean) ||
    /^Your guild officers have blocked your access to guild dungeons\./.test(clean)
  );
}
function showServerErrorMessage(msg) {
  const clean = (typeof msg === "string") ? msg.trim() : "";
  showNotification(clean ? escapeHtml(clean) : "Server error", "error");
}

function parseDamageJson(raw) {
  const text = String(raw ?? '');
  const trimmed = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
  const candidates = [text, trimmed];
  const firstLine = trimmed.split(/\r?\n/, 1)[0];
  if (firstLine && firstLine.trim().startsWith('{')) {
    candidates.push(firstLine.trim());
  }

  const firstJsonObject = (() => {
    const start = trimmed.indexOf('{');
    if (start < 0) return '';
    let depth = 0;
    let inString = false;
    let escaped = false;
    for (let i = start; i < trimmed.length; i++) {
      const ch = trimmed[i];
      if (inString) {
        if (escaped) {
          escaped = false;
        } else if (ch === '\\') {
          escaped = true;
        } else if (ch === '"') {
          inString = false;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '"') {
        inString = true;
      } else if (ch === '{') {
        depth++;
      } else if (ch === '}') {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) {
          return trimmed.slice(start, i + 1);
        }
      }
    }
    return '';
  })();
  if (firstJsonObject) {
    candidates.push(firstJsonObject);
  }

  const firstBrace = trimmed.indexOf('{');
  const lastBrace = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
  if (firstBrace >= 0 && lastBrace > firstBrace) {
    candidates.push(trimmed.slice(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1));
  }

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (!candidate) continue;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(candidate);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  return null;
}

function formatAttackFailureMessage(raw, res, err) {
  if (err) {
    const errMsg = ((err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown attack error')).trim();
    return 'Attack request failed: ' + (errMsg || 'Unknown attack error');
  }

  const statusText = res && res.status ? ('HTTP ' + res.status) : 'unknown status';
  const cleanRaw = String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!cleanRaw) {
    return 'Invalid response from damage.php (' + statusText + ').';
  }

  const snippet = cleanRaw.slice(0, 180);
  return 'Invalid response from damage.php (' + statusText + '): ' + snippet;
}

function setHtmlIfExists(id, html) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.innerHTML = html;
}

function setStyleIfExists(id, prop, value) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.style[prop] = value;
}

function setDuplicateIdText(id, text) {
  document.querySelectorAll(`[id="${id}"]`).forEach(el => {
    el.textContent = text;
  });
}

function refreshPlayerMonsterDebuffs() {
  const target = document.getElementById('playerMonsterDebuffsBody');
  if (!target || IS_DG) return;

  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('debuffs_json', '1');
  fetch(url.toString(), {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
    cache: 'no-store'
  })
    .then(res => res.ok ? res.json() : null)
    .then(data => {
      if (data && data.ok && typeof data.html === 'string') {
        target.innerHTML = data.html;
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {});
}

function updateAttackSuccessUI(data) {
  showNotification(data.message, 'success');
  animateMonster();

  const hp = data && data.hp ? data.hp : {};
  const hpPercent = Number(hp.percent);
  if (Number.isFinite(hpPercent)) {
    setStyleIfExists('hpFill', 'width', hpPercent + '%');
  }
  if (typeof data.stamina !== 'undefined') {
    setHtmlIfExists('stamina_span', new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(data.stamina) || 0));
  }
  if (typeof hp.value !== 'undefined' && typeof hp.max !== 'undefined') {
    setHtmlIfExists('hpText', `❤️ ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(hp.value) || 0)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(hp.max) || 0)} HP`);
  }

  if (typeof data.mana === 'number') {
    const manaVal = Math.max(0, Math.min(PLAYER_MAX_MANA, data.mana));
    const manaPct = PLAYER_MAX_MANA > 0 ? (manaVal / PLAYER_MAX_MANA) * 100 : 0;
    setStyleIfExists('pManaFill', 'width', manaPct + '%');
    setHtmlIfExists('pManaText', `💠 ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(manaVal)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(PLAYER_MAX_MANA)} MP`);
  }

  if (data.phase && data.phase.image) {
    const imgEl = document.getElementById('monsterImage');
    if (imgEl) imgEl.src = data.phase.image;
  }

  if (data.retaliation && typeof data.retaliation.user_hp_after === 'number') {
    const afterHP = data.retaliation.user_hp_after;
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (afterHP / PLAYER_MAX_HP) * 100));
    setStyleIfExists('pHpFill', 'width', pct + '%');
    setHtmlIfExists('pHpText', `💚 ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(afterHP)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(PLAYER_MAX_HP)} HP`);
  }

  if ((!data.phase || !data.phase.changed) && Number(hp.value) <= 0) {
    location.reload();
    return;
  }

  const leaderboardRows = Array.isArray(data.leaderboard) ? data.leaderboard : [];
  const lbHtml =
    '<strong>📊 Attackers Leaderboard</strong>' +
    '<div class="lb-list">' +
    leaderboardRows.map((row, i) => {
      const picture = (typeof row.PICTURE === 'string' && row.PICTURE.trim()) ? row.PICTURE : 'images/default_avatar.png';
      const username = escapeHtml(row.USERNAME || 'Unknown');
      const playerId = Number(row.ID) || 0;
      return `
        <div class="lb-row">
          <span class="lb-rank">#${i + 1}</span>
          <img class="lb-avatar" src="${escapeHtml(picture)}" alt="">
          <span class="lb-name">
            <a style="color:white;" href="player.php?pid=${playerId}">${username}</a>
          </span>
          <span class="lb-dmg">${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(row.DAMAGE_DEALT) || 0)} DMG</span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('') +
    '</div>';
  const leaderboardPanel = document.querySelector('.leaderboard-panel');
  if (leaderboardPanel) leaderboardPanel.innerHTML = lbHtml;

  let totalDamageValue = null;
  if (typeof data.totaldmgdealt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(data.totaldmgdealt)) {
    totalDamageValue = Number(data.totaldmgdealt);
  } else if (USER_ID) {
    const myRow = leaderboardRows.find(r => Number(r.ID) === Number(USER_ID));
    if (myRow && typeof myRow.DAMAGE_DEALT !== 'undefined') {
      totalDamageValue = Number(myRow.DAMAGE_DEALT);
    }
  }
  if (totalDamageValue !== null && Number.isFinite(totalDamageValue)) {
    setDuplicateIdText('yourDamageValue', new Intl.NumberFormat().format(totalDamageValue));
    updateCapNotice(totalDamageValue);
  }

  const logs = Array.isArray(data.logs) ? data.logs : [];
  const logHtml =
    '<strong>📜 Attack Log</strong><br>' +
    logs.map(row => {
      const extra = row.EXTRA_INFO !== "NONE" ? ` (${escapeHtml(row.EXTRA_INFO || '')})` : "";
      return `⚔️ ${escapeHtml(row.USERNAME || 'Unknown')} used ${escapeHtml(row.SKILL_NAME || 'Slash')}${extra} for ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(row.DAMAGE) || 0)} DMG!<br>`;
    }).join('');
  const logPanel = document.querySelector('.log-panel');
  if (logPanel) logPanel.innerHTML = logHtml;

  if (typeof data.xp_delta === 'number') {
    addExpUI(data.xp_delta);
  } else {
    addExpUI(10);
  }

  refreshPlayerMonsterDebuffs();
}


</script>

<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('damageDebugClose');
    if (closeBtn) {
      closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => clearDamageDebugOutput());
    }
  }

  const rewardIntroModal = document.getElementById('monsterRewardInfoModal');
  if (rewardIntroModal) {
    const rewardModalCookieName = 'battle_rank_rewards_seen_day';
    const todayKey = getDailyCookieKey();
    if (getCookie(rewardModalCookieName) !== todayKey) {
      rewardIntroModal.style.display = 'flex';
      setCookie(rewardModalCookieName, todayKey, 7 * 86400);
    }
    rewardIntroModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === rewardIntroModal) {
        closeMonsterRewardInfoModal();
      }
    });
  }

  // attach attack button handlers
  document.querySelectorAll('.attack-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const skillName = (btn.getAttribute('data-skill-name') || '').toLowerCase();

      // decide FX mode
      let fxMode = 'slash';
      if (skillName.includes('ultimate'))   fxMode = 'ultimate';
      else if (skillName.includes('world')) fxMode = 'world';
      else if (skillName.includes('legend')) fxMode = 'legend';
      else if (skillName.includes('heroic')) fxMode = 'heroic';
      else if (skillName.includes('power'))  fxMode = 'power';

      // fire visual instantly on tap
      if (!fxIsOff()) triggerSlashFX(fxMode);

      const check = canAttackNow();
      if (!check.ok) {
        const secs = Math.ceil(check.waitMs / 1000);
        showNotification(`⏳ Take your time… ${secs}s`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      setCookie('last_attack', check.now);
      lockAttackButtons(true);
      setTimeout(() => lockAttackButtons(false), 1000);

      const skillId = btn.getAttribute('data-skill-id');
      const cost =
        skillId === "-1" ? 10 :
        skillId === "-2" ? 50 :
        skillId === "-3" ? 100 :
        skillId === "-4" ? 200 :
        skillId === "-5" ? 1000 :
        1;

      const fd = baseQS();
      fd.set('skill_id', skillId);
      fd.set('stamina_cost', String(cost));
      if (IS_DG) {
        fd.set('instance_id', String(BCFG.instanceId));
        fd.set('dgmid', String(BCFG.dgmid));
      }
      if (BCFG.privateBoss && BCFG.privateBoss.enabled) {
        fd.set('csrf_token', String(BCFG.privateBoss.csrf || ''));
        fd.set(
          'request_token',
          (window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === 'function')
            ? window.crypto.randomUUID()
            : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`
        );
      }

      const attackPayload = fd.toString();
      const runAttackRequest = (attempt = 1) => {
        fetch(ep('ATTACK'), {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
          body: attackPayload
        })
        .then(async res => {
          const raw = await res.text();
          const data = parseDamageJson(raw);
          return { res, raw, data };
        })
        .then(({ res, raw, data }) => {
          const msg = (data && typeof data.message === 'string') ? data.message.trim() : '';

          if (msg === 'Invalid request.' && attempt < 2) {
            setTimeout(() => runAttackRequest(attempt + 1), 350);
            return;
          }

          if (!res.ok || !data) {
            if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
              showDamageDebugFailure(raw, data, res);
            } else {
              showServerErrorMessage(msg || formatAttackFailureMessage(raw, res, null));
            }
            return;
          }

          if (String(data.status).trim() === 'success') {
            clearDamageDebugOutput();
            try {
              updateAttackSuccessUI(data);
            } catch (uiErr) {
              showNotification(data.message || 'Attack succeeded.', 'success');
              if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
                const uiMsg = 'Attack succeeded, but the battle page UI failed to update: ' +
                  ((uiErr && uiErr.message) ? uiErr.message : String(uiErr));
                setDamageDebugOutput(uiMsg);
              }
            }
            if (data.private_boss && data.private_boss.redirect_url) {
              window.setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.assign(String(data.private_boss.redirect_url));
              }, 450);
            }
          } else {
            if (msg === "Monster is already dead.") {
              location.reload();
            } else if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
              showDamageDebugFailure(raw, data, res);
            } else {
              showServerErrorMessage(msg);
            }
          }
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
            showDamageDebugFailure((err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Unknown attack error.', null, null);
          } else {
            showServerErrorMessage(formatAttackFailureMessage('', null, err));
          }
        });
      };

      runAttackRequest();
    });
  });

  // attach join button handler
  const joinBtn = document.getElementById('join-battle');
  if (joinBtn) {
    joinBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        const p = baseQS();
p.set('user_id', '159129');

const res = await fetch(ep('JOIN'), {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body: p.toString()
});

        const msgRaw = await res.text();
        const msg = (msgRaw || '').trim();
        const ok = msg.toLowerCase().startsWith('you have successfully');
        showNotification(msg || 'Unknown response', ok ? 'success' : 'error');
        if (ok) setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 900);
      } catch (e) {
        showNotification('Server error. Please try again.', 'error');
      }
    });
  }

}); // end DOMContentLoaded

function computeReqExp(level) {
  return Math.round(100 + Math.pow(2.5 * (level + 1), 2));
}
function addExpUI(amount) {
  const expTop  = document.querySelector('.gtb-exp-top span:last-child');
  const expFill = document.querySelector('.gtb-exp-fill');
  const lvlEl   = document.querySelector('.gtb-level');
  if (!expTop || !expFill || !lvlEl) return;
  let level = parseInt(lvlEl.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10) || 0;
  let [current, required] = expTop.textContent.split('/').map(s => parseInt(s.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10));
  if (!isFinite(current) || !isFinite(required)) return;
  current += amount;
  required = computeReqExp(level);
  while (current >= required) {
    current -= required;
    level += 1;
    required = computeReqExp(level);
  }
  lvlEl.textContent = 'LV ' + level;
  expTop.textContent = `${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(current)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(required)}`;
  expFill.style.width = Math.min(100, (current / required) * 100) + '%';
}

// loot claim handler (fixed, single promise chain)
const lootBtn = document.getElementById('loot-button');
let lootRedirectUrl = '';
if (lootBtn) {
  lootBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (lootBtn.disabled) return;
    lootBtn.disabled = true;
    const p = baseQS();
    p.set('user_id', '159129');
    if (BCFG.privateBoss && BCFG.privateBoss.enabled) {
      p.set('csrf_token', String(BCFG.privateBoss.csrf || ''));
      p.set(
        'request_token',
        (window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === 'function')
          ? window.crypto.randomUUID()
          : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`
      );
    }

    fetch(ep('LOOT'), {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: p.toString()
    })
    .then(async res => {
      const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      const raw = await res.text();
      const data = ct.includes('application/json') ? (()=>{ try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return null; } })() : null;
      if (!res.ok || !data) throw new Error(data?.message || raw || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
      return data;
    })
    .then(data => {
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        showNotification(data.message || 'Loot claimed!', 'success');
        lootRedirectUrl = String(data.redirect_url || '');

        const lootContainer = document.getElementById('lootItems');
        const lootNoteEl    = document.getElementById('lootNote');
        const lootRankWrap  = document.getElementById('lootRankWrap');
        const lootRankTitle = document.getElementById('lootRankTitle');
        const lootRankItems = document.getElementById('lootRankRewards');

        if (lootNoteEl) {
          if (data.note && String(data.note).trim()) {
            lootNoteEl.textContent = data.note;
            lootNoteEl.style.display = 'block';
          } else {
            lootNoteEl.textContent = '';
            lootNoteEl.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }

        if (lootContainer) {
          lootContainer.innerHTML = '';
          if (Array.isArray(data.items) && data.items.length) {
            data.items.forEach(item => {
              const qty = Math.max(1, Number(item.QUANTITY || item.quantity || 1));
              const qtyText = new Intl.NumberFormat().format(qty);
              const div = document.createElement('div');
              div.style = 'background:#1e1e2f; border-radius:8px; padding:10px; text-align:center; width:96px;';
              div.innerHTML = `
                <span style="position:relative;display:inline-block;width:64px;height:64px;">
                  <img src="${item.IMAGE_URL}" alt="${item.NAME}" style="width:64px; height:64px;">
                  ${qty > 1 ? `<b style="position:absolute;right:-7px;bottom:-5px;background:#ffd369;color:#1b1300;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 6px;font-size:11px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);">x${qtyText}</b>` : ``}
                </span><br>
                <small>${qty > 1 ? `x${qtyText} ` : ``}${item.NAME}</small>`;
              lootContainer.appendChild(div);
            });
          } else {
            const none = document.createElement('div');
            none.className = 'muted';
            none.style = 'padding:6px 0;';
            none.textContent = 'No items this time.';
            lootContainer.appendChild(none);
          }
        }

        if (lootRankWrap && lootRankItems) {
          lootRankItems.innerHTML = '';
          if (Array.isArray(data.ranking_rewards) && data.ranking_rewards.length) {
            const rankLabel = Number(data.ranking_rank || 0) > 0
              ? `Damage Ranking Rewards (Rank #${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(data.ranking_rank))})`
              : 'Damage Ranking Rewards';
            if (lootRankTitle) {
              lootRankTitle.textContent = rankLabel;
            }
            data.ranking_rewards.forEach(item => {
              const div = document.createElement('div');
              div.style = 'background:#1e1e2f; border-radius:8px; padding:10px; text-align:center; width:96px;';
              div.innerHTML = `
                <img src="${item.IMAGE_URL}" alt="${item.NAME}" style="width:64px; height:64px;"><br>
                <small>x${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(item.QUANTITY || 1))} ${item.NAME}</small>`;
              lootRankItems.appendChild(div);
            });
            lootRankWrap.style.display = 'block';
          } else {
            lootRankWrap.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }

        const modal = document.getElementById('lootModal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        lootBtn.disabled = false;
        showNotification(data.message || 'Failed to loot.', 'error');
      }
    })
    .catch(err => {
      lootBtn.disabled = false;
      showNotification((err && err.message) ? err.message : "Server error", 'error');
    });
  });
}

  const modal = document.getElementById('lootModal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
  if (lootRedirectUrl) {
    window.location.assign(lootRedirectUrl);
  }
}
let extractReloadOnClose = false;

  const modal = document.getElementById('extractModal');

  if (extractReloadOnClose) {

  }

function openExtractFailModal(message) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('extractModal');
  const card  = document.getElementById('extractCard');
  const body  = document.getElementById('extractModalBody');

  if (!modal || !card || !body) return;

  extractReloadOnClose = false;
  card.className = 'extract-card fail';
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="extract-kicker" style="color:#ff9aa6;">Shadow Rejection</div>
    <h2 class="extract-title">Extraction Failed</h2>
    <p class="extract-copy">${escExtractHtml(message || 'The shadow refused your command.')}</p>
    <div class="extract-note">
      The darkness did not answer your call. Strengthen your extraction skill, preserve your daily attempts, and try again on a valid corpse.
    </div>
  `;
  modal.classList.add('show');
}
function escExtractHtml(str) {
  return String(str ?? '')
    .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
    .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
    .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
    .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
    .replaceAll("'", '&#039;');
}

const extractNumFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat();

function fmtNum(value) {
  const num = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(num) ? extractNumFormatter.format(num) : '0';
}

function openExtractSuccessModal(data) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('extractModal');
  const card  = document.getElementById('extractCard');
  const body  = document.getElementById('extractModalBody');

  if (!modal || !card || !body) return;

  const shadow = data.shadow || {};
  const rankHtml = shadow.rank
    ? `<div class="extract-rank">${escExtractHtml(shadow.rank)}</div>`
    : '';

  const extraCopyHtml = shadow.extra_copies_now !== null && shadow.extra_copies_now !== undefined
    ? `<div class="extract-note">Your existing special shadow absorbed this extraction. Extra copies: <strong>${fmtNum(shadow.extra_copies_now)}</strong>.</div>`
    : `<div class="extract-note">A new shadow has joined your army.</div>`;

  const leadHtml = shadow.type === 'special'
    ? `<div class="extract-stat"><span>Leads</span><strong>${fmtNum(shadow.lead_capacity || 0)}</strong></div>`
    : '';

  extractReloadOnClose = true;
  card.className = 'extract-card success';
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="extract-kicker">Arise</div>
    <h2 class="extract-title">Extraction Successful</h2>
    <p class="extract-copy">${escExtractHtml(data.message || 'The dead answered your command.')}</p>

    <div class="extract-unit">
      <div class="extract-art">
        <img src="${escExtractHtml(shadow.image || '')}" alt="">
        <div class="extract-stars">${escExtractHtml(shadow.stars_text || '★')}</div>
      </div>

      <div class="extract-meta">
        <div class="extract-name">${escExtractHtml(shadow.name || 'Shadow')}</div>
        ${rankHtml}

        <div class="extract-stats">
          <div class="extract-stat"><span>Attack</span><strong>${fmtNum(shadow.attack || 0)}</strong></div>
          <div class="extract-stat"><span>Defense</span><strong>${fmtNum(shadow.defense || 0)}</strong></div>
          <div class="extract-stat"><span>Health</span><strong>${fmtNum(shadow.health || 0)}</strong></div>
          ${leadHtml}
        </div>

        ${extraCopyHtml}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  modal.classList.add('show');
}

if (extractModal) {
  extractModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === extractModal) {
      closeExtractModal();

  });

const extractBtn = document.getElementById('extract-shadow-btn');
if (extractBtn) {
  extractBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    extractBtn.disabled = true;

    const body = new URLSearchParams();
    body.set('action', 'extract_shadow');

    fetch(ep('EXTRACT') || window.location.href, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
      body: body.toString()
    })
    .then(async res => {
      const raw = await res.text();
      const data = parseDamageJson(raw);

      if (!res.ok || !data) {
        throw new Error((data && data.message) ? data.message : (raw || `HTTP ${res.status}`));
      }

      return data;
    })
    .then(data => {
      if (!data.ok) {
        extractBtn.disabled = false;
        openExtractFailModal(data.message || 'Extraction failed.');
        return;
      }

      openExtractSuccessModal(data);
    })
    .catch(err => {
      extractBtn.disabled = false;
      openExtractFailModal((err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Server error.');
    });
  });
}

<script>
/* Countdown for timed heal (HH:MM:SS) */
function startHealCountdown(spanId, btnId, readyAtMs, nowMs){
  const span = document.getElementById(spanId);
  const btn  = document.getElementById(btnId);
  if (!span || !btn) return;

  let serverNow = nowMs || Date.now();
  const tw = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  const fmt = s => `${tw(Math.floor(s/3600))}:${tw(Math.floor((s%3600)/60))}:${tw(s%60)}`;

  function tick(){
    const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((readyAtMs - serverNow)/1000));
    if (remaining <= 0){
      span.textContent = '00:00:00';
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.title = 'You can heal now';
      return;
    }
    span.textContent = fmt(remaining);
    serverNow += 1000;
    setTimeout(tick, 1000);
  }
  tick();
}

/* Use Heal Potion */
(function(){
  const btn = document.getElementById('usePotionBtn');
  if (!btn) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
    try{
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Processing…';
      const fd = new URLSearchParams();
      fd.set('user_id', '159129');

      const res = await fetch(ep('HEAL_POTION'), {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body: fd.toString()
});


      const ct  = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      const raw = await res.text();
      let data = null; if (ct.includes('application/json')) { try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch{} }

      if (!res.ok || !data){
        showNotification(data?.message || raw.slice(0,200) || `HTTP ${res.status}`, 'error');
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '🧪 Use Heal Potion';

(function(){
  const btn = document.getElementById('timedHealBtn');
  if (!btn) return;
  btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
    try{
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Healing…';
      const fd = new URLSearchParams();
      fd.set('user_id', '159129');

      // Endpoint name up to you; this one checks:
      // - user CURRENT_HP <= 0
      // - NOW() >= LAST_ATTACK_TIME + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
      // - then restores HP (e.g., to max or a fixed amount)
      const res = await fetch(ep('HEAL'), {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body: fd.toString()
});


      const ct  = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      const raw = await res.text();
      let data = null; if (ct.includes('application/json')) { try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch{} }

      if (!res.ok || !data){
        showNotification(data?.message || raw.slice(0,200) || `HTTP ${res.status}`, 'error');
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '💚 Heal';
        return;
      }
      if (String(data.status).trim()==='success'){
        showNotification(data.message || 'Healed!', 'success');
        setTimeout(()=>location.reload(), 500);
      } else {
        showNotification(data.message || 'Heal not ready yet.', 'error');
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '💚 Heal';
      }
    } catch(e){
      showNotification('Network error.', 'error');
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '💚 Heal';
    }
  });
})();

<script>
function fmtHMS(totalSeconds){
  totalSeconds = Math.max(0, totalSeconds|0);
  const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const s = totalSeconds % 60;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)}`;
}

function startNoDamageCountdown(elId, expiresMs){
  const el = document.getElementById(elId);
  if (!el || !expiresMs) return;

  function tick(){
    const now = Date.now();
    const leftSec = Math.floor((expiresMs - now) / 1000);

    if (leftSec <= 0){
      el.textContent = "00:00:00";
      // Optional: make it obvious it has expired
      el.insertAdjacentText('afterend', ' (expired)');
      clearInterval(tmr);
      return;
    }
    el.textContent = fmtHMS(leftSec);
  }

  tick();
  const tmr = setInterval(tick, 1000);
}
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const cfg = window.AUTO_DIE_CFG;
  if (!cfg || !cfg.nextDieMs || !cfg.serverNowMs) return;

  const el = document.getElementById('autoDieTimer');
  if (!el) return;

  // We anchor to SERVER time at render, then advance using elapsed time.
  const clientLoadMs = Date.now();
  const serverLoadMs = cfg.serverNowMs;

  function pad(n){ return String(n).padStart(2,'0'); }

  function render(){
    const elapsed = Date.now() - clientLoadMs;
    const serverNow = serverLoadMs + elapsed;

    let remainMs = cfg.nextDieMs - serverNow;
    if (remainMs < 0) remainMs = 0;

    const totalSec = Math.floor(remainMs / 1000);
    const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSec % 60;

    el.textContent = `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)}`;

    if (remainMs <= 0) {
      clearInterval(t);
      // optional: show EXPIRED instead
      // el.textContent = "EXPIRED";
    }
  }

  render();
  const t = setInterval(render, 250);
})();
</script>

<script>
const SOURCE = "monster_phase";
const ENCOUNTER_CSRF = "";
const ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT = "";
let encounterRevision = 0;
const SOURCE_PARAMS = {"active_id":"557845671"};
const USER_ID = 159129;
const ROOM_STATUS = "live";
const CAN_CLASH_AUTO_BATTLE = false;
const HAS_SNAPSHOT = true;
const STATE_URL = 'pvp_style_state.php';
const ACTION_URL = 'pvp_style_action.php';
const LOG_DETAILS = {"1":null,"2":null};
const JOIN_HINT_KEY = `veyra_pvp_style_join_hint_seen_v2_${USER_ID}`;
const ROOM_ID = 76912;
const PVP_REWARD_ITEMS = [];
const REWARD_MODAL_KEY = `veyra_pvp_style_reward_seen_room_${ROOM_ID}_${USER_ID}`;

let isMyTurn = false;
let myAlive = false;
let myTokens = 0;
let mySkills = [];
let selectedTargetKey = '';
let selectedTargetName = '—';
let healTargetKey = '';
let healTargetName = '—';
let reviveTargetKey = '';
let reviveTargetName = '—';
let pollMs = 2500;
let pollHandle = null;
let lastLogId = 2;
let currentRoomStatus = ROOM_STATUS;
let currentRoomJoined = true;
let rewardsModalShown = false;
let clashReturnScheduled = false;
let currentAutoBattle = false;

function shouldShowJoinHint() {
  if (currentRoomStatus === 'live') return false;
  if (currentRoomJoined) return false;
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem(JOIN_HINT_KEY) !== '1';
  } catch (error) {
    return true;
  }
}

function closeJoinHint(markSeen = false) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('joinHintModal');
  if (modal) {
    modal.classList.remove('show');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }
  if (markSeen) {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(JOIN_HINT_KEY, '1');
    } catch (error) {
      // ignore storage issues and allow the hint to reappear if needed
    }
  }
}

function maybeShowJoinHint() {
  if (!shouldShowJoinHint()) return;
  const modal = document.getElementById('joinHintModal');
  if (!modal) return;
  modal.classList.add('show');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
}

function forceShowJoinHint() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('joinHintModal');
  if (!modal) return;
  modal.classList.add('show');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
}

function renderRewardItems(items) {
  return (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).map((reward) => {
    const image = reward.image || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
    const qty = Number(reward.qty || 0);
    const rarity = reward.rarity ? `<div class="rewardRarity">${escapeHtml(reward.rarity)}</div>` : '';
    return `
      <div class="rewardCard">
        <img src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="">
        <div class="rewardMeta">
          <div class="rewardName">${escapeHtml(reward.name || 'Reward')}</div>
          <div class="rewardQty">x${escapeHtml(String(qty))}</div>
          ${rarity}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function closeRewardsModal(markSeen = false) {
  const modal = document.getElementById('rewardsModal');
  if (modal) {
    modal.classList.remove('show');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }
  if (markSeen) {
    rewardsModalShown = true;
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(REWARD_MODAL_KEY, '1');
    } catch (error) {
      // ignore storage issues
    }
  }
}

function maybeShowRewardsModal(state) {
  if (rewardsModalShown) return;
  if (!Array.isArray(PVP_REWARD_ITEMS) || !PVP_REWARD_ITEMS.length) return;
  if (!state || !state.match || !state.room_joined) return;
  if (!state.match.ended || String(state.match.winner_side || '') !== 'ally') return;
  if (String(state.room_status || '') !== 'cleared') return;
  try {
    if (window.localStorage.getItem(REWARD_MODAL_KEY) === '1') {
      rewardsModalShown = true;
      return;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore storage issues and still show the modal once in memory
  }
  const modal = document.getElementById('rewardsModal');
  const grid = document.getElementById('rewardsGrid');
  if (!modal || !grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = renderRewardItems(PVP_REWARD_ITEMS);
  modal.classList.add('show');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  rewardsModalShown = true;
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = String(value ?? '');
  return div.innerHTML;
}

function formatNum(value, decimals = 0) {
  const num = Number(value || 0);
  if (decimals > 0) {
    return num.toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
      maximumFractionDigits: decimals
    });
  }
  return Math.round(num).toLocaleString();
}

function formatPct(value, decimals = 1) {
  const pct = Number(value || 0) * 100;
  return `${pct.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals
  })}%`;
}

function detailRows(rows) {
  return `<div class="detailList">${rows.map((row) => `
    <div class="detailRow">
      <div class="detailLabel">${escapeHtml(row.label)}</div>
      <div class="detailValue">${escapeHtml(row.value)}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('')}</div>`;
}

function detailCard(title, bodyHtml, full = false) {
  return `<div class="detailCard${full ? ' full' : ''}">
    <div class="detailTitle">${escapeHtml(title)}</div>
    ${bodyHtml}
  </div>`;
}

function detailStep(title, text) {
  return `<div class="detailStep">
    <div class="detailStepHead">${escapeHtml(title)}</div>
    <div class="detailStepText">${escapeHtml(text)}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function sanitizeLogHTML(value) {
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = String(value || '');
  return div.innerHTML
    .replace(/&lt;(\/?b)&gt;/gi, '<$1>')
    .replace(/&lt;br\s*\/?&gt;/gi, '<br>');
}

function renderAttackDetails(content, details) {
  const actor = details.actor || {};
  const target = details.target || {};
  const skill = details.skill || {};
  const formula = details.formula || {};
  const attackNotes = Array.isArray(formula.attack_notes) ? formula.attack_notes.filter(Boolean) : [];
  const defenseNotes = Array.isArray(formula.defense_notes) ? formula.defense_notes.filter(Boolean) : [];
  const exchangeWinner = String(formula.exchange_winner || '');
  const attackerWon = exchangeWinner === 'attacker';
  const defenderStunned = Number(formula.defender_stunned_before_exchange || 0) > 0;
  const supportFollowup = Number(skill.is_support_followup || formula.support_followup || 0) > 0;
  const supportSourceSkill = String(skill.source_name || formula.support_source_skill_name || skill.name || 'the no-damage skill');
  const skillLabel = supportFollowup ? `Forced Slash (from ${supportSourceSkill})` : (skill.name || '-');
  const armorPenChanged =
    Number(formula.armor_penetration_core_ignored || 0) > 0 ||
    Number(formula.armor_penetration_eq_ignored || 0) > 0 ||
    Number(formula.armor_penetration_pet_ignored || 0) > 0;
  const stepCards = [
    detailStep(
      'Attack Build',
      `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} begins with ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_base)} raw core attack. Pre-battle pet, equipment, and guild effects shift that by ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_legacy_bonus)} to ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_before_live_buffs)} before temporary buffs. Formation adds ${formatPct(formula.attack_slot_buff_pct || 0)} and temporary attack buffs add ${formatPct(formula.attack_skill_buff_pct || 0)}, so the effective attack stat used in this exchange is ${formatNum(formula.attack_core_effective)}. Equipment attack contributes ${formatNum(formula.equipment_attack)}${Number(formula.equipment_attack_legacy_bonus || 0) !== 0 ? `, including ${formatNum(formula.equipment_attack_legacy_bonus)} from passive effects` : ''}. Raw pet attack is ${formatNum(formula.pet_attack_raw_total)} and contributes ${formatNum(formula.pet_attack_contribution)} to damage only. The score check uses only base attack and base equipment attack after class passive adjustments.`
    ),
    ...(attackNotes.length ? [detailStep('Attack-Side Buff Sources', attackNotes.join(' '))] : []),
    detailStep(
      'Defense Build',
      `${target.name || 'Target'} begins with ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_base)} raw core defense. Pre-battle pet, equipment, and guild effects shift that by ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_legacy_bonus)} to ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_before_live_buffs)} before temporary buffs. Formation adds ${formatPct(formula.defense_slot_buff_pct || 0)} and temporary defense buffs add ${formatPct(formula.defense_skill_buff_pct || 0)}, so the effective defense stat used in this exchange is ${formatNum(formula.defense_core_effective)}. Equipment defense contributes ${formatNum(formula.equipment_defense)}${Number(formula.equipment_defense_legacy_bonus || 0) !== 0 ? `, including ${formatNum(formula.equipment_defense_legacy_bonus)} from passive effects` : ''}. Raw pet defense is ${formatNum(formula.pet_defense_raw_total)} and contributes ${formatNum(formula.pet_defense_contribution)} to damage back only.${armorPenChanged ? ` Armor penetration reduced defense values from core ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_defense_core_raw)}, equipment ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_equipment_defense_raw)}, and pet ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_pet_defense_raw_total)} to ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_defense_core_used)}, ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_equipment_defense_used)}, and ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_pet_defense_used_total)} before damage back was calculated.` : ''} The score check uses only base defense and base equipment defense after class passive adjustments.`
    ),
    ...(defenseNotes.length ? [detailStep('Defense-Side Buff Sources', defenseNotes.join(' '))] : []),
    detailStep(
      'Score Inputs vs Damage Back',
      `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} score = ${formatNum(formula.score_attacker_attack_core ?? formula.attack_core_base)} base attack after class passive + 50% of ${formatNum(formula.score_attacker_equipment_attack ?? formula.equipment_attack_base)} base equipment attack = ${formatNum(formula.exchange_attacker_score, 2)}. ${target.name || 'Target'} score = ${formatNum(formula.score_defender_defense_core ?? formula.defense_core_base)} base defense after class passive + 50% of ${formatNum(formula.score_defender_equipment_defense ?? formula.equipment_defense_base)} base equipment defense = ${formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_score, 2)}. Pets, guild bonuses, equipment passives, formation bonuses, temporary buffs, and armor penetration do not enter this score.${defenderStunned ? ` ${target.name || 'The defender'} was already stunned at the start of this exchange, so retaliation was suppressed entirely.` : ''}`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Exchange Score',
      `The higher score picks the rule for this hit. The score difference was ${formatNum(formula.exchange_advantage_score, 2)}, so the ${attackerWon ? 'attacker' : 'defender'} won the score phase.`
    ),
    ...(supportFollowup ? [detailStep('Forced Slash Trigger', `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} used ${supportSourceSkill}, which does not deal direct damage in PvP. That no-damage skill forced a slash exchange against ${target.name || 'the target'}.`)] : []),
    detailStep(
      'Base Exchange Damage',
      attackerWon
? `Because the attacker won the score check, base target damage uses attack core + 20% pet attack + equipment attack, while damage back uses 30% defense core + 20% pet defense + 50% equipment defense from ${target.name || 'the defender'}. That creates ${formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_base)} base damage to the target and ${formatNum(formula.exchange_self_damage_base)} base damage back to the attacker.${defenderStunned ? ` Because ${target.name || 'the defender'} was stunned, that damage back was overridden to 0 for this exchange.` : ''}`
: `Because the defender won the score check, base target damage uses 50% attack core + 20% pet attack + 50% equipment attack, while damage back uses 60% defense core + 20% pet defense + full equipment defense from ${target.name || 'the defender'}. That creates ${formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_base)} base damage to the target and ${formatNum(formula.exchange_self_damage_base)} base damage back to the attacker.${defenderStunned ? ` Because ${target.name || 'the defender'} was stunned, that damage back was overridden to 0 for this exchange.` : ''}`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Skill And Multipliers',
      `${supportFollowup ? `${supportSourceSkill} did not add direct skill damage, so this follow-up used a normal slash exchange before multipliers.` : `${formatNum(formula.skill_extra_damage)} extra skill damage is added to the target side only, moving target damage to ${formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_after_skill)} before multipliers.`} Outgoing damage then pushes the target side to ${formatNum(formula.after_outgoing_target_damage)}. Power Slash applies x${formatNum(formula.power_slash_multiplier, 2)} to both sides, the turn bonus applies x${formatNum(formula.turn_bonus_multiplier, 2)} to both sides (${formatNum(formula.turn_bonus_steps || 0)} step(s), every ${formatNum(formula.turn_bonus_interval || 10)} turns), and the match pacing multiplier applies x${formatNum(formula.global_damage_multiplier || 1, 2)} to both sides, leaving ${formatNum(formula.pre_critical_target_damage)} target damage before the crit check and ${formatNum(formula.pre_critical_self_damage ?? formula.self_damage_input)} damage back from the defender before shields${defenderStunned ? ', which stays at 0 because the defender was stunned' : ''}. Attacker crits only multiply target damage, not damage back.`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Critical Check',
      Number(formula.critical_triggered || 0)
        ? `Critical chance was ${formatPct(formula.critical_chance || 0)} and it triggered, multiplying target damage by x${formatNum(formula.critical_multiplier, 2)} to ${formatNum(formula.target_damage_input)} before shields.`
        : `Critical chance was ${formatPct(formula.critical_chance || 0)} and it did not trigger, so target damage stayed at ${formatNum(formula.target_damage_input)} before shields.`
    ),
    detailStep(
      'Shield And HP',
      `${target.name || 'Target'} blocks ${formatNum(formula.target_blocked)} with shield and takes ${formatNum(formula.target_damage_dealt)} HP damage. ${Number(formula.self_damage_input || 0) > 0 || Number(formula.self_blocked || 0) > 0 || Number(formula.self_damage_dealt || 0) > 0 ? `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} also takes ${formatNum(formula.self_damage_input)} damage back from ${target.name || 'the defender'}, with ${formatNum(formula.self_blocked)} blocked and ${formatNum(formula.self_damage_dealt)} dealt.` : defenderStunned ? `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} takes no damage back because ${target.name || 'the defender'} was stunned before the exchange.` : `${actor.name || 'Attacker'} takes no damage back from ${target.name || 'the defender'}.`}`
    )
  ].join('');

  return `<div class="detailGrid">
    ${detailCard('Log Entry', `<div class="detailSummary">${escapeHtml(content)}</div>`, true)}
    ${detailCard('Summary', detailRows([
      { label: 'Actor', value: actor.name || '-' },
      { label: 'Target', value: target.name || '-' },
      { label: 'Skill', value: skillLabel },
      { label: 'Auto Action', value: details.auto ? 'Yes' : 'No' }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Exchange Score', detailRows([
      { label: 'Attacker Score', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_attacker_score, 2) },
      { label: 'Defender Score', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_defender_score, 2) },
      { label: 'Advantage', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_advantage_score, 2) },
      { label: 'Winner', value: exchangeWinner ? `${exchangeWinner.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${exchangeWinner.slice(1)}` : '-' }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Outcome', detailRows([
      { label: 'Target HP', value: `${formatNum(target.hp_before)} -> ${formatNum(target.hp_after)}` },
      { label: 'Target Shield', value: `${formatNum(target.shield_before)} -> ${formatNum(target.shield_after)}` },
      { label: 'Attacker HP', value: `${formatNum(actor.hp_before)} -> ${formatNum(actor.hp_after)}` },
      { label: 'Attacker Shield', value: `${formatNum(actor.shield_before)} -> ${formatNum(actor.shield_after)}` }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Damage Numbers', detailRows([
      { label: 'Base Target Damage', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_target_damage_base) },
      { label: 'Base Damage Back', value: formatNum(formula.exchange_self_damage_base) },
      { label: 'Skill Bonus', value: formatNum(formula.skill_extra_damage) },
      { label: 'Target Damage Before Shields', value: formatNum(formula.target_damage_input) },
      { label: 'Damage Back Before Shields', value: formatNum(formula.self_damage_input) },
      { label: 'Blocked By Target', value: formatNum(formula.target_blocked) },
      { label: 'Final Target Damage', value: formatNum(formula.target_damage_dealt) },
      { label: 'Final Damage Back', value: formatNum(formula.self_damage_dealt) }
    ]))}
    ${detailCard('Formula Steps', `<div class="detailSteps">${stepCards}</div>`, true)}
  </div>`;
}
