function renderLogDetail(content, details) {
  if (!details || typeof details !== 'object') {
    return `<div class="detailGrid">
      ${detailCard('Log Entry', `<div class="detailSummary">${escapeHtml(content)}</div>`, true)}
      ${detailCard('Details', `<div class="detailNote">This entry is informational only, or it was created before detailed combat math was attached to the log. New damage, heal, revive, and skill-trigger lines will show their breakdown here.</div>`, true)}
    </div>`;
  }
  switch (details.kind) {
    case 'attack':
      return renderAttackDetails(content, details);
    case 'splash':
      return renderSplashDetails(content, details);
    case 'npc_skill_damage':
      return renderNpcSkillDamageDetails(content, details);
    case 'heal':
      return renderHealDetails(content, details);
    case 'revive':
      return renderReviveDetails(content, details);
    case 'support':
    case 'npc_support':
      return renderSupportDetails(content, details);
    default:
      return `<div class="detailGrid">
        ${detailCard('Log Entry', `<div class="detailSummary">${escapeHtml(content)}</div>`, true)}
        ${detailCard('Stored Data', `<pre class="detailNote" style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin:0;">${escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(details, null, 2))}</pre>`, true)}
      </div>`;
  }
}

function showToast(message) {
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  toast.textContent = message;
  toast.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
}

function closeLogDetail() {
  document.getElementById('logDetailModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openLogDetail(logLine) {
  if (!logLine) return;
  const logId = String(logLine.dataset.logId || '');
  const content = logLine.querySelector('.logText')?.textContent || '';
  const stamp = logLine.querySelector('.logTime')?.textContent || '-';
  const details = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(LOG_DETAILS, logId) ? LOG_DETAILS[logId] : null;
  document.getElementById('logDetailTime').textContent = stamp || '-';
  const body = document.getElementById('logDetailBody');
  body.innerHTML = renderLogDetail(content, details);
  body.scrollTop = 0;
  document.getElementById('logDetailModal').classList.add('show');
}

function clearTarget() {
  selectedTargetKey = '';
  selectedTargetName = '—';
  document.getElementById('targetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  document.getElementById('modalTargetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  document.querySelectorAll('#topTeamCard .pSlot.targeted').forEach((slot) => slot.classList.remove('targeted'));
}

function roomAction(action, extra = {}) {
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    source: SOURCE,
    action
  });
  Object.entries(SOURCE_PARAMS || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => body.set(key, String(value)));
  Object.entries(extra).forEach(([key, value]) => body.set(key, String(value)));
  if ((SOURCE === 'event' || SOURCE === 'event_army') && ENCOUNTER_CSRF) {
    body.set('csrf', ENCOUNTER_CSRF);
    body.set('encounter_attempt', ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT);
    if (SOURCE === 'event_army') body.set('encounter_revision', String(encounterRevision));
  }
  return fetch(ACTION_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    body: body.toString()
  }).then(async (res) => {
    const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!res.ok || !json || !json.ok) {
      throw new Error((json && (json.error || json.message)) ? (json.error || json.message) : `Action failed (${res.status})`);
    }
    if (json.state && Number.isInteger(json.state.encounter_revision)) {
      encounterRevision = Math.max(encounterRevision, json.state.encounter_revision);
    }
    return json;
  });
}

function closeSkills() {
  document.getElementById('skillsModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openSkills() {
  const hasSelfSkill = mySkills.some((skill) => skill.target === 'self');
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose skills manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Not your turn.');
    return;
  }
  if (!selectedTargetKey && !hasSelfSkill) {
    showToast('Click an enemy card to select your target.');
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('modalTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  document.getElementById('modalTargetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  refreshSkillPanels();
  document.getElementById('skillsModal').classList.add('show');
  refreshSkillDisabled();
}

function openHeal(targetKey, targetName) {
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose skills manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Not your turn.');
    return;
  }
  const healSkills = mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_alive');
  if (!healSkills.length) {
    showToast("You don't have any heal skill.");
    return;
  }
  healTargetKey = targetKey;
  healTargetName = targetName || 'Ally';
  document.getElementById('healTargetName').textContent = healTargetName;
  document.getElementById('healTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  refreshSkillPanels();
  document.getElementById('healModal').classList.add('show');
  refreshHealDisabled();
}

function closeHeal() {
  document.getElementById('healModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function openRevive(targetKey, targetName) {
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose skills manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Not your turn.');
    return;
  }
  const reviveSkills = mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_dead');
  if (!reviveSkills.length) {
    showToast("You don't have any revive skill.");
    return;
  }
  reviveTargetKey = targetKey;
  reviveTargetName = targetName || 'Ally';
  document.getElementById('reviveTargetName').textContent = reviveTargetName;
  document.getElementById('reviveTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  refreshSkillPanels();
  document.getElementById('reviveModal').classList.add('show');
  refreshReviveDisabled();
}

function closeRevive() {
  document.getElementById('reviveModal').classList.remove('show');
}

function createSkillButton(skill, clickHandler) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.type = 'button';
  button.className = 'skillCard';
  button.dataset.skillId = String(skill.id);
  button.dataset.cost = String(skill.cost || 0);
  button.dataset.needsTarget = skill.target === 'enemy' ? '1' : '0';
  button.addEventListener('click', clickHandler);

  const metaLabel = skill.target === 'ally_alive'
    ? 'Heal'
    : (skill.target === 'ally_dead' ? 'Revive' : (skill.target === 'self' ? 'Self Cast' : 'Active'));

  button.innerHTML = `
    <div class="skillTop">
      <img class="skillIco" src="${sanitizeLogHTML(skill.icon || 'images/skills/slash.webp')}" alt="">
      <div class="skillName">${sanitizeLogHTML(skill.name || 'Skill')}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="skillMeta">
      <span class="chip">${metaLabel}</span>
      <span class="chip">Cost: ×${parseInt(skill.cost || 0, 10)}</span>
    </div>
  `;
  return button;
}

function refreshSkillPanels() {
  const attackGrid = document.getElementById('skillsGrid');
  const healGrid = document.getElementById('healGrid');
  const reviveGrid = document.getElementById('reviveGrid');
  attackGrid.innerHTML = '';
  healGrid.innerHTML = '';
  reviveGrid.innerHTML = '';

  mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'enemy' || skill.target === 'self').forEach((skill) => {
    attackGrid.appendChild(createSkillButton(skill, () => useSkill(String(skill.id))));
  });
  mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_alive').forEach((skill) => {
    healGrid.appendChild(createSkillButton(skill, () => useHealSkill(String(skill.id))));
  });
  mySkills.filter((skill) => skill.target === 'ally_dead').forEach((skill) => {
    reviveGrid.appendChild(createSkillButton(skill, () => useReviveSkill(String(skill.id))));
  });
}

function refreshSkillDisabled() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#skillsGrid button.skillCard').forEach((button) => {
    const cost = parseInt(button.dataset.cost || '0', 10);
    const needsTarget = button.dataset.needsTarget === '1';
    button.disabled = (currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive || myTokens < cost || (needsTarget && !selectedTargetKey));
  });
}

function refreshHealDisabled() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#healGrid button.skillCard').forEach((button) => {
    const cost = parseInt(button.dataset.cost || '0', 10);
    button.disabled = (currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive || !healTargetKey || myTokens < cost);
  });
}

function refreshReviveDisabled() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#reviveGrid button.skillCard').forEach((button) => {
    const cost = parseInt(button.dataset.cost || '0', 10);
    button.disabled = (currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive || !reviveTargetKey || myTokens < cost);
  });
}

function refreshSurrenderDisabled() {
  const button = document.getElementById('surrenderBtn');
  if (!button) return;
  button.disabled = (currentRoomStatus !== 'live') || (SOURCE === 'cube' && !currentRoomJoined);
}

function refreshRetryDisabled() {
  const button = document.getElementById('retryPhaseDuelBtn');
  if (!button) return;
  button.disabled = !(SOURCE === 'monster_phase' || SOURCE === 'hermes') || currentRoomStatus !== 'lost';
}

function refreshAutoBattleButton(state = null) {
  const button = document.getElementById('autoBattleBtn');
  if (!button) return;
  const ended = !!(state && state.match && state.match.ended);
  const enabled = !!(state && state.match && state.match.auto_play);
  button.disabled = !CAN_CLASH_AUTO_BATTLE || currentRoomStatus !== 'live' || ended;
  button.classList.toggle('autoOn', enabled);
  button.textContent = enabled ? 'Auto Battle On' : 'Auto Battle';
}

function refreshAutoBattlePolling(enabled, ended = false) {
  const nextPollMs = (SOURCE === 'clash' && enabled && !ended) ? 1100 : 2500;
  if (pollMs === nextPollMs) return;
  pollMs = nextPollMs;
  restartPolling();
}

async function useSkill(skillId) {
  try {
    const res = await roomAction('use_skill', { skill_id: skillId, target_key: selectedTargetKey });
    showToast(res.message || 'Action success!');
    closeSkills();
    await tick();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Action failed.');
  } finally {
    refreshSkillDisabled();
    refreshHealDisabled();
    refreshReviveDisabled();
  }
}

async function useHealSkill(skillId) {
  try {
    const res = await roomAction('use_skill', { skill_id: skillId, target_key: healTargetKey });
    showToast(res.message || 'Heal success!');
    closeHeal();
    await tick();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Heal failed.');
  } finally {
    refreshHealDisabled();
  }
}

async function useReviveSkill(skillId) {
  try {
    const res = await roomAction('use_skill', { skill_id: skillId, target_key: reviveTargetKey });
    showToast(res.message || 'Revive success!');
    closeRevive();
    await tick();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'Revive failed.');
  } finally {
    refreshReviveDisabled();
  }
}

function applySlot(side, slot, pdata, currentKey) {
  const el = document.getElementById(`slot_${side}_${slot}`);
  if (!el) return;

  const img = el.querySelector('img.pfp');
  const name = el.querySelector('.uname');
  const hpFill = el.querySelector('.hpFill');
  const hpVal = el.querySelector('.hpVal');
  const hpMaxVal = el.querySelector('.hpMaxVal');
  const tokChip = el.querySelector('.tokChip');
  const aliveTag = el.querySelector('.aliveTag');
  const buff = el.querySelector('.buff');
  const defaultBuff = el.dataset.defaultBuff || '';

  el.classList.remove('turn', 'targeted', 'dead', 'joinable');
  el.dataset.key = '';
  el.dataset.userId = '0';
  el.dataset.alive = '0';
  el.dataset.username = '';
  img.src = '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
  name.textContent = 'Empty';
  hpFill.style.width = '0%';
  hpVal.textContent = '0';
  hpMaxVal.textContent = '1';
  tokChip.textContent = side === 'ally' ? '⚔️ 0' : '🛡️ 0';
  aliveTag.textContent = 'EMPTY';
  buff.textContent = defaultBuff;

  if (!pdata || !pdata.key) {
    if (side === 'ally' && currentRoomStatus !== 'live' && !currentRoomJoined) {
      el.classList.add('joinable');
      name.textContent = 'Open Slot';
      hpVal.textContent = '-';
      hpMaxVal.textContent = '-';
      tokChip.textContent = 'OPEN';
      aliveTag.textContent = 'JOIN';
      buff.textContent = defaultBuff;
      return;
    }
    el.classList.add('dead');
    return;
  }

  const alive = !!pdata.alive;
  el.dataset.key = pdata.key || '';
  el.dataset.userId = String(pdata.user_id || 0);
  el.dataset.alive = alive ? '1' : '0';
  el.dataset.username = pdata.username || '';
  img.src = pdata.picture || '/images/monsters/not_set.webp';
  name.textContent = pdata.username || 'Unknown';
  hpFill.style.width = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(((pdata.hp || 0) * 100) / Math.max(1, pdata.hp_max || 1))))}%`;
  hpVal.textContent = String(pdata.hp || 0);
  hpMaxVal.textContent = String(pdata.hp_max || 0);
  tokChip.textContent = side === 'ally' ? `⚔️ ${pdata.tokens || 0}` : `🛡️ ${pdata.shield || 0}`;
  aliveTag.textContent = alive ? 'ALIVE' : 'OUT';
  buff.textContent = pdata.effect_badge ? (defaultBuff ? `${defaultBuff} • ${pdata.effect_badge}` : pdata.effect_badge) : defaultBuff;

  if (!alive) {
    el.classList.add('dead');
  }
  if ((pdata.key || '') === currentKey) {
    el.classList.add('turn');
  }
  if (selectedTargetKey && selectedTargetKey === pdata.key) {
    el.classList.add('targeted');
  }
}

function appendLogs(rows) {
  const box = document.getElementById('logBox');
  const empty = document.getElementById('emptyLog');
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) {
    return;
  }
  if (empty) {
    empty.remove();
  }
  rows.forEach((row) => {
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'logLine';
    line.dataset.logId = String(row.id || 0);
    line.tabIndex = 0;
    line.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    line.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open battle log details');
    LOG_DETAILS[String(row.id || 0)] = row.details || null;

    const text = document.createElement('div');
    text.className = 'logText';
    text.innerHTML = sanitizeLogHTML(row.content || '');

    const time = document.createElement('div');
    time.className = 'logTime';
    time.textContent = row.datetime || '';

    line.appendChild(text);
    line.appendChild(time);
    box.appendChild(line);
    lastLogId = Math.max(lastLogId, parseInt(row.id || 0, 10));
  });
  while (box.children.length > 80) {
    box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
  }
  box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
}

async function fetchState() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ source: SOURCE, since_log_id: String(lastLogId) });
  Object.entries(SOURCE_PARAMS || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => params.set(key, String(value)));
  const res = await fetch(`${STATE_URL}?${params.toString()}`, {
    credentials: 'same-origin'
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !json || !json.ok) {
    throw new Error((json && (json.error || json.message)) ? (json.error || json.message) : `State error (${res.status})`);
  }
  return json;
}

function updateUI(state) {
  if (Number.isInteger(state.encounter_revision) && state.encounter_attempt === ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT) {
    encounterRevision = Math.max(encounterRevision, state.encounter_revision);
  }
  const turn = state.turn || {};
  const me = state.me || {};
  const ended = !!(state.match && state.match.ended);
  const autoBattle = SOURCE === 'clash' && !!(state.match && state.match.auto_play);
  const currentKey = turn.key || '';
  const roomStatus = state.room_status || ROOM_STATUS;
  const roomJoined = !!state.room_joined;
  const roomSlot = parseInt(state.room_slot || 0, 10);
  currentRoomStatus = roomStatus;
  currentRoomJoined = roomJoined;
  currentAutoBattle = autoBattle;
  if (roomJoined || roomStatus === 'live' || ended) {
    closeJoinHint(true);
  }
  maybeShowRewardsModal(state);

  isMyTurn = !!(me.in_match && turn.user_id === USER_ID && turn.side === 'ally' && !ended);
  myAlive = !!me.alive;
  myTokens = parseInt(me.tokens || 0, 10);
  mySkills = Array.isArray(me.skills) ? me.skills : [];
  updateClashFatigue(state.clash_fatigue || null);

  document.getElementById('turnWho').textContent = turn.username || '—';
  document.getElementById('turnMeta').textContent = turn.side ? `${turn.side === 'ally' ? 'Allied' : 'Enemy'} turn • Slot ${turn.num_in_formation || '?'}` : 'Waiting for launch.';
  document.getElementById('turnTimer').textContent = String(turn.seconds_left || 0).padStart(2, '0');
  document.getElementById('turnTimer').classList.toggle('danger', (turn.seconds_left || 0) <= 3);
  document.getElementById('myTokens').textContent = String(myTokens);
  document.getElementById('matchStatusBadge').textContent = ended
    ? ((state.match.winner_side || 'draw') === 'ally'
      ? 'Room cleared'
      : ((SOURCE === 'monster_phase' || SOURCE === 'hermes') && roomStatus === 'lost' ? 'Duel failed - retry available' : 'Trial failed'))
    : (roomStatus === 'live' ? 'Live / Updating' : 'Awaiting launch');

  if (ended) {
    if (SOURCE === 'clash' && !clashReturnScheduled) {
      clashReturnScheduled = true;
      const nextUrl = state.clash_next_url || "battle.php?id=557845671";
      setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = nextUrl; }, 1800);
    }
    if ((SOURCE === 'monster_phase' || SOURCE === 'hermes') && state.match.winner_side === 'enemy' && roomStatus === 'lost') {
      document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'You were defeated. Retry restarts only your own phase duel and heals both sides.';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = (state.match.winner_side === 'ally')
        ? 'The allied team cleared the room.'
        : (state.match.winner_side === 'enemy' ? 'The enemy team held the room. Regroup and try again.' : 'The room ended in a draw.');
    }
  } else if (roomStatus !== 'live') {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = (SOURCE === 'event' || SOURCE === 'event_army' || SOURCE === 'clash')
      ? "You have already cleared this phase duel. Return to the battle page to face the next form."      : (roomJoined
        ? `This match is waiting to start. Your slot #${roomSlot || '?'} is reserved here.`
        : 'This match is waiting to start. Click one empty ally card below to join it.');
  } else if (!me.in_match) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Spectating mode. Joined hunters will take turns here once the room goes live.';
  } else if (!myAlive) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Your hunter is down. You can still spectate the battle.';
  } else if (currentAutoBattle) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Auto Battle is running. The battle AI will pick skills for both sides until you turn it off.';
  } else if (isMyTurn) {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Your turn. Click an enemy card and choose a skill before the timer ends.';
  } else if (turn.side === 'enemy') {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Enemy turn. The NPC strikes after a brief 3-second wind-up.';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('noteText').textContent = 'Waiting for your teammates to act.';
  }

  document.getElementById('bottomBadge').textContent = (SOURCE === 'event' || SOURCE === 'event_army' || SOURCE === 'clash')
    ? 'Your side'
    : ((roomStatus !== 'live' && !ended)
      ? (roomJoined ? `Your slot #${roomSlot || '?'}` : 'Click an empty card to join')
      : (roomJoined ? 'Your side' : 'Guild side'));

  const enemyMap = (((state.teams || {}).enemy || {}).players_by_num) || {};
  const allyMap = (((state.teams || {}).ally || {}).players_by_num) || {};
  (Array.isArray(state.template_numbers) ? state.template_numbers : [1,2,3,4,5]).forEach((slot) => {
    const normalized = parseInt(slot, 10);
    applySlot('enemy', normalized, enemyMap[String(normalized)] || null, currentKey);
    applySlot('ally', normalized, allyMap[String(normalized)] || null, currentKey);
  });

  document.getElementById('attackBtn').disabled = currentAutoBattle || !isMyTurn || !myAlive;
  refreshSkillPanels();
  refreshSkillDisabled();
  refreshHealDisabled();
  refreshReviveDisabled();
  refreshSurrenderDisabled();
  refreshRetryDisabled();
  refreshAutoBattleButton(state);
  refreshAutoBattlePolling(currentAutoBattle, ended);
  appendLogs(state.new_logs || []);
}

function updateClashFatigue(payload) {
  if (SOURCE !== 'clash' || !payload) return;
  const value = Number(payload.fatigue || 0);
  const statReduction = Number(payload.stat_reduction_pct || value);
  const damageTaken = Number(payload.damage_received_increase_pct || (value * 2));
  const healingReduction = Number(payload.healing_reduction_pct || value);
  const valueEl = document.getElementById('clashFatigueValue');
  const textEl = document.getElementById('clashFatigueText');
  if (valueEl) valueEl.textContent = String(value);
  if (textEl) {
    textEl.textContent = `Stats reduced by ${statReduction}%. Damage received increased by ${damageTaken}%. Healing reduced by ${healingReduction}%.`;
  }
}

async function tick() {
  try {
    const state = await fetchState();
    updateUI(state);
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || 'State error.');
  }
}

function restartPolling() {
  if (pollHandle) clearInterval(pollHandle);
  pollHandle = setInterval(tick, pollMs);
}

  if (!line) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  openLogDetail(line);
});

document.getElementById('topTeamCard').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  const slot = event.target.closest('.pSlot');
  if (!slot) return;
  if (currentAutoBattle) {
    showToast('Auto Battle is running. Turn it off to choose targets manually.');
    return;
  }
  if (!isMyTurn || !myAlive) {
    showToast('Wait for your turn.');
    return;
  }
  if (!slot.dataset.key) {
    showToast('Empty slot.');
    return;
  }
  if (slot.dataset.alive !== '1') {
    showToast('That enemy is already down.');
    return;
  }
  clearTarget();
  selectedTargetKey = slot.dataset.key || '';
  selectedTargetName = slot.dataset.username || 'Enemy';
  slot.classList.add('targeted');
  document.getElementById('targetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  document.getElementById('modalTargetName').textContent = selectedTargetName;
  openSkills();
});

document.getElementById('bottomTeamCard').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  const slot = event.target.closest('.pSlot');
  if (!slot) return;
  if (currentRoomStatus !== 'live') {
    if (SOURCE !== 'cube') {
      return;
    }
    const slotNum = parseInt(slot.dataset.slot || '0', 10);
    if (!slotNum) return;
    if (slot.dataset.key && String(slot.dataset.userId || '0') !== String(USER_ID)) {
      showToast('That formation slot is already taken.');
      return;
    }
    if (slot.dataset.key && String(slot.dataset.userId || '0') === String(USER_ID)) {
      showToast('This is your current slot.');
      return;
    }
    roomAction('pick_slot', { slot_index: slotNum })
      .then((res) => {
        showToast(res.message || 'Formation slot claimed.');
        window.location.reload();
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        showToast(error.message || 'Could not claim that slot.');
      });
    return;
  }
  if (!slot.dataset.key) return;
  if (slot.dataset.alive !== '1') {
    openRevive(slot.dataset.key, slot.dataset.username || 'Ally');
    return;
  }
  openHeal(slot.dataset.key, slot.dataset.username || 'Ally');
});

    }
  });
}

      await tick();
    } catch (error) {
      retryPhaseDuelBtn.disabled = false;
      showToast(error.message || 'Retry failed.');
    }
  });
}

// --- endpoint + payload helpers ---
const BCFG = window.BATTLE_CFG || {};
const EP   = BCFG.endpoints || {};
const IS_DG = !!BCFG.isDungeon;

function ep(name){
  // name is one of: ATTACK, JOIN, LOOT, HEAL, HEAL_POTION
  return EP[name] || '';
}

// Always include the right identifiers for the current mode.
// Global: monster_id
// Dungeon: instance_id + dgmid  (and we also send monster_id if you want)
function baseQS(){
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (IS_DG) {
    p.set('instance_id', String(BCFG.instanceId));
    p.set('dgmid',      String(BCFG.dgmid      || 0));
  } else {
    p.set('monster_id', String(BCFG.id || 0));
  }
  return p;
}

<script>
(function(){
  let secs = 1400;
  const refillAmt = 344;
  const maxStam = 12000;

  const tEl = document.getElementById('stamina_timer');
  const sEl = document.getElementById('stamina_span');

  function fmt(n){ return n.toLocaleString(); }
  function mmss(total){
    const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const s = total % 60;
    return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':' + (s<10?'0':'')+s;
  }

  function tick(){
    tEl.textContent = '⏳ ' + mmss(secs);

    if (secs <= 0){
      // Apply +10 stamina visually (server already did at HH:00:00)
      const current = parseInt((sEl.textContent || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''), 10) || 0;
      const next = Math.min(maxStam, current + refillAmt);
      if (next !== current){
        sEl.textContent = fmt(next);
      }
      secs = 3600;
    }
    secs--;
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const el = document.getElementById('server_time');
  if (!el) return;

  let epoch  = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-epoch'), 10) || Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
  const offS = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-tzoff'), 10) || 0; // server offset (seconds from UTC)

  function pad2(n){ return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(){
    // Shift by server offset, then read UTC fields => server-local time
    const d = new Date((epoch + offS) * 1000);
    let h = d.getUTCHours();
    const m = d.getUTCMinutes();
    const s = d.getUTCSeconds();
    const am = h < 12;
    let h12 = h % 12; if (h12 === 0) h12 = 12;
    el.textContent = h12 + ':' + pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s) + ' ' + (am ? 'AM' : 'PM');
  }

  render();
  setInterval(function(){ epoch++; render(); }, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const btn   = document.getElementById('buffs_btn');
  const modal = document.getElementById('buffs_modal');
  const close = document.getElementById('buffs_close');
  const list  = document.getElementById('buffs_list');

  if (!btn || !modal || !list) return;

  // Open / close
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); });
  close.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); });
  modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === modal) { modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) {
      modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
  });

  // Countdown: align to server time to avoid client skew
  const serverStartMs = (parseInt(document.getElementById('server_time')?.getAttribute('data-epoch') || '0', 10)) * 1000;
  const offsetMs = serverStartMs ? (serverStartMs - Date.now()) : 0; // server - client

  function nowServerSec(){ return Math.floor((Date.now() + offsetMs) / 1000); }
  function fmtLeft(secs){
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
    const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
    const s = secs%60;
    return (h>0 ? (h+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':') : (m+':')) + String(s).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  function tick(){
    const now = nowServerSec();
    list.querySelectorAll('.buff-row').forEach(row => {
      const ends = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-ends') || '0', 10);
      const left = Math.max(0, ends - now);
      const label = row.querySelector('[data-ends-text]');
      if (label) label.textContent = left > 0 ? (fmtLeft(left) + ' left') : 'expired';
    });
  }

  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const isLoggedIn  = true;
  const guildId     = 41;
  const hasCouncil = false;
  const tabCouncil = document.getElementById('tab_council');

  const elToggle = document.getElementById('gcw_toggle');
  const elPanel  = document.getElementById('gcw_panel');
  const elLog    = document.getElementById('gcw_log');
  const elClose  = document.getElementById('gcw_close');
  const elPopout = document.getElementById('gcw_popout');

  const elForm   = document.getElementById('gcw_form');
  const elInput  = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  const elSend   = document.getElementById('gcw_send');

  const tabGlobal = document.getElementById('tab_global');
  const tabGuild  = document.getElementById('tab_guild');

  let pollTimer  = null;
  let lastHTML   = '';
  let openedOnce = false;
  let isOpen     = false;



  const elBadge = document.getElementById('gcw_badge');

  function setBadge(n){
    if (!elBadge) return;
    n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
    if (n > 0){
      elBadge.textContent = (n > 99 ? '99+' : String(n));
      elBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
    } else {
      elBadge.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  async function refreshUnseenBadge(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) { setBadge(0); return; }
    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_unseen_count.php', { cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success') setBadge(d.count);
    }catch(_){}
  }

  async function markRepliesSeenIfAny(){
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    // only hit server if badge already shows >0 (cheap)
    const current = elBadge && elBadge.style.display !== 'none'
      ? parseInt(elBadge.textContent, 10) || 1
      : 0;
    if (!current) return;

    try{
      const r = await fetch('chat_mark_seen.php', { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
      const d = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (d && (''+d.status).trim() === 'success'){
        setBadge(0);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }


// Reply button -> set reply_to + insert @username into chat input
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.gcw_reply_btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  const replyUid = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-uid') || '0', 10) || 0;
  const u = (btn.getAttribute('data-username') || '').trim();
  if (!u) return;

  // store reply target
  const replyHidden = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
  if (replyHidden) replyHidden.value = String(replyUid);

  const input = document.getElementById('gcw_input');
  if (!input) return;

  const tag = '@' + u;
  const start = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
  const end   = input.selectionEnd ?? input.value.length;

  const before = input.value.slice(0, start);
  const after  = input.value.slice(end);

  const needsSpaceBefore = before.length && !/\s$/.test(before);
  const insert = (needsSpaceBefore ? ' ' : '') + tag + ' ';

  input.value = before + insert + after;

  const newPos = (before + insert).length;
  input.focus();
  input.setSelectionRange(newPos, newPos);
});


  // ---- rooms
  const LS_KEY_ROOM = 'gcw_room';
  function getSavedRoom(){
  const r = (localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_ROOM) || 'global').toLowerCase();
  if (r === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return 'global';
  if (r === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return 'global';
  return (r === 'guild' || r === 'council' || r === 'global') ? r : 'global';
}
  function saveRoom(r){ try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_ROOM, r); }catch(_){ } }

  let room = getSavedRoom(); // 'global' | 'guild'

  function setActiveTab(){
  if (tabGlobal)  tabGlobal.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'global'  ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabGuild)   tabGuild .setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'guild'   ? 'true':'false');
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.setAttribute('aria-selected', room === 'council' ? 'true':'false');
}

  function currentEndpoints(){
  if (room === 'guild') {
    // Use your real guild endpoints, channel fixed to "general"
    return {
      update: 'guild_updatechat.php?channel=general',
      send:   'guild_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  if (room === 'council') {
    return {
      update: 'council_updatechat.php',
      send:   'council_chat_send.php'
    };
  }
  // global
  return {
    update: 'updatechat.php',
    send:   'chat_send.php'
  };
}


  function renderRoomHeader(){
    // Optional: you can reflect the title somewhere if desired
    // (we kept title in the tabs; nothing else needed here)
  }

  function saveOpenState(open){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('gcw_open', open ? '1' : '0'); }catch(_){}
  }
  function loadOpenState(){
    try{ return localStorage.getItem('gcw_open') === '1'; }catch(_){ return false; }
  }

  function openPanel(){
    if (isOpen) return;
    isOpen = true;
    elPanel.classList.add('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    saveOpenState(true);
    if (!openedOnce){ fetchAndRender(true); openedOnce = true; }
    startPolling();
    setTimeout(() => { elLog.scrollTop = elLog.scrollHeight; }, 50);
    markRepliesSeenIfAny();
  }
  function closePanel(){
    if (!isOpen) return;
    isOpen = false;
    elPanel.classList.remove('gcw-open');
    elToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    saveOpenState(false);
    stopPolling();
  }

  elToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { isOpen ? closePanel() : openPanel(); });
  elClose .addEventListener('click', closePanel);
  elPopout.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (room === 'guild' && guildId){
    window.location.href = 'guild_chat.php?channel=general';
  } else if (room === 'council' && hasCouncil){
    window.location.href = 'council_chat.php';
  } else {
    window.location.href = 'chat.php';
  }
});

  // Switch tabs
  if (tabGlobal) tabGlobal.addEventListener('click', () => switchRoom('global'));
  if (tabGuild)  tabGuild .addEventListener('click', () => { if (guildId) switchRoom('guild'); });
  if (tabCouncil) tabCouncil.addEventListener('click', () => { if (hasCouncil) switchRoom('council'); });

  function switchRoom(next){
  if (next === room) return;
  room = next;
  saveRoom(room);
  setActiveTab();
  lastHTML = '';

  // Handle access
  if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">You are not in a guild yet. Join or create a guild to use Guild Chat.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }
  if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil){
    stopPolling();
    elLog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="msg"><div class="content">
        <span class="u">System</span>
        <span class="t">now</span>
        <div class="text">Council Chat is restricted to guild leaders and vice leaders.</div>
      </div></div>`;
    if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = true; elSend.disabled = true; }
    return;
  }

  if (elForm){ elInput.disabled = false; elSend.disabled = false; }
  fetchAndRender(true);
  if (isOpen) startPolling();
}


  function startPolling(){
    stopPolling();
    if (room === 'guild' && !guildId) return; // nothing to poll
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; 
    pollTimer = setInterval(fetchAndRender, 1500);
  }
  function stopPolling(){
    if (pollTimer){ clearInterval(pollTimer); pollTimer = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden || !isOpen) { stopPolling(); }
    else { startPolling(); fetchAndRender(); }
  });

  async function fetchAndRender(first=false){
  try{
    if (room === 'guild'   && !guildId)   return;
    if (room === 'council' && !hasCouncil) return; // ← add
    const logEl = elLog;
    const wasNearBottom = (logEl.scrollHeight - logEl.scrollTop - logEl.clientHeight) < 120;
    const { update } = currentEndpoints();
    const r = await fetch(update, { method:'POST', cache:'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const html = await r.text();
    if (html !== lastHTML){
      lastHTML = html;
      elLog.innerHTML = html;
      if (first || wasNearBottom) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }catch(e){ /* silent */ }
}


  if (isLoggedIn && elForm){
    elForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (room === 'guild' && !guildId){
        alert('Join a guild to chat in Guild channel.');
        return;
      }
      const text = (elInput.value || '').trim();
      if (!text) return;
      if (text.length > 300) { alert('Message too long.'); return; }
      elSend.disabled = true;
      try{
        const { send } = currentEndpoints();
const replyTo = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to')?.value || '0';

const body = 'message=' + encodeURIComponent(text)
           + '&reply_to=' + encodeURIComponent(replyTo)
           + (room === 'guild' ? '&channel=general' : '');

const r = await fetch(send, {
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body
});

        const data = await r.json().catch(()=>null);
        if (data && (''+data.status).trim() === 'success'){
          elInput.value = '';
const rt = document.getElementById('gcw_reply_to');
if (rt) rt.value = '0';
await fetchAndRender();     // <-- make it await
  refreshUnseenBadge();       // <-- add this

        }else{
          alert((data && data.message) || 'Failed to send.');
        }
      }catch(_){
        alert('Server error.');
      }
      elSend.disabled = false;
      elInput.focus();
    });
  }

  // init
  setActiveTab();
  renderRoomHeader();
  refreshUnseenBadge();
  setInterval(refreshUnseenBadge, 300000);
  if (loadOpenState()) { openPanel(); }
  else {
    // lazy-load the first selected room once user opens the panel
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
// Announcement dismiss logic
(function(){
  const bar   = document.getElementById('globalAnnouncementBar');
  const btn   = document.getElementById('dismissAnnouncementBtn');
  if (!bar || !btn) return;

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    const annId = bar.getAttribute('data-ann-id') || '0';


    bar.style.display = 'none';

    const fd = new URLSearchParams();
    fd.set('ann_id', annId);

    fetch('announcement_seen.php', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body: fd.toString()
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
 
    })
    .catch(()=>{  });
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
// side nav open/close logic
(function(){
  const drawer   = document.getElementById('sideDrawer');
  const fabOpen  = document.getElementById('nav_fab');       // 👈 bottom-left button
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('sideCloseBtn');  // ✕ inside drawer header
  const overlay  = document.getElementById('sideOverlay');   // dark backdrop on mobile

  if (!drawer) return;

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','true');
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.setAttribute('data-open','false');
  }

  if (fabOpen){
    fabOpen.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  }
  if (closeBtn){
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }
  if (overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  }

  // ESC closes only on mobile view (doesn't really matter to check width though)
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){
      closeDrawer();
    }
  });
})();

function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  if (!note) return;
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = (type === 'error') ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
}
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
        const btn = e.target.closest('.potion-use-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        const invId   = btn.getAttribute('data-inv');
        const itemId  = btn.getAttribute('data-item');
        if (window.ExpPotions && window.ExpPotions.handles(itemId)) {
            await window.ExpPotions.use(invId, itemId);
            return;
        }
        const itemNm  = btn.getAttribute('data-name') || 'Item';
        const maxQty  = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-max'), 10) || 1;
        const qtyInput= document.getElementById('puse_'+invId);
        const qtyLeftSpan = document.getElementById('pqty_'+invId);

        let useQty = 1;
        if (qtyInput) {
            useQty = parseInt(qtyInput.value,10) || 1;
            if (useQty < 1) useQty = 1;
            if (useQty > maxQty) useQty = maxQty;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Use ${useQty}x ${itemNm}? This will consume the item(s).`)) {
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('inv_id', invId);
        if (useQty > 1) params.set('qty', useQty);

        try {
            const endpoint = (parseInt(itemId, 10) === 108) ? 'user_heal_potion.php' : 'use_item.php';

            const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: params.toString()
            });

            const raw = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                showNotification('Used ' + itemNm + '!', 'success');

                // update qty inside drawer
                let leftNow = parseInt(qtyLeftSpan.textContent,10) || 0;
                leftNow = leftNow - useQty;
                if (leftNow < 0) leftNow = 0;
                qtyLeftSpan.textContent = leftNow;

                // update btn / input max
                btn.setAttribute('data-max', leftNow);
                if (qtyInput) {
                    qtyInput.setAttribute('max', leftNow);
                    if (leftNow === 0) qtyInput.value = 0;
                }

                // update the bubble on trigger
                const totalBubble = document.getElementById('drawerTotalQty');
                if (totalBubble) {
                    let totalAll = 0;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.potion-qty-left').forEach(sp => {
                        totalAll += (parseInt(sp.textContent,10) || 0);
                    });
                    totalBubble.textContent = totalAll;
                }

                // if out of stock disable button
                if (leftNow <= 0) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.textContent = 'None';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Use';
                }

                // optional refresh to sync stamina/HP/etc
                location.reload();
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0,200) || 'Failed to use item.', 'error');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'Use';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error.', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Use';
        }
    });
})();


(function(){
    let selectedSetNum   = null;
    let selectedApplyType = 'equipments';


    const bodyEl        = document.body;
    const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('qsModalBackdrop');
    const modal         = document.getElementById('qsModal');
    const setSpan       = document.getElementById('qsModalSetNum');
    const modalText     = document.getElementById('qsModalText');
    const pveAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPveAttackBtn');
    const pvpAttackBtn  = document.getElementById('qsModalPvpAttackBtn');
    const defenseBtn    = document.getElementById('qsModalDefenseBtn');

    function syncQuickSetModalTargets() {
        if (!pveAttackBtn || !pvpAttackBtn || !defenseBtn) return;

        if (selectedApplyType === 'pets') {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which pet team to update. It will overwrite your current pets for that team.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Team';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Team';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Team';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        } else {
            if (modalText) {
                modalText.textContent = 'Choose which equipment set to update. It will overwrite your current items for that set.';
            }

            pveAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvE Attack Set';
            pveAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'attack');
            pveAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            pvpAttackBtn.textContent = 'PvP Attack Set';
            pvpAttackBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'pvp_attack');
            pvpAttackBtn.style.display = '';

            defenseBtn.textContent = 'PvP Defense Set';
            defenseBtn.setAttribute('data-target', 'defense');
        }
    }

        function openModal(setNum, applyType) {
        selectedSetNum    = setNum;
        selectedApplyType = (applyType === 'pets') ? 'pets' : 'equipments';

        if (setSpan) {
            // Example: "#3 – Gear" or "#3 – Pets"
            const labelSuffix = (selectedApplyType === 'pets') ? ' – Pets' : ' – Gear';
            setSpan.textContent = '#' + setNum + labelSuffix;
        }

        syncQuickSetModalTargets();
        bodyEl.classList.add('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }


    function closeModal() {
        selectedSetNum = null;
        bodyEl.classList.remove('qsmodal-open');
        if (modal)  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }


    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        // Click on a quick set button inside the drawer
        const setBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-set-btn');
        if (setBtn) {
            const setNum    = parseInt(setBtn.getAttribute('data-set-number') || '0', 10);
            const applyType = (setBtn.getAttribute('data-apply-type') || 'equipments').toLowerCase();

            if (setNum > 0) {
                openModal(setNum, applyType);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) return;

        // Click outside dialog on the dark backdrop
        if (e.target === modalBackdrop) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        const actionBtn = e.target.closest('.qs-modal-btn');
        if (!actionBtn) return;

        const target = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-target');
        if (target === 'cancel') {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        if (!selectedSetNum || (target !== 'attack' && target !== 'defense' && target !== 'pvp_attack')) {
            closeModal();
            return;
        }

        applyQuickSet(selectedSetNum, target, actionBtn);
    });

    async function applyQuickSet(setNum, target, actionBtn) {
        const originalText = actionBtn.textContent;
        actionBtn.disabled = true;
        actionBtn.textContent = 'Applying...';

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('set_number', String(setNum));
        params.set('target_set', target);
        params.set('apply_type', selectedApplyType); // "equipment" or "pets"

        try {
            const res = await fetch('quick_sets_apply.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
                body: params.toString()
            });
            const raw   = await res.text();
            const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();

            if (lower.includes('success')) {
                const targetLabel = (selectedApplyType === 'pets')
                    ? (target === 'defense' ? 'PvP DEFENSE' : 'ATTACK')
                    : (target === 'pvp_attack' ? 'PVP ATTACK' : (target === 'defense' ? 'PVP DEFENSE' : 'PVE ATTACK'));
                showNotification(
                    `Quick Set #${setNum} equipped as your ${targetLabel} set.`,
                    'success'
                );
                closeModal();
                // If you want immediate refresh to reflect new stats/gear:
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 600);
            } else {
                showNotification(raw.slice(0, 200) || 'Failed to apply quick set.', 'error');
                actionBtn.disabled = false;
                actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            showNotification('Server error while applying quick set.', 'error');
            actionBtn.disabled = false;
            actionBtn.textContent = originalText;
        }
    }

    // ESC closes modal
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && bodyEl.classList.contains('qsmodal-open')) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
})();


</script>
<script>
// Record one authenticated game visit per server day for retention cohorts.
(function () {
  const serverDay = "2026-10-31";
  const storageKey = 'veyra_game_activity_day';
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === serverDay) return;
  } catch (_e) {}

  fetch('/game_activity_ping.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  }).then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() : null)
    .then((payload) => {
      if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) return;
      try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serverDay); } catch (_e) {}
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
<script>
// Prevent old per-wave UI cookies from growing into an oversized Cookie header.
(function(){
  try {
    const rawCookie = document.cookie || '';
    const waveFilterNames = rawCookie
      .split(';')
      .map((part) => part.trim().split('=')[0])
      .filter((name) => /^wave_filters_/.test(name));

    if (rawCookie.length < 6000 && waveFilterNames.length <= 8) {
      return;
    }

    waveFilterNames.forEach((name) => {
      document.cookie = `${name}=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; Path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
    });
  } catch (_e) {}
})();
</script>

  <div class="formula-body">
    <div style="margin-bottom:10px;">
      Monster DEF is split into:
      <strong>EQ DEF</strong> = 2,250,
      <strong>PET DEF</strong> = 4,750,
      <strong>Active DEF</strong> = 5,000.
    </div>

    <code>
base_damage =
(
  225
  + (max(30, (equip_atk - monster_eq_defense)) * 20)
  + (max(30, (pet_atk   - monster_pet_defense)) * 20)
  + (1000 * max(30, (user_attack_stat - monster_def)) ** 0.25)
)
* stamina_cost;
    </code>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;">
      <strong>⚡ Elemental damage:</strong><br>
      Elemental rate used = <strong>highest elemental rate equipped</strong>.<br>
      If your element <strong>counters</strong> the monster's element, your rate is <strong>doubled</strong> for this part only.
      <br><br>

      <code>
player_element_rate = equipped element with the highest rate
elemental_damage =
(
  (player_element_rate - monster_element_rate)
  * 1500
)
*
stamina_cost;

if(element_1 counters element_2) then element_1_rate = element_1_rate x 2
      </code>
      <div style="margin-top:12px;">
        <strong>✨ Divine shield:</strong><br><br>
        <code>final_damage = base_damage * (50% + 50% * have / needed)</code> (clamped 50%–100%).<br>
        In this fight: <strong>10</strong> / <strong>10</strong>
        → multiplier = <strong>100.0%</strong>.

<script>
    function fxIsOff(){ return document.body.classList.contains('fx-off'); }

function setFxOff(off){
  document.body.classList.toggle('fx-off', !!off);
  // persist both ways
  try { localStorage.setItem('fx_off', off ? '1' : '0'); } catch(e){}
  setCookie('fx_off', off ? '1' : '0', 60*60*24*365); // 1 year

  const btn = document.getElementById('fxToggleBtn');
  if (btn){
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', (!off).toString());
    btn.textContent = off ? '⚡ Attack FX: OFF' : '⚡ Attack FX: ON';
  }
}

// Initialize preference (auto-off if user prefers reduced motion)
(function initFxPref(){
  let off = false;
  try { off = (localStorage.getItem('fx_off') === '1'); } catch(e){}
  if (!off) off = (getCookie('fx_off') === '1');
  if (!off && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
    off = true;
  }
  setFxOff(off);

  const btn = document.getElementById('fxToggleBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', () => setFxOff(!fxIsOff()));
})();

function triggerSlashFX(mode='slash'){
    if (fxIsOff()) return;
  const box = document.getElementById('slashFX');
  if (!box) return;

  // Set mode class for palette/intensity
  box.classList.remove('mode-power','mode-heroic','mode-legend','mode-ultimate');
  if (mode === 'power')    box.classList.add('mode-power');
  if (mode === 'heroic')   box.classList.add('mode-heroic');
  if (mode === 'legend')   box.classList.add('mode-legend');
  if (mode === 'ultimate') box.classList.add('mode-ultimate');
  if (mode === 'world') box.classList.add('mode-world');

  // Base nodes present in all modes
  const parts = [];

  // Helper to add N diagonal slashes
  const addSlash = (klass='') => `<div class="fx-slash ${klass}"></div>`;

  switch(mode){
    case 'power':
      parts.push(
        addSlash('long'),
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(10) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(2);
      break;

    case 'heroic':
      parts.push(
        addSlash('long'),
        addSlash('long late'),
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(16) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(2);
      break;

    case 'legend':
      parts.push(
        addSlash('ultra'),
        addSlash('ultra late'),
        addSlash('ultra later'),
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(24) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(3);
      break;

    case 'ultimate':
      parts.push(
        // Cross slash + vertical rift + big ring + tint
        addSlash('ultra'),
        addSlash('ultra rev late'),
        '<div class="fx-rift"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-ring"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-sparks">' + createSparks(32) + '</div>',
        '<div class="fx-tint"></div>',
        '<div class="fx-flash"></div>'
      );
      bodyShake(3);
      break;

    default: // normal slash
      parts.push(addSlash(), '<div class="fx-flash"></div>');
      bodyShake(1);
  }

  // Build + (re)start animations
  box.innerHTML = parts.join('');
  box.classList.remove('animate');
  void box.offsetWidth; // reflow
  box.classList.add('animate');

  // Clear overlay once done
  setTimeout(() => { box.classList.remove('animate'); box.innerHTML=''; }, 750);
}

function bodyShake(level=1){
    if (fxIsOff()) return;
  document.body.classList.remove('shake','shake-1','shake-2','shake-3');
  if (level === 1) document.body.classList.add('shake-1');
  if (level === 2) document.body.classList.add('shake-2');
  if (level >= 3)  document.body.classList.add('shake-3');
  setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove('shake','shake-1','shake-2','shake-3'), 420);
}

function createSparks(n=12){
  // Random short shards radiating from center
  let html = '';
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const ang = Math.random()*360;
    const dist = 20 + Math.random()*40; // vmin-ish
    const x = 50 + Math.cos(ang*Math.PI/180)*dist;
    const y = 50 + Math.sin(ang*Math.PI/180)*dist;
    const rot = Math.random()*360;
    const w = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random()*9);
    const top = `${y}vmin`, left = `${x}vmin`;
    html += `<i style="top:${top};left:${left};transform:rotate(${rot}deg);width:${w}px;"></i>`;
  }
  return html;
}


/* --- simple helpers --- */
function getCookie(name) {
  const m = document.cookie.split('; ').find(r => r.startsWith(name + '='));
  return m ? decodeURIComponent(m.split('=')[1]) : '';
}
function setCookie(name, value, maxAgeSeconds = 86400) {
  document.cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; max-age=${maxAgeSeconds}; SameSite=Lax`;
}
function deleteCookie(name) {
  document.cookie = `${name}=; path=/; max-age=0; SameSite=Lax`;
}
function getDailyCookieKey() {
  const now = new Date();
  const year = now.getFullYear();
  const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}
function canAttackNow() {
  const raw = getCookie('last_attack');
  const last = parseInt(raw || '0', 10) || 0;
  const now  = Date.now();
  if (!Number.isFinite(last) || last <= 0) {
    return { ok: true, now };
  }
  // A future attack timestamp means the browser clock changed or the cookie is corrupted.
  // Clear it so players do not get fake waits like "3000s".
  if (last > now + 1000) {
    deleteCookie('last_attack');
    return { ok: true, now };
  }
  if (last && now - last < 500) {
    return { ok: false, waitMs: 500 - (now - last) };
  }
  return { ok: true, now };
}
function lockAttackButtons(lock = true) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.attack-btn').forEach(b => {
    b.disabled = lock;
    if (lock) { b.classList.add('is-loading'); b.setAttribute('aria-busy','true'); }
    else { b.classList.remove('is-loading'); b.removeAttribute('aria-busy'); }
  });
}
function showNotification(msg, type = 'success') {
  const note = document.getElementById('notification');
  note.innerHTML = msg;
  note.style.background = type === 'error' ? '#e74c3c' : '#2ecc71';
  note.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { note.style.display = 'none'; }, type === 'error' ? 8000 : 3000);
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

function setDamageDebugOutput(msg) {
  if (!DAMAGE_DEBUG) return;
  const box = document.getElementById('damageDebugBox');
  const content = document.getElementById('damageDebugContent');
  if (!box || !content) return;
  content.textContent = String(msg || '');
  box.classList.add('is-visible');
  try { console.error('damage.php debug:', msg); } catch (e) {}
}

function clearDamageDebugOutput() {
  if (!DAMAGE_DEBUG) return;
  const box = document.getElementById('damageDebugBox');
  const content = document.getElementById('damageDebugContent');
  if (content) content.textContent = '';
  if (box) box.classList.remove('is-visible');
}

function buildDamageDebugMessage(raw, data, res) {
  const parts = [];
  const msg = (data && typeof data.message === 'string') ? data.message.trim() : '';
  if (msg) parts.push(msg);
  if (data && typeof data.req_id === 'string' && data.req_id.trim()) {
    parts.push(`req_id: ${data.req_id.trim()}`);
  }
  const rawText = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : '';
  if (rawText) {
    const normalizedMsg = msg.trim();
    if (!normalizedMsg || rawText !== normalizedMsg) {
      parts.push(rawText);
    }
  }
  if (!parts.length && res) {
    parts.push(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  }
  return parts.join("\n\n");
}

function showDamageDebugFailure(raw, data, res) {
  const debugMsg = buildDamageDebugMessage(raw, data, res) || 'Unknown attack error.';
  setDamageDebugOutput(debugMsg);
  showNotification(
    `<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;">Attack failed</div><div style="max-width:520px;white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:Consolas,Monaco,monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;">${escapeHtml(debugMsg)}</div>`,
    'error'
  );
}

/* EXP cap updater (DOM) */
function updateCapNotice(newDamage) {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('yourStats');
  if (!wrap) return;
  const cont = document.getElementById('capNotice');
  if (!cont) return;

  const maxhp    = Number(wrap.dataset.maxhp || 0);
  const capFrac  = parseFloat(wrap.dataset.capfraction || '0.2');
  const capPerc  = wrap.dataset.capperc || String(Math.round(capFrac * 100));

  if (!maxhp || capFrac <= 0) { cont.innerHTML=''; return; }

  const need = Math.ceil(capFrac * maxhp);
  if (Number(newDamage) >= need) {
    cont.innerHTML =
      `<span class="chip" style="font-size:14px; background:#3b1f1f; border-color:#6a2b2b; color:#ffb3b3;">
         ⚠ EXP cap reached (${capPerc}%). Extra damage won't increase your EXP share.
       </span>`;
  } else {
    cont.innerHTML = '';
  }
}

function isSafeUserMsg(m){
  if (typeof m !== "string") return false;
  const clean = m.trim();
  if (!clean) return false;
  if (SAFE_ERROR_MESSAGES.has(clean)) return true;
  return (
    / is still sealed\.$/.test(clean) ||
    /^This run is .+\. Combat is disabled\.$/.test(clean) ||
    /^Your guild officers have blocked your access to guild dungeons\./.test(clean)
  );
}
function showServerErrorMessage(msg) {
  const clean = (typeof msg === "string") ? msg.trim() : "";
  showNotification(clean ? escapeHtml(clean) : "Server error", "error");
}

function parseDamageJson(raw) {
  const text = String(raw ?? '');
  const trimmed = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
  const candidates = [text, trimmed];
  const firstLine = trimmed.split(/\r?\n/, 1)[0];
  if (firstLine && firstLine.trim().startsWith('{')) {
    candidates.push(firstLine.trim());
  }

  const firstJsonObject = (() => {
    const start = trimmed.indexOf('{');
    if (start < 0) return '';
    let depth = 0;
    let inString = false;
    let escaped = false;
    for (let i = start; i < trimmed.length; i++) {
      const ch = trimmed[i];
      if (inString) {
        if (escaped) {
          escaped = false;
        } else if (ch === '\\') {
          escaped = true;
        } else if (ch === '"') {
          inString = false;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '"') {
        inString = true;
      } else if (ch === '{') {
        depth++;
      } else if (ch === '}') {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) {
          return trimmed.slice(start, i + 1);
        }
      }
    }
    return '';
  })();
  if (firstJsonObject) {
    candidates.push(firstJsonObject);
  }

  const firstBrace = trimmed.indexOf('{');
  const lastBrace = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
  if (firstBrace >= 0 && lastBrace > firstBrace) {
    candidates.push(trimmed.slice(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1));
  }

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (!candidate) continue;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(candidate);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  return null;
}

function formatAttackFailureMessage(raw, res, err) {
  if (err) {
    const errMsg = ((err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown attack error')).trim();
    return 'Attack request failed: ' + (errMsg || 'Unknown attack error');
  }

  const statusText = res && res.status ? ('HTTP ' + res.status) : 'unknown status';
  const cleanRaw = String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!cleanRaw) {
    return 'Invalid response from damage.php (' + statusText + ').';
  }

  const snippet = cleanRaw.slice(0, 180);
  return 'Invalid response from damage.php (' + statusText + '): ' + snippet;
}

function setHtmlIfExists(id, html) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.innerHTML = html;
}

function setStyleIfExists(id, prop, value) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.style[prop] = value;
}

function setDuplicateIdText(id, text) {
  document.querySelectorAll(`[id="${id}"]`).forEach(el => {
    el.textContent = text;
  });
}

function refreshPlayerMonsterDebuffs() {
  const target = document.getElementById('playerMonsterDebuffsBody');
  if (!target || IS_DG) return;

  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('debuffs_json', '1');
  fetch(url.toString(), {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
    cache: 'no-store'
  })
    .then(res => res.ok ? res.json() : null)
    .then(data => {
      if (data && data.ok && typeof data.html === 'string') {
        target.innerHTML = data.html;
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {});
}

function updateAttackSuccessUI(data) {
  showNotification(data.message, 'success');
  animateMonster();

  const hp = data && data.hp ? data.hp : {};
  const hpPercent = Number(hp.percent);
  if (Number.isFinite(hpPercent)) {
    setStyleIfExists('hpFill', 'width', hpPercent + '%');
  }
  if (typeof data.stamina !== 'undefined') {
    setHtmlIfExists('stamina_span', new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(data.stamina) || 0));
  }
  if (typeof hp.value !== 'undefined' && typeof hp.max !== 'undefined') {
    setHtmlIfExists('hpText', `❤️ ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(hp.value) || 0)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(hp.max) || 0)} HP`);
  }

  if (typeof data.mana === 'number') {
    const manaVal = Math.max(0, Math.min(PLAYER_MAX_MANA, data.mana));
    const manaPct = PLAYER_MAX_MANA > 0 ? (manaVal / PLAYER_MAX_MANA) * 100 : 0;
    setStyleIfExists('pManaFill', 'width', manaPct + '%');
    setHtmlIfExists('pManaText', `💠 ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(manaVal)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(PLAYER_MAX_MANA)} MP`);
  }

  if (data.phase && data.phase.image) {
    const imgEl = document.getElementById('monsterImage');
    if (imgEl) imgEl.src = data.phase.image;
  }

  if (data.retaliation && typeof data.retaliation.user_hp_after === 'number') {
    const afterHP = data.retaliation.user_hp_after;
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (afterHP / PLAYER_MAX_HP) * 100));
    setStyleIfExists('pHpFill', 'width', pct + '%');
    setHtmlIfExists('pHpText', `💚 ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(afterHP)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(PLAYER_MAX_HP)} HP`);
  }

  if ((!data.phase || !data.phase.changed) && Number(hp.value) <= 0) {
    location.reload();
    return;
  }

  const leaderboardRows = Array.isArray(data.leaderboard) ? data.leaderboard : [];
  const lbHtml =
    '<strong>📊 Attackers Leaderboard</strong>' +
    '<div class="lb-list">' +
    leaderboardRows.map((row, i) => {
      const picture = (typeof row.PICTURE === 'string' && row.PICTURE.trim()) ? row.PICTURE : 'images/default_avatar.png';
      const username = escapeHtml(row.USERNAME || 'Unknown');
      const playerId = Number(row.ID) || 0;
      return `
        <div class="lb-row">
          <span class="lb-rank">#${i + 1}</span>
          <img class="lb-avatar" src="${escapeHtml(picture)}" alt="">
          <span class="lb-name">
            <a style="color:white;" href="player.php?pid=${playerId}">${username}</a>
          </span>
          <span class="lb-dmg">${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(row.DAMAGE_DEALT) || 0)} DMG</span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('') +
    '</div>';
  const leaderboardPanel = document.querySelector('.leaderboard-panel');
  if (leaderboardPanel) leaderboardPanel.innerHTML = lbHtml;

  let totalDamageValue = null;
  if (typeof data.totaldmgdealt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(data.totaldmgdealt)) {
    totalDamageValue = Number(data.totaldmgdealt);
  } else if (USER_ID) {
    const myRow = leaderboardRows.find(r => Number(r.ID) === Number(USER_ID));
    if (myRow && typeof myRow.DAMAGE_DEALT !== 'undefined') {
      totalDamageValue = Number(myRow.DAMAGE_DEALT);
    }
  }
  if (totalDamageValue !== null && Number.isFinite(totalDamageValue)) {
    setDuplicateIdText('yourDamageValue', new Intl.NumberFormat().format(totalDamageValue));
    updateCapNotice(totalDamageValue);
  }

  const logs = Array.isArray(data.logs) ? data.logs : [];
  const logHtml =
    '<strong>📜 Attack Log</strong><br>' +
    logs.map(row => {
      const extra = row.EXTRA_INFO !== "NONE" ? ` (${escapeHtml(row.EXTRA_INFO || '')})` : "";
      return `⚔️ ${escapeHtml(row.USERNAME || 'Unknown')} used ${escapeHtml(row.SKILL_NAME || 'Slash')}${extra} for ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(Number(row.DAMAGE) || 0)} DMG!<br>`;
    }).join('');
  const logPanel = document.querySelector('.log-panel');
  if (logPanel) logPanel.innerHTML = logHtml;

  if (typeof data.xp_delta === 'number') {
    addExpUI(data.xp_delta);
  } else {
    addExpUI(10);
  }

  refreshPlayerMonsterDebuffs();
}

<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('damageDebugClose');
    if (closeBtn) {
      closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => clearDamageDebugOutput());
    }
  }

  const rewardIntroModal = document.getElementById('monsterRewardInfoModal');
  if (rewardIntroModal) {
    const rewardModalCookieName = 'battle_rank_rewards_seen_day';
    const todayKey = getDailyCookieKey();
    if (getCookie(rewardModalCookieName) !== todayKey) {
      rewardIntroModal.style.display = 'flex';
      setCookie(rewardModalCookieName, todayKey, 7 * 86400);
    }
    rewardIntroModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === rewardIntroModal) {
        closeMonsterRewardInfoModal();
      }
    });
  }

  // attach attack button handlers
  document.querySelectorAll('.attack-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const skillName = (btn.getAttribute('data-skill-name') || '').toLowerCase();

      // decide FX mode
      let fxMode = 'slash';
      if (skillName.includes('ultimate'))   fxMode = 'ultimate';
      else if (skillName.includes('world')) fxMode = 'world';
      else if (skillName.includes('legend')) fxMode = 'legend';
      else if (skillName.includes('heroic')) fxMode = 'heroic';
      else if (skillName.includes('power'))  fxMode = 'power';

      // fire visual instantly on tap
      if (!fxIsOff()) triggerSlashFX(fxMode);

      const check = canAttackNow();
      if (!check.ok) {
        const secs = Math.ceil(check.waitMs / 1000);
        showNotification(`⏳ Take your time… ${secs}s`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      setCookie('last_attack', check.now);
      lockAttackButtons(true);
      setTimeout(() => lockAttackButtons(false), 1000);

      const skillId = btn.getAttribute('data-skill-id');
      const cost =
        skillId === "-1" ? 10 :
        skillId === "-2" ? 50 :
        skillId === "-3" ? 100 :
        skillId === "-4" ? 200 :
        skillId === "-5" ? 1000 :
        1;

      const fd = baseQS();
      fd.set('skill_id', skillId);
      fd.set('stamina_cost', String(cost));
      if (IS_DG) {
        fd.set('instance_id', String(BCFG.instanceId));
        fd.set('dgmid', String(BCFG.dgmid));
      }
      if (BCFG.privateBoss && BCFG.privateBoss.enabled) {
        fd.set('csrf_token', String(BCFG.privateBoss.csrf || ''));
        fd.set(
          'request_token',
          (window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === 'function')
            ? window.crypto.randomUUID()
            : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`
        );
      }

      const attackPayload = fd.toString();
      const runAttackRequest = (attempt = 1) => {
        fetch(ep('ATTACK'), {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
          body: attackPayload
        })
        .then(async res => {
          const raw = await res.text();
          const data = parseDamageJson(raw);
          return { res, raw, data };
        })
        .then(({ res, raw, data }) => {
          const msg = (data && typeof data.message === 'string') ? data.message.trim() : '';

          if (msg === 'Invalid request.' && attempt < 2) {
            setTimeout(() => runAttackRequest(attempt + 1), 350);
            return;
          }

          if (!res.ok || !data) {
            if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
              showDamageDebugFailure(raw, data, res);
            } else {
              showServerErrorMessage(msg || formatAttackFailureMessage(raw, res, null));
            }
            return;
          }

          if (String(data.status).trim() === 'success') {
            clearDamageDebugOutput();
            try {
              updateAttackSuccessUI(data);
            } catch (uiErr) {
              showNotification(data.message || 'Attack succeeded.', 'success');
              if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
                const uiMsg = 'Attack succeeded, but the battle page UI failed to update: ' +
                  ((uiErr && uiErr.message) ? uiErr.message : String(uiErr));
                setDamageDebugOutput(uiMsg);
              }
            }
            if (data.private_boss && data.private_boss.redirect_url) {
              window.setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.assign(String(data.private_boss.redirect_url));
              }, 450);
            }
          } else {
            if (msg === "Monster is already dead.") {
              location.reload();
            } else if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
              showDamageDebugFailure(raw, data, res);
            } else {
              showServerErrorMessage(msg);
            }
          }
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          if (DAMAGE_DEBUG) {
            showDamageDebugFailure((err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Unknown attack error.', null, null);
          } else {
            showServerErrorMessage(formatAttackFailureMessage('', null, err));
          }
        });
      };

      runAttackRequest();
    });
  });

  // attach join button handler
  const joinBtn = document.getElementById('join-battle');
  if (joinBtn) {
    joinBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        const p = baseQS();
p.set('user_id', '159129');

const res = await fetch(ep('JOIN'), {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
  body: p.toString()
});

        const msgRaw = await res.text();
        const msg = (msgRaw || '').trim();
        const ok = msg.toLowerCase().startsWith('you have successfully');
        showNotification(msg || 'Unknown response', ok ? 'success' : 'error');
        if (ok) setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 900);
      } catch (e) {
        showNotification('Server error. Please try again.', 'error');
      }
    });
  }

}); // end DOMContentLoaded

function computeReqExp(level) {
  return Math.round(100 + Math.pow(2.5 * (level + 1), 2));
}
function addExpUI(amount) {
  const expTop  = document.querySelector('.gtb-exp-top span:last-child');
  const expFill = document.querySelector('.gtb-exp-fill');
  const lvlEl   = document.querySelector('.gtb-level');
  if (!expTop || !expFill || !lvlEl) return;
  let level = parseInt(lvlEl.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10) || 0;
  let [current, required] = expTop.textContent.split('/').map(s => parseInt(s.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10));
  if (!isFinite(current) || !isFinite(required)) return;
  current += amount;
  required = computeReqExp(level);
  while (current >= required) {
    current -= required;
    level += 1;
    required = computeReqExp(level);
  }
  lvlEl.textContent = 'LV ' + level;
  expTop.textContent = `${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(current)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat().format(required)}`;
  expFill.style.width = Math.min(100, (current / required) * 100) + '%';
}
